title: Remote Cold Caller – Appointment Setter, Path to Commission-Based Closer (Web Solutions Company)
description:
Job overview:



• Company: A web solutions company

• Location: 100% remote (Philippines-based)

• Type: Full-time, long-term

• Working hours: 9 AM to 5 PM US time (this is a night shift in Philippine time)

• Start date: We will contact applicants for onboarding starting immediately



About the role:



We are a web solutions company growing our client base through outbound calling.

You will cold call businesses and offer them a free, in-depth analysis of their website and their Google and AI search rankings. Your main goal on every call is to get the business to accept the free analysis. Your second goal is to book a call between the prospect and our founder.

You'll work from a simple, proven script. You won't need to sell services or explain technical details on the call. You just need to get the yes and collect the right details.

Over time, strong performers will have the opportunity to move into a commission-based sales role as a closer. This is a genuine growth opportunity for people who deliver results.



Key responsibilities:



• Make outbound cold calls to businesses from the lists we provide.

• Offer our free website and Google and AI search rankings analysis using our call script.

• Collect the prospect's details accurately: names, website,
, phone number, role, and their main website goal or pain point.

• Submit each accepted analysis through our booking form and website tool.

• Book calls with our founder for interested prospects, and for businesses that don't have a website yet.

• Keep accurate records of every call.

• Meet weekly targets for calls made, conversations, analyses accepted and calls booked.



Requirements:



• Near-perfect spoken English (non-negotiable).

• Experience in cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, sales or customer service is a big plus.

• Confident on the phone and comfortable hearing "no."

• Self-motivated, persistent, organized and comfortable working remotely.

• Reliable computer/laptop, good headset and stable high-speed internet.

• Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US time (a night shift in Philippine time). Exact hours may shift slightly depending on which US time zone we're calling.

• Fast learner and coachable.



Trial period and pay:



Every new team member starts on a paid trial period. Trial period will be paid at $8 per analysis accepted. The trial ends as soon as you get your first free analysis accepted by a prospect.

From that point on, you are paid $4 USD per hour, full-time.



What we offer:



• $4 USD per hour once you complete the trial period.

• Full-time, long-term, stable work with a growing company.

• A clear, simple call script. No technical selling required.

• Training on our offer, script, tools and process.

• All necessary tools and lead lists provided.

• A path to a commission-based closer role over time for top performers, with very high earning potential.



How to apply:



Only serious applicants who follow instructions will be considered.

1. Send your updated resume/CV.

2. In the first line of your message, write exactly: "I have near-perfect English and am available for voice interviews."

3. Record a short voice message (30–60 seconds, using 
 or a similar tool). Introduce yourself, explain why you're interested in a cold calling role, and show us your English speaking ability. Attach or link the audio file.



We will immediately review applications and reach out to selected candidates for onboarding. Thank you in advance to everyone who applies!

title: Experienced US Social Media Marketing Coach & Strategist
description:
We're looking for an experienced Social Media Marketing coach and strategist who understands the US market and can help us improve how we promote our apps and digital products.



This is primarily a coaching and advisory role, rather than a role where you simply receive tasks and execute them. We want someone who can review what we're doing, identify what is and isn't working, recommend better approaches, and coach us through implementing them.



There may also be opportunities for hands-on work—such as content planning, editing, posting, community management or campaign support—depending on your experience and availability.



WHAT YOU'LL HELP WITH



- Audit our current social media accounts, content and strategy

- Help us understand what appeals to US audiences

- Develop practical content themes, hooks and posting strategies

- Review content ideas and provide direct, constructive feedback

- Coach us on TikTok, Instagram,
 and short-form video

- Help us interpret analytics and d
 what to test next

- Recommend simple, realistic growth experiments

- Improve our content workflow and consistency

- Potentially assist with content creation, scheduling or account management



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU



- Have proven SMM experience targeting customers in the United States

- Have managed or advised social accounts for US brands or clients

- Understand organic growth, short-form content and audience engagement

- Can explain strategy clearly and turn it into practical next steps

- Are comfortable giving honest feedback and challenging weak ideas

- Use analytics and evidence—not just opinions—to guide decisions

- Are dependable, organised and able to work independently

- Communicate clearly in written and spoken English



Experience marketing mobile apps, SaaS, AI tools or consumer technology would be especially useful.



HOURS AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT



- Approximately 5 hours per week initially

- Flexible working hours

- One regular strategy/coaching call, with asynchronous feedback between calls

- Occasional overlap with Australian hours will be required

- More hours may become available for hands-on implementation

- Paid trial period to make sure we work well together



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction and your hourly rate

2. Your experience working with US brands or audiences

3. Links or examples of accounts you have managed or advised

4. One or two measurable results you helped achieve

5. Which platforms you know best

6. Whether you prefer coaching, hands-on execution, or a mix of both

7. A brief answer to: If a new app's social content was receiving views but very few downloads, what would you investigate first?



Please don't send a generic application. We're looking for someone who can think strategically, communicate clearly and help us make better marketing decisions.

title: Administrative Assistant to the CEO
description:
Job Title: Administrative Assistant to the CEO (Operations & Outbound Outreach)

Schedule: TBD 5 Days on 2 Days off

Hours: Full-time 40 Hours

Pay: $640 - $800 - $1120/ month ($5/hr - $7/hr) USD



About Us

We are a modern media and marketing company that places sleek, entertaining screens directly on bar counters. Our business gives bars and restaurants a free digital marketing channel to replace old-fashioned paper table tents. At the same time, we offer brands a premium, high-visibility way to connect directly with customers while they socialize. Our mission is to upgrade the bar experience for venues, advertisers, and patrons through engaging counter-top media. 



Our founder and CEO built BarTopTV from the ground up. As our network expands rapidly, we need a dedicated partner to take over critical operational tasks: keeping our devices online and opening doors for new venue partnerships. We believe in clear communication, taking ownership of tasks, and rewarding team members who take initiative.



Accountability 

*Success in this role is measured by clear, simple numbers:

*Network Uptime: Elevate and maintain active screen uptime from 80% to 95%+ across all assigned venues.

*Troubleshooting Resolution Rate: Resolve at least 85% of offline screen tickets on the first phone call (plugged back in or Wi-Fi reconnected).

*Call Volume & Execution: Complete 40–60 targeted outbound calls daily during venue "dead hours" (2:00 PM – 5:30 PM venue local time).

*Owner Transfers & Bookings: Successfully transfer 10+ live calls per week with venue owners to the CEO.

*Data Accuracy: Maintain 100% updated records in our internal dashboard and call logs before signing off each shift.



Tasks 

*Monitor the Network Dashboard: Check our custom, web-based management portal at the start of each shift to identify offline units, Wi-Fi drops, and disconnected screens.

*Conduct Friendly Tech Support Calls: Call bars and restaurants during off-peak hours (between lunch and dinner rushes). *Politely engage staff (bartenders, managers, barbacks), gain their buy-in, and guide them step-by-step through basic physical checks (verifying power plugs, cords, and Wi-Fi networks).

*Execute Outbound Owner Outreach: Place short, professional phone calls to prospective bar and restaurant owners using our provided contact list.

*Finesse Gatekeepers & Transfer Calls: Speak with front-of-house staff with confidence and warmth; if the owner is available, execute a live transfer to the CEO. If not, log the owner's typical schedule and schedule a prompt follow-up.

*Maintain Accurate Records: Update contact info, Wi-Fi credentials, manager names, gatekeeper notes, and call outcomes immediately in our tracking sheets and CRM.

*Daily Sync with the CEO: Send a concise end-of-day wrap-up report summarizing uptime percentage, calls made, tickets resolved, and owner calls transferred.



Expectations 

*Clear, Neutral English Communication: Exceptional verbal English skills with a neutral, confident accent. You can command attention politely over noisy bar backgrounds and win buy-in from busy hospitality staff.

*Phone Confidence & Resilience: Comfortable dialing outbound and navigating gatekeepers without being discouraged by quick answers or hang-ups.

*Attention to Detail is a must have the [Secret Code = BAR1126]

*Basic Technical Aptitude: Ability to walk a non-technical person through basic hardware troubleshooting (e.g., checking power bricks, power cords, and updating Wi-Fi passwords).

*Hospitality / Customer Service Awareness: Familiarity with the rhythm of bars and restaurants (understanding that they are busy).

*Home Office Setup: High-speed, stable internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps), a dedicated noise-canceling USB headset, a modern computer/laptop, and a quiet, interruption-free workspace.

*Industry Tools & Apps Used:

Custom Web App / Network Dashboard

VoIP / Phone System (e.g., OpenPhone or similar)

Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar)

Slack / Communication tools

title: Bookkeeper - Australia
description:
Evisory is a Brisbane-based accounting and advisory firm built for the hospitality industry. Our clients are cafés, restaurants, bars and venues – businesses where margins are tight and things move quickly if owners aren’t on top of their numbers.

We’re in our clients’ files every day, so their books are always current and they can make decisions on real numbers. Bookkeeping is the backbone of everything we do.



We’re looking for a Bookkeeper to look after the day-to-day books for a portfolio of hospitality clients. You’ll keep files reconciled and up to date, run payroll, prepare BAS/IAS for review, and be a friendly, reliable point of contact for clients’ questions. You’ll work alongside our accountants and report to the Director.



What you’ll do

▪ Reconcile bank, credit card and clearing accounts in Xero daily, keeping client files current

▪ Process supplier bills, receipts and sales data, including POS and delivery platform reconciliations

▪ Run weekly and fortnightly payroll, including STP, super and leave, with award-based wages

▪ Prepare BAS/IAS and payroll reconciliations for accountant review

▪ Keep client queries organised and send them out on a regular weekly cycle

▪ Help clean up and catch up files for new clients

▪ Flag anything unusual in the numbers to the accounting team early



What you’ll bring

▪ 5 years’ bookkeeping experience, ideally in an accounting practice

▪ Strong Xero skills, including bank feeds, reconciliations and payroll

▪ Working knowledge of GST, BAS and payroll compliance (STP, super, PAYG withholding)

▪ Great attention to detail and the ability to manage several client files at once

▪ Clear, friendly communication with business owners

▪ Highly regarded: hospitality client experience, award interpretation (e.g. Hospitality Industry General Award), POS and rostering integrations, e.g. Square, Lightspeed, Deputy.

title: Short-form Video Editor (CapCut) - Football Top 5 Countdown Shorts
description:
Pay: $4 USD per approved video. Up to 5 videos a day once you're up to speed (we start at 1 a day).

Time per video: about 1 hour 30 at first, 45 min to 1 hour once you know the style.

Flexible hours, but videos go out every day, 7 days a week.



The job

Each video is a 70-85 second countdown of 5 players: a cut-out of the player on a black background, the list title, then the real match clip of every moment the narrator describes, with captions. You get the voiceover, the captions file (SRT) and a one-page PDF brief for every video, plus a short video guide that shows the whole edit step by step.



What you'll do

- Lay the voiceover first and trim every silence (never cut a word)

- Find the official HD match clip for every line, so the screen always shows what the narrator says

- Crop and keyframe each clip so the player fills the vertical frame (no black bars)

- Add captions and the intro title in our style (white serif, black stroke)

- Watch your edit back start to finish and run the self-check before you send

- Upload to the shared Drive folder and log it in your tracker the same day



What you need

- You've edited short-form videos (TikTok / Reels / Shorts) before: show us examples

- CapCut (desktop) and solid keyframing

- You can find and download HD sports highlights quickly

- You take notes once and don't repeat the same mistake

- Reliable internet and you can deliver every day, 7 days a week



Nice to have

- You follow football and know the players

- Experience with sports or countdown edits



How the trial works

1. Shortlisted applicants get one sample video to edit, due within 48 hours.

2. The best two get a paid one-week trial: 7 videos, one a day, $4 per approved video.

3. The best editor keeps the account, with steady daily work and room to grow into a lead role.



You don't need to be an expert. You need to follow the system, take every note and watch your work back.



How to apply

Send a message with DOMINANT at the top, a link to 2-3 short-form videos you've edited, and two or three lines on why you'd be a good fit. Applications without the keyword or a portfolio aren't read.

title: Research assistant – US Government Contracting
description:
Research assistant – US Government Contracting:  

1. Find senior finance and legal professionals in U.S. government contracting from public sources only, to a written criteria sheet.  

a. You never call,
, or contact any candidate for any reason.  

2. Deliver the professionals research data in an MS Excel file.  

a. One row per person.  Sorted by grade, A’s on top.  One line of evidence per score.  No evidence, mark it as a question mark (?).  

3. Fluent in English.   Available to begin Monday, November 16, 2026.  

4. Proficiency required in the following software platforms:  LinkedIn, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word,
 and zoom.  

5. Familiarity with the GoHighLevel CRM a plus.  

a. Data entry into CRM will be required once the research phase is running.  

6. This is a test-first engagement.  No test submission, no hire.  

a. The first activity is to find 10 CFO names off a one-page CFO criteria sheet, delivered in Excel as stated above.   Due Friday end of day.  

b. Ultimately, will want 50 quality sets of names per workday.



CFO Search Criteria

1.	CPA, active.  

     a.	Provide license number and status where the state board shows it.  

          i.	google search “cpaverify” for status.

2.	Big-4 accounting experience.   

     a.	Work experience at one of PricewaterhouseCoopers, Ernst & Young, KPMG or Deloitte.

     b.	Prefer to have the people have worked in the areas of 

          i.	Audit, with government contractor clients.  (DCAA, FAR, CAS).  

          ii.	Transaction services:  financial due diligence and quality of earnings (QoE).  Deal advisory, transaction services, FDD.

          iii.	Government contracts advisory for contractors.  CAS compliance, DCAA readiness, incurred cost submissions, indirect rate structures, contractor accounting system reviews.  

          iv.	Post merger integration.  Folding a bought company’s finance function into yours.  

     c.	Prefer to NOT have the people have their experience in the areas of 

          i.	Tax, any sort of tax.  Corporate, international, transfer pricing, state and local, private client.  

          ii.	Public sector work where the agency is the client.  

          iii.	Audit in industries with no GovCon tie.  Banks, retail, hospitals, insurance.  

          iv.	Management, strategy and technology consulting.  ERP rollouts, operations, human capital, org design.  

          v.	Actuarial, pensions, sustainability and ESG assurance.  

3.	GovCon, contractor side.

     a.	CFO or controller at a government contractor.   DCAA, indirect rates.  

4.	M&A (mergers and acquisition) or DEALS, buy-side preferred.

     a.	Sell-side counts.  Diligence and integration count.  

5.	Available.

     a.	Retired, fractional, or between seats.  Not buried in a full-time job with a conflict.  



Search for the above five criteria.  For each of the 5 criteria, if the requirement is met give it a “1.”   If the criteria are NOT met, give it a “0.”  If you can’t tell or don’t know, put a “?.”  

The sum of the scores is the rank.   If CPA = 1, BIG4 = 1, GovCon = 0, DEALS = 1, Available=?  

The sum for this person would be 1+1+0+1+?= 3+.  



Any question marks that are on a sum that is 2 or higher, I will accept and ask about on the call that I have with this person.   There are no fractional scores.  A person either has a trait (1), they don’t (0) or you don’t know or can’t tell (?).  



The sum of the scores is the rank.  A = 5, B = 4, C = 3, D = 2, F = 1, Z = 0.

title: Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist — E-Commerce — $6/hour
description:
We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company selling consumer products across multiple countries.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, and communicative Chargeback & Payment Dispute Specialist to take ownership of our payment disputes and chargebacks.



This role is especially suited for someone who is excellent at:



Following clear SOPs consistently every single day.

Staying organized even when handling many cases at once.

Keeping accurate records and documentation.

Communicating clearly with other team members.

Following up when something is missing.

Managing deadlines without needing reminders.

Paying attention to small details.

Taking responsibility for their work.



We already have clear systems and SOPs in place.



We are not looking for someone who ignores processes, skips steps, forgets to update cases, or waits until the last minute.



We want someone who can take a clear SOP, follow it accurately, communicate when something is unclear, and make sure every task is completed properly.



Your main responsibility will be to fight chargebacks, collect and submit strong evidence, communicate with our Customer Support team, track deadlines, and make sure no dispute is lost because of poor preparation, poor communication, or missed deadlines.



What Success Looks Like in This Role



A successful person in this role:



Checks every required platform every working day.

Follows our SOPs without skipping steps.

Keeps every chargeback properly documented.

Always knows which cases are urgent.

Communicates immediately when something is missing.

Follows up with Customer Support instead of waiting.

Updates statuses so the rest of the team knows what is happening.

Completes evidence before deadlines.

Double-checks their work before submitting.

Asks questions when something is unclear rather than guessing.

Takes ownership of problems until they are resolved.



Communication and organization are extremely important in this position.



If you notice a problem, we expect you to communicate it.



If you are waiting for information, we expect you to follow up.



If you cannot complete something, we expect you to explain why.



We never want issues to be ignored or left unresolved without communication.



1. Daily Chargeback Monitoring



You will monitor payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers we use



Your responsibilities include:



Check all payment platforms every working day.

Identify all new disputes.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record the dispute reason.

Record the dispute amount.

Record the evidence deadline.

Keep the status of every dispute updated.

Follow our chargeback SOP for every case.

Prioritize disputes based on deadlines.

Follow up on open disputes.

Track whether disputes are won or lost.

Communicate immediately if there is an issue you cannot solve.



No chargeback should ever be lost because someone forgot about it, skipped a step, failed to communicate, or missed a deadline.



2. Prepare & Submit Chargeback Evidence



You will prepare strong evidence for each dispute.



Depending on the dispute, evidence may include:



Order information

Customer information

Billing and shipping information

Tracking information

Proof of delivery

Shipping confirmation

Customer communication

Customer Support conversations

Refund history

Store policies

Refund policies

Shipping policies

Terms & Conditions

Screenshots

Product information

Other supporting evidence relevant to the case



You will be given clear SOPs explaining how different chargeback types should be handled.



We expect you to follow those SOPs carefully.



At the same time, you must understand the case you are working on.



Do not blindly copy and paste evidence.



Read the information.



Understand what the customer is claiming.



Make sure the evidence actually supports our case.



Double-check everything before submitting.



3. Communicate With the Customer Support Team



Communication with our Customer Support team is a very important part of this role.



You may need Customer Support to:



Contact a customer.

Send you missing information.

Explain what happened in a case.

Resolve a customer issue.

Ask a customer to collect their package.

Ask a customer to close a dispute after their issue has been resolved.

Provide screenshots or previous conversations.

Confirm whether a refund or reshipment was issued.



We expect you to communicate clearly and professionally.



Do not simply send a message and forget about it.



If you are waiting for information, follow up.



If something is urgent, make that clear.



If a deadline is approaching, communicate it.



If Customer Support has made a mistake that affects a chargeback, report it clearly so it can be corrected.



Good communication is one of the most important skills for this role.



4. Investigate Every Chargeback



Before submitting evidence, you should understand the full situation.



You should review:



The entire customer conversation.

Order history.

Tracking history.

Delivery status.

Previous refunds or reshipments.

Customer claims.

Internal notes.

Relevant company policies.



Do not make assumptions.



Do not skip information because you are in a hurry.



Follow the investigation process in our SOP and make sure you understand what happened before making a decision.



5. Deadline Management



You will often handle many disputes at the same time.



Being organized is therefore extremely important.



You will be responsible for:



Recording every deadline correctly.

Keeping an organized list of open cases.

Prioritizing urgent disputes.

Preparing evidence early.

Following up when information is missing.

Escalating problems before they become urgent.

Making sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should never need management to remind you that a chargeback deadline is approaching.



Managing your workload and deadlines is your responsibility.



6. Documentation & Organization



Every chargeback must be properly documented.



We expect you to keep clear records showing:



What happened.

What the customer claimed.

What evidence was collected.

What actions were taken.

Whether Customer Support was contacted.

What information is still missing.

When evidence was submitted.

The final dispute outcome.



Another team member should be able to open your documentation and immediately understand the status of the case.



If your work is not documented, it is considered incomplete.



7. Track Chargeback Results



You will track dispute outcomes and help us understand why we win or lose cases.



You should track things such as:



Chargeback reason.

Payment provider.

Amount.

Evidence submitted.

Outcome.

Win rate.

Reasons for losses when identifiable.



If you notice repeated problems, communicate them to management.



For example:



Customers frequently dispute delayed packages.

A specific shipping method creates many disputes.

Customer Support is handling a situation incorrectly.

Certain evidence is missing repeatedly.

We are repeatedly losing one specific type of dispute.



We want someone who notices patterns and communicates them clearly.



8. Improve Our Chargeback Process



Our SOPs are important, but they should also improve over time.



If you notice:



A repeated mistake.

An unclear SOP.

A missing step.

A better evidence structure.

A recurring communication problem.

A process that is causing unnecessary chargebacks.



You should report it.



We want someone who can follow systems extremely well while also helping us improve them.



Daily Responsibilities



Every working day you should:



Check all payment processors.

Identify new disputes.

Log all new chargebacks.

Review upcoming deadlines.

Work through active cases.

Follow the correct SOP for every dispute.

Collect missing evidence.

Communicate with Customer Support when necessary.

Follow up on unanswered requests.

Submit completed evidence.

Double-check submissions.

Update dispute statuses.

Track wins and losses.

Report urgent issues.

Make sure there are no forgotten cases.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



CHARGEBACK SPECIALIST



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



What We Are Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely Organized



You should be comfortable handling many active cases without losing track of deadlines, follow-ups, or missing information.



Excellent at Following SOPs



We have clear processes for how work should be completed.



We need someone who can follow instructions consistently every day.



Not just during the first week.



Not only when someone is checking.



Every single day.



You should not skip steps because you believe they are unnecessary.



If an SOP is unclear, communicate with us instead of guessing.



Strong Communication



You will communicate regularly with Customer Support and management.



We expect you to:



Respond clearly.

Ask questions when necessary.

Follow up.

Communicate problems early.

Explain what you need from another team member.

Keep people updated on important cases.



Ignoring a problem is never acceptable.



Reliable



If you are responsible for something, we expect it to get done.



We should not need to repeatedly remind you about your responsibilities.



Detail-Oriented



Small mistakes in chargebacks can cost the company money.



You must be comfortable checking details carefully and reviewing your work before submission.



Proactive



If something is missing, investigate it.



If someone has not responded, follow up.



If a deadline is approaching, act early.



If you notice a repeated problem, report it.



Do not wait until someone tells you what to do.



Experience



Previous experience handling chargebacks or payment disputes is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Shopify

Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Gorgias

Gmail

Slack

Google Sheets

Excel

WhatsApp

Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Following SOPs correctly.

No missed chargeback deadlines.

Accuracy of evidence submissions.

Quality of evidence.

Organization.

Documentation quality.

Communication with Customer Support.

Following up properly.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Ability to manage many cases at once.

Chargeback win rate.

Ability to identify and communicate repeated problems.



We care heavily about consistency.



Doing a good job one day and becoming disorganized the next week is not enough.



We are looking for someone who can maintain the same high standard every working day.



Salary



$6 USD/hour



Full-time position: approximately 40 hours per week.



There is potential for increased responsibility, performance bonuses, and salary growth for someone who consistently performs at a high level.



How to Apply



Please include:



Tell us about yourself.

Describe your previous chargeback or payment dispute experience.

Which payment processors have you handled disputes with?

Have you used Shopify before?

Have you worked with PayPal disputes?

Approximately how many chargebacks have you handled?

How do you organize multiple cases and deadlines?

Give an example of a job where you had to follow detailed SOPs every day.

What would you do if an SOP was unclear?

What would you do if you needed information from another employee and they did not respond?

What evidence would you use for a "Product Not Received" dispute?

What evidence would you use for a "Fraudulent Transaction" dispute?

Which software platforms have you used?

When can you start?



Please also record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.



Interview Questions

Question 1



You have 30 active chargebacks across four different payment providers.



Five deadlines are within the next three days.



Explain exactly how you would organize your work.



Question 2



Our SOP says that before submitting a "Product Not Received" chargeback, you must review tracking, the entire customer conversation, and any previous refunds.



You are very busy and tracking already shows "Delivered."



Would you still complete the other steps?



Explain why.



Question 3



You need information from a Customer Support agent to complete evidence.



You message them, but they have not responded after several hours and the evidence deadline is tomorrow.



What would you do?



Question 4



A customer opens a chargeback claiming that they never received their order.



Tracking shows that the order was delivered.



Walk us through exactly what you would investigate and what evidence you would submit.



Question 5



You realize you made a mistake on a case.



What would you do?



Question 6



You notice the same type of mistake happening repeatedly between the Customer Support team and chargeback team.



How would you handle it?



Final Note



We are looking for someone who is organized, reliable, communicative, detail-oriented, and excellent at following clear SOPs.



This is extremely important to us.



You will receive clear instructions and processes, but we need someone who can follow them consistently without needing to be reminded every day.



We want someone who communicates when something is wrong, follows up when something is missing, keeps their work organized, documents everything properly, meets every deadline, and takes responsibility for their tasks.



If this describes the way you work, we would like to hear from you.

title: Peek Pro Booking Setup Specialist (Contract, Ongoing Retainer)
description:
We run pink-minibus island tours in Bermuda and need a Peek Pro specialist to load our 2027 tour availability from a spreadsheet we provide, then keep it current on a small monthly retainer. You load dates, start times and capacity only. You will not change prices.



The work

• Load tour dates, start times and capacity from our spreadsheet (57 patterns, plus book-outs on 126 no-ship days)

• Send a short checkpoint report each day during setup, and check the next two weeks once a week afterwards

• Keep a short change log. One tour (Caves & Coastline) will be turned off in April, so expect that update.



You need

• Experience with Peek Pro or a similar booking engine (Fareharbor, Rezdy, Bokun)

• Basic spreadsheet skills

• Care with details, and replies within a day



Hours and pay

• One-time setup: about 25 to 50 hours over 1 to 2 weeks, flat $300 for the complete verified setup. A small paid trial batch comes first and counts toward the $300.

• Then about 1 to 2 hours a week

• Then a $65 monthly retainer for the weekly checks and schedule updates.



To apply

Put PINKBUS27 at the start of your subject line, then tell us in a few lines which booking software you have used. Applications without the code will not be read.

title: Google Ads Specialist
description:
On-target earnings are AUD 1,500 a month



About Castillo Marketing



Castillo Marketing is an Australian marketing agency that works only with painting businesses. We run Meta and Google ads, landing pages, CRM follow-up in GoHighLevel and video content for more than 30 clients, and our own sales team helps painters close the jobs our ads bring in.



You will own Google Ads for our clients, from the first account build to the leads that land in their calendar. 



That covers Search, Performance Max and Local Services Ads, conversion tracking into the CRM, and clear reporting on what each dollar of spend returns.



You report to our COO and work alongside our Meta media buyer, web developer and client success manager. This is a remote contractor role with Castillo Taylor Soloman Limited, trading as Castillo Marketing.

Responsibilities



• Build new accounts: keyword research by service and suburb, campaign structure, ad copy, assets and negative keyword lists, with location targeting matched to each client's real service area.



• Launch on time: new clients live within 7 working days of their client brief call.



• Track every lead: Google Ads conversion tags, GA4, form and call tracking feeding GoHighLevel, plus offline imports of booked quotes and won jobs.



• Optimise weekly: search terms, negatives, bids, budgets and ad copy tests, with landing page feedback passed to our web developer.



• Report: weekly spend and a monthly results summary for each client.



• Flag problems the same day: spend spikes, disapprovals, broken tracking or a sudden drop in leads.



Must have:



• At least 2 years managing Google Ads accounts for contractors and trades businesses, such as painters, builders, roofers, plumbers, electricians or landscapers.



• Results you can show: real accounts with spend, leads and cost per lead.



• Strong skills in Search campaigns, Performance Max and conversion tracking (Google Tag Manager, GA4, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports).



• Clear written English.



• Your own computer, reliable internet, and replies to the team within Melbourne business hours.



• Local Services Ads experience, ideally in Australia.



• GoHighLevel experience.



• Meta ads experience.

The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance.



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **



Claims Lodgements

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant



Documentation and Information Requests

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system



Claims Administration

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **



- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



You Must Have

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation)

- What We're Looking For

- Calm, mature, and professional phone manner.

- Strong reliability. Late starts, missed shifts, and no-shows directly affect client response times.

Nice to Have

- Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Notion, GoHighLevel, Slack, WhatsApp Business, Aircall, RingCentral, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in sensitive client conversations where confidentiality, trust, and clear communication are important. 



Available Shift Schedules

- We are currently hiring for the following shift C (Manila Time / PHT):



Shift C: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (PHT)



Candidates must be consistently available during the full assigned shift.



Compensation & Growth

Base salary: $800/month

Commission: 3%–5% on closed deals, depending on monthly performance and collected revenue.

Additional performance incentives may include client review bonuses and other performance-based rewards.

Top performers may be promoted to Senior Client Advisor / Team Lead, with a base salary increase and additional training responsibilities.

Employee Benefits

Monthly base salary + tiered commission.

$10 bonus per verified customer review.

$300 retention bonus every 3 months of tenure.

13th month pay: 1× base salary, paid by December 20, soft-conditional on hitting average commission performance.

7 days paid annual leave per year.

2× pay for work on Philippine regular public holidays.

Guaranteed weekly rest day

Application review.

Resume/CV and voice recording review.

Written screening assessment.

Live interview with scenario-based questions.

Offer, NDA, agreement, and onboarding.

Your recording should include:

title: Short Term Rental Guest Services Coordinator
description:
Short Term Rental or Hotel Experience is Required



We are an expanding company and we are hiring another Guest Services Coordinator!



If you have applied for one of our roles in the past, but didn't get an interview, please feel free to apply again; we are looking for talented people that can be trained. We are taking a closer look at the following qualities--work ethic, long term commitment.



We are also looking extra closely at someone that has any or all of these abilities:

Administrative--this person doesn't forget deadlines, and can help keep the whole team working efficiently because you are reminding them of deadlines, taking notes in meetings, and creating and filing documents including new SOP's that are created weekly in this rapidly changing industry

Communication--this person has excellent English writing and speaking skills

Customer Service--this person can connect with customers and can motivate them to leave five star reviews



When applying, be sure to mention the type of experience you have in the subject heading. You must use one of the following titles in the subject heading of your application message to be considered for this position--either "STR Experience" if you worked for a company that manages short term rentals, "Airbnb Experience" if you worked for the Website Company called Airbnb, or "Both STR and Airbnb Experience" if you have both work experiences. A fourth category is if you have no experience in either Airbnb or STR, but you do have Hotel Experience, in which case you would put "Hotel Experience." Hotel Experience can be preferred if you truly know how to give a guest 5-star service.



Interviews start soon. We are seeking a reliable and organized Guest Services Coordinator to assist with guest inquiries, schedule maintenance tasks, and collaborate with our housekeeping team to ensure a seamless guest experience; for our short term rental property management company that services approximately 35 listings.



We are looking for someone who can work exclusively with our team, rather than juggling multiple clients at the same time. Employees are expected to share their screen during their work shift. We realize this is out of the question for some, and that is the very reason we have that as a requirement. The persons that have a problem with this are the ones we need to screen for. If you have a problem with this, please save you and us both the time and not apply.



The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving. If you thrive in a demanding, fast-paced environment and are passionate about hospitality, we want to hear from you! Management potential/training/advancement and long term opportunity for the right individual. Interview schedule will be during the day during Central Time in the US, as will your work shift if you are hired. In your response confirm that you understand the time zone and your ability to work during those hours; please let us know whether or not you have experience working that shift, or that this will be the first time. The time shift is 8 AM - 4 or 5 PM Central Time, five to five and a half days per week, with the half day probably a weekend day. The most flexible candidates go to the front of the line.



US is on Daylight Savings Time currently.



Please follow all of the instructions in above mentioned posting for your application to be considered. We will only respond to those candidates that take the time to apply and follow the instructions because they truly see a potential fit with us. In the interview process you will have the opportunity to meet and speak with the person we hired in 2025, over one year ago, that answered this same job posting, who has since been promoted to Management.



Lastly, in your response,

Please rate yourself on a scale of 1-10, with 10 being the highest, on the following:

1. Basic Math skills (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentages, use of calculator)

2. Organization skills

3. Administration skills

4. Communication



Please provide a BRIEF overview/outline of your job experience including the following information for each job held:

1. job title, name of company

2. dates of employment

3. reason for leaving

4. starting pay and ending pay

(Please DO NOT send a description of what you did, responsibilities, when I need that I can refer to your resume; I can rely strictly on the job title for the first phase of pre-qualification)



In addition, you may also provide a link to your resume, but it doesn't replace the need for above requested information. We just need a very brief, easy to read outline of your experience. We are mostly concerned with jobs you have had for at least one year. We don't need every job you have had for a month or a couple of months. If you have those, we can see those when we look at your resume. Thank you for your interest in working with us!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Virtual Operations & Administrative Assistant to support our daily business operations.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working with spreadsheets, managing multiple administrative tasks, communicating with employees, and supporting a fast-paced logistics business.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Employee Scheduling & Timecard Management**

- Assist with preparing and updating weekly driver schedules.

- Compare employee schedules against timecard reports to identify missing punches and discrepancies.

- Monitor employee attendance, call-outs, and scheduling changes.

- Track overtime, hours worked, and potential scheduling compliance issues.

- Prepare weekly payroll and attendance reports for management review.



**2. Recruiting & Human Resources Support**

- Review job applications and screen potential delivery driver candidates.

- Communicate with applicants and coordinate interviews.

- Assist with onboarding paperwork and new-hire tracking.

- Maintain accurate employee records and documentation.

- Track employee training, certifications, and onboarding progress.

- Assist with employee communications, announcements, and follow-ups.



**3. Fleet Management & Maintenance Coordination**

- Maintain vehicle maintenance and repair tracking spreadsheets.

- Monitor scheduled maintenance, vehicle inspections, and repair status.

- Communicate with repair shops, fleet vendors, and maintenance providers.

- Track vehicle downtime and follow up on outstanding repairs.

- Organize maintenance invoices, service records, and fleet documentation.



**4. Operations & Reporting**

- Prepare daily and weekly operational performance reports.

- Assist with tracking driver performance.

- Maintain spreadsheets and dashboards for key operational indicators.

- Monitor administrative deadlines and follow up on outstanding tasks.

- Organize operational documents and records.

- Identify discrepancies and bring operational concerns to management's attention.



**5. General Administrative Support**

- Monitor and organize business
s.

- Respond to routine employee and vendor inquiries.

- Schedule meetings, appointments, and follow-ups.

- Maintain digital filing systems and shared documents.

- Assist management with special projects and other administrative duties.



## Qualifications



**Required:**

- Previous experience as a virtual assistant, administrative assistant, or operations coordinator.

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.

- Ability to handle confidential employee and business information responsibly.



**Preferred:**

- Experience working with a logistics company.

- Familiarity with ADP or other payroll/timekeeping systems.

- Experience with recruiting, employee scheduling, or HR administration.

- Experience coordinating fleet maintenance.



## Working Hours



- Must be available during agreed-upon U.S. Central Time business hours.

- Schedule and weekly hours will be determined based on business needs.

- Some flexibility may be required during peak delivery seasons.



## What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Proactive:** Identifies issues and follows up without constant reminders.

- **Detail-oriented:** Can accurately review timecards, schedules, and spreadsheets.

- **Organized:** Keeps track of multiple tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities.

- **Dependable:** Completes assignments on time and communicates consistently.

- **Tech-savvy:** Comfortable learning new software and using digital tools.

- **Resourceful:** Can solve routine problems independently and escalate important issues.

Compensation: 25,000 PHP base salary + monthly performance bonuses. Strong performers realistically earn 35,000 to 40,000+ PHP / month based on booked, qualified partner calls and active referrals.



ABOUT US

We are an established sports placement and career development platform run by active professional athletes and industry specialists. We assist top talent in securing trials, contracts, and roster spots internationally through an extensive global network of club decision-makers, scouts, and sporting directors across [Redacted] countries.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a sharp, proactive B2B Partnerships Specialist to help build, nurture, and scale our international referral network. Our target partners include independent 1-on-1 performance trainers, private high-performance academies, elite showcase operators, and regional talent media pages.

You will own top-of-funnel operations: researching target partners, executing structured multi-channel outreach, qualifying prospective partners, and booking high-intent alignment calls directly onto executive calendar schedules. NICE TO HAVE

Direct hands-on experience navigating GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows, pipelines, and contact management.

title: AI Automation Expert + Executive Assistant | US Wellness Company | Growth to Full-Time
description:
WE'RE HIRING: AI Operations & Automation Manager



Remote | Philippines | $7 USD/hour | 20 Hours/Week | Long-Term Opportunity



We're looking for someone who doesn't just use AI. They know how to build with it.



Have you built AI agents, created dashboards, or automated business processes that actually save time?



Are you exceptionally detail-oriented, organized, and reliable?



Do you love finding ways to make businesses run more efficiently?



Generation Wellness is looking for an experienced AI Operations & Automation Manager who combines advanced AI expertise with exceptional attention to detail.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position. We're looking for someone who can independently build and maintain AI-powered systems while managing important daily business operations.



You must already be proficient in Claude AI, ChatGPT, and ChatGPT Work. We are not looking to train someone in AI fundamentals.



About Generation Wellness



Generation Wellness is a US-based education consulting company helping schools improve student behavior, engagement, and well-being through practical, neuroscience-based tools.



For more than 13 years, we've equipped educators with strategies to regulate, connect, and reflect.



We've reached more than 750 schools, districts, and universities and impacted over 500,000 educators, students, and families.



We're a small, mission-driven company looking for someone who can help us expand our impact through smarter systems, better organization, and AI-powered operations.



Your Primary Responsibilities



1. AI Systems & Automation



- Build and maintain AI agents and workflows using Claude and ChatGPT.

- Use ChatGPT Work to carry out multi-step business workflows, research, analysis, and operational tasks.

- Create and manage our centralized Notion business dashboard.

- Develop AI systems supporting executive operations, sales, finance reporting, marketing, administration, and customer service.

- Connect AI with existing business applications using appropriate integrations, APIs, or automation solutions.

- Test AI workflows, troubleshoot errors, and continuously improve reliability.

- Create documentation and SOPs for AI agents and business processes.

- Establish appropriate human approval checkpoints for sensitive actions.

- Identify repetitive work that can be automated to save time.



2. Lead Management & Sales Operations



- Monitor leads from LinkedIn, Instagram,
, Help Scout, and HoneyBook.

- Track qualified leads, proposals, bookings, and follow-ups.

- Draft personalized outreach and follow-up messages.

- Connect with previous Generation Wellness training participants on LinkedIn.

- Maintain an organized sales pipeline and identify opportunities requiring attention.

- Ensure qualified leads do not fall through the cracks.



3. Administrative & Executive Support



- Manage customer inquiries and
 communications.

- Coordinate calendars, meetings, training events, and reminders.

- Review call recordings, prepare summaries, and track action items.

- Draft proposals, invoices, contracts, and other client documents.

- Organize projects, records, and documentation in Notion.

- Maintain and improve SOPs.

- Prepare daily executive briefings highlighting priorities, opportunities, and outstanding decisions.

- Complete administrative tasks accurately and on schedule.



4. Marketing & Digital Operations



- Schedule and publish approved LinkedIn and Instagram content.

- Support Kajabi
 campaigns, website updates, landing pages, and digital products.

- Create simple branded graphics in Canva.

- Organize videos and resources in Vimeo.

- Track basic marketing performance and lead conversions.

- Identify opportunities to streamline marketing processes using AI.



Our Five Core Platforms



These are the five platforms most important to this position:



1. **Notion:** Business organization, projects, SOPs, dashboards, and information management.

2. **Kajabi:** Website,
 marketing, digital products, online courses, and customer management.

3. **Help Scout:** Customer support, inbox management, and communications.

4. **Claude AI:** AI agents, analysis, automation, and business workflows.

5. **ChatGPT & ChatGPT Work:** Advanced AI assistance, research, multi-step workflows, connected tools, and business operations.



We also use Google Workspace, HoneyBook, Canva, Vimeo, LinkedIn, Instagram, Zoom, Loom, and Voxer.



Advanced proficiency in Claude, ChatGPT, and ChatGPT Work is required. Experience with Notion, Kajabi, and Help Scout is strongly preferred.



We value people who can independently learn new systems and find reliable ways to connect the tools we already use.



Required Qualifications



Advanced AI & Technical Skills



- Demonstrated experience building functional AI agents and automated workflows.

- Advanced proficiency in Claude AI and ChatGPT.

- Hands-on experience with ChatGPT Work, including multi-step workflows.

- Experience creating dashboards and organized business systems.

- Understanding of AI integrations, workflow testing, and troubleshooting.

- Ability to independently solve technical problems.

- Experience documenting and maintaining automated processes.

- Ability to demonstrate real AI systems you personally built.



Professional & Administrative Skills



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Experience with administrative operations or executive support.

- Professional customer service skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

- Strong Google Workspace skills.

- Reliable internet connection and remote work environment.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively.



Attention to Detail Is Nonnegotiable



We're looking for someone who notices the small things that others miss.



You must be able to follow detailed instructions, identify inconsistencies, catch errors, and deliver accurate work without constant supervision.



Our hiring process includes a rigorous, multi-stage skills assessment designed to evaluate:



- Attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely.

- Advanced Claude, ChatGPT, and ChatGPT Work expertise.

- Ability to build and troubleshoot AI-powered workflows.

- Written communication and organizational skills.

- Critical thinking, problem-solving, and independent judgment.

- Accuracy when completing realistic administrative tasks.



Candidates will complete structured screening questions, detail-oriented exercises, and a practical AI skills assessment. Finalists may also be asked to demonstrate their work live.



We evaluate actual performance, not just resumes or self-reported skills.



Who Will Thrive in This Role?



You're someone who:



- Loves building useful AI systems.

- Takes ownership and follows through.

- Is highly organized, punctual, and dependable.

- Reads instructions carefully and catches mistakes.

- Finds solutions instead of waiting for directions.

- Can move comfortably between technical projects and daily administrative responsibilities.

- Communicates clearly and welcomes feedback.

- Wants to grow with a purpose-driven company for the long term.



This position is not a fit for someone whose AI experience is limited to using chatbots for writing or answering questions.



Your First 90 Days



Days 1–30: Learn our business, organize our Notion workspace, identify automation opportunities, and build an initial AI workflow.



Days 31–60: Improve lead tracking, inbox workflows, executive reporting, and AI-powered operations.



Days 61–90: Expand reliable automations, improve reporting, document systems, and demonstrate measurable time savings.



Success is measured by the reliability of your systems, the accuracy of your work, and the improvements you make to our business.



Position Details



- Location: Remote, Philippines

- Pay: $7 USD/hour

- Payment: Every Friday via Wise

- Hours: 20 hours per week

- US Schedule: Monday–Friday, 2:00–6:00 PM Pacific Standard Time

- Philippines Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday, 6:00–10:00 AM Philippine Time

- Availability: Must work the full scheduled shift

- Opportunity: Long-term position with potential for full-time hours

- Reports To: Founder & CEO, Generation Wellness



How to Apply



We have a detailed application process because accuracy, technical expertise, and follow-through are essential to this role.



To be considered:



1. Complete our online application form.

2. Answer all required questions and complete the attention-to-detail exercises.

3. Provide evidence of an AI system you have personally built.

4. Be prepared to complete a paid practical skills assessment if selected.



Apply here: 



Please submit your application through the Google Form only. Do not
 or send an OnlineJobs message.



Incomplete applications or submissions that do not follow instructions may not be considered.



Why Join Generation Wellness?



You'll work directly with our founder to help build an AI-powered business that serves educators and schools.



You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, create innovative systems, and help a growing company operate more efficiently.



Most of our team stays with us for years because we are kind, give yearly raises, and bonuses.



If you're an experienced AI builder who is also exceptionally detailed, reliable, and proactive, we'd love to see your application.

title: Car rental Operations, Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Business Support
description:
Job Description: Virtual Assistant – Car Rental Operations, Digital Marketing, Video Editing& Business Support 



(immediate raise after 90 days when value, responsibilities and market data clearly outpaces your current compensation. Acquiring new skills, increased responsibility, loyalty and continuous good performance as a company and as well as an individual will also be well compensated)



About the Company



We are looking for talented, professional, and motivated individuals who are ready to grow alongside one of the fastest-growing car rental companies in Central Florida.



At our company, we value transparent communication, continuous learning, accountability, efficiency, and maintaining a healthy work-life balance.



We are seeking a versatile Virtual Assistant who can manage multiple responsibilities, assist with daily car rental operations, oversee digital marketing activities, and provide administrative and creative support for other business ventures.



This position is ideal for someone who is organized, tech-savvy, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning new software and AI-powered tools.



Position Overview



The Virtual Assistant will play an important role in the company’s daily operations and continued growth.



Responsibilities will include managing digital advertising campaigns, generating and processing rental leads, assisting with existing customer accounts, maintaining rental records, coordinating vehicle maintenance, and providing customer support.



As you become more familiar with the company’s car rental operations, additional responsibilities will include managing social media content using AI tools (if needed), editing promotional videos, building websites, and also assisting with digital marketing strategies for other businesses as a lesser importance task to the car rental business. 



The ideal candidate must be able to manage multiple projects, complete assignments within established deadlines, communicate effectively, and maintain a structured weekly work agenda outlining tasks and priorities. 



1. Digital Marketing & Lead Generation



The Virtual Assistant will be responsible for helping generate new rental customers through digital advertising and online marketing strategies.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing and creating advertising campaigns through Meta Ads 
 and Instagram).

* Managing and creating Google Ads campaigns.

* Developing targeted advertising campaigns specifically designed to attract gig economy drivers, including Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, and other delivery or rideshare drivers.

* Creating advertisements that direct potential customers to the company’s website.

* Monitoring advertising performance, lead generation, and campaign effectiveness.

* Implementing SEO strategies to increase website traffic, improve search engine visibility, and attract qualified rental customers.

* Identifying opportunities to improve website conversions and turn visitors into profitable renters.

* Continuously researching and implementing new marketing strategies to increase company visibility and rental bookings.



2. Lead Management & Rental Applicant Processing



The Virtual Assistant will handle incoming rental inquiries and assist with processing potential customers before they become active renters.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitoring and reaching out to incoming rental leads.

* Conducting background checks using Intelius.

* Verifying driver’s licenses and reviewing applicant information.

* Contacting potential renters to confirm their desired rental start date and time.

* Following up with qualified leads to move them through the rental process.

* Entering new leads and customer information into the company’s CRM system, which operates similarly to GoHighLevel.

* Adding new customer conversions and updating their information within the company’s system.

* Maintaining accurate records of applicants, approved renters, and conversion activity.

* Providing timely communication and follow-ups to prospective customers.



3. Current Rental Management & Customer Support



The Virtual Assistant will assist with managing active rental accounts to ensure payments, rental agreements, vehicle compliance, and customer communication remain up to date.



Responsibilities include:



* Performing daily administrative tasks, data entry, and updates to existing rental accounts.

* Verifying weekly rental extensions at least two days before the next payment is due.

* Following up with customers regarding upcoming payments and overdue balances.

* Activating the vehicle kill switch when a payment remains unpaid 24 hours after its due date, in accordance with company procedures and applicable requirements.

* Sending weekly rental extension agreements to customers and ensuring electronic completion.

* Calculating and sending toll charges to customers at the end of each rental week.

* Monitoring vehicle usage to ensure renters remain within their permitted geographical operating areas.

* Providing customer support by answering incoming phone calls and text messages.

* Responding to customer questions, concerns, and rental-related issues in a professional and timely manner.

* Coordinating vehicle maintenance appointments with the company’s designated mobile mechanic.

* Keeping accurate records of rental activity, customer communication, payments, and vehicle maintenance and sending in a daily report at the end of the day.



4. Vehicle Administration & Business Systems



The Virtual Assistant will help maintain the company’s internal systems and ensure newly acquired vehicles are properly registered and organized across the necessary platforms.



Responsibilities include:



* Adding newly acquired vehicles to the company’s internal systems.

* Setting up and updating vehicle information within SunPass.

* Adding and managing vehicles through Connect Pro.

* Ensuring vehicle information is accurate and consistent across all applicable platforms.

* Entering expenses into the Profit Pro expense management system.

* Maintaining organized digital records for vehicle-related expenses and business transactions.



5. Social Media Management & Content Creation



Once the Virtual Assistant has developed a strong understanding of the company’s rental operations, additional responsibilities will include helping manage the company’s social media presence.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating engaging social media content using AI-powered tools.

* Developing promotional content for Instagram,
, and TikTok.

* Creating marketing materials to advertise available rental vehicles and company services.

* Using AI tools to assist with content creation, captions, promotional graphics, and marketing ideas.

* Helping maintain a consistent social media posting schedule.

* Identifying creative ways to increase engagement, brand awareness, and customer inquiries.



6. Additional Virtual Assistant Services for Other Businesses



In addition to supporting the car rental company, the Virtual Assistant may be assigned projects involving other businesses, clients, and business ventures.



These responsibilities will provide opportunities to develop additional technical, creative, and digital marketing skills.



Website Development & AI Automation



* Building professional websites using AI-powered website builders and automation tools.

* Managing website hosting and domain-related setup.

* Customizing websites to meet individual customer and business needs.

* Implementing website improvements designed to increase customer engagement and conversions.

* Incorporating AI automation tools to improve business efficiency and customer interactions.

* Implementing SEO strategies to improve website rankings and online visibility.

* Optimizing Google Business Profiles to improve local search visibility.

* Developing digital marketing strategies to help other businesses attract customers and grow their online presence.



Video Editing & Social Media Content



* Editing short-form promotional videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok for businesses

* Creating engaging video content for businesses and their services.

* Adding captions, transitions, graphics, and other professional editing elements.

* Repurposing existing video footage into marketing content.

* Assisting with social media marketing strategies and content development.



7. Qualifications & Desired Skills



We are looking for someone who possesses the following qualities:



* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.

* Ability to multitask and manage several responsibilities.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Comfortable communicating with customers professionally.

* Experience with digital marketing, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.

* Familiarity with SEO and website optimization.

* Experience with CRM platforms and data entry.

* Familiarity with AI tools and automation platforms.

* Basic video editing skills or willingness to learn.

* Ability to learn new software and business systems quickly.

* Problem-solving skills and the ability to take initiative.

* Dependability, accountability, and a strong work ethic.



Previous experience in car rental operations, customer service, digital marketing, or virtual assistance is a plus.



8. Work Expectations & Performance Standards



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities and understands the importance of completing tasks correctly and on time.



The following expectations will apply:



* Maintain a structured weekly work agenda outlining responsibilities, deadlines, and priorities.

* Complete assigned tasks within established timeframes.

* Provide consistent updates regarding completed assignments and outstanding tasks.

* Communicate proactively when issues arise or additional assistance is needed.

* Maintain accurate records and keep company systems updated.

* Respond to customer inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

* Follow established company procedures and protect confidential customer and business information.

* Be willing to learn new systems, technologies, and processes as the company grows.

* Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows and increase operational efficiency.

* Maintain professionalism, reliability, and accountability throughout the workweek.



9. Growth Opportunities



This is an opportunity to grow with a company that is expanding its operations and developing additional business ventures.



The position will offer exposure to several areas of business, including:



* Car rental management and operations.

* Digital advertising and lead generation.

* Customer relationship management.

* Social media marketing and content creation.

* AI-powered business automation.

* Website development and management.

* Search engine optimization.

* Digital marketing services for other businesses.



We value individuals who are eager to learn, take initiative, and grow alongside the company. As the business expands, there will be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and develop new professional skills.



Our Ideal Candidate



We are not simply looking for someone who wants to complete a few administrative tasks. We are looking for a dependable, motivated, and versatile individual who wants to become an important part of our company’s growth.



If you are organized, technology-driven, creative, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities while maintaining excellent communication, we encourage you to apply.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, contribute ideas, take initiative, and become a valuable long-term member of our team.

title: Customer Support Specialist (Nutrition/Dietetics)

Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, fatsecret is a leading digital health company helping millions of people around the world achieve their weight loss, nutrition, and wellness goals.



We're growing and looking for a Customer Support Specialist (Nutrition) to join our Marketing and Customer Engagement team. If you're a qualified dietitian or nutritionist who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.



This is a remote role open only to candidates currently based in Metro Manila or nearby provinces (including Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, Bulacan, and Pampanga). While the position is primarily work-from-home, team members are expected to attend occasional in-person team meetups and company events.



About the Role



As a Customer Support Specialist (Nutrition), you'll be the first point of contact for customers who need assistance using the fatsecret app and our programs.



You'll help users navigate app features, answer nutrition-related questions, troubleshoot issues, and provide guidance that supports their health and wellness journey. You'll also work closely with our Product, Dietetics, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to identify recurring issues, share customer insights, and improve the overall user experience.



This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong nutrition background with excellent customer service skills and enjoys working directly with users to solve problems.



What You'll Do



Customer Support

- Respond to customer inquiries via
 and support channels.

- Help customers understand and use app features, meal plans, food tracking tools, and nutrition programs.

- Investigate and troubleshoot user-reported issues.

- Provide accurate nutrition-related guidance within established support protocols.

- Escalate technical, product, or clinical concerns when appropriate.

- Maintain high standards for customer satisfaction and first-contact resolution.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Communicate customer feedback, trends, and recurring issues to relevant stakeholders.

- Help identify opportunities to improve the product and user experience.

- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Dietetics teams to resolve customer issues.



Knowledge Management

- Create and maintain FAQs, help articles, troubleshooting guides, and other support documentation.

- Identify common customer questions and propose improvements to existing resources.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes.



What We're Looking For



Required

- Degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, Nutrition Science, or a related field.
