title: Hiring: US IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) – Remote | $1,540/Month
description:
Hiring: US IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) – Remote | $1,540/Month



Company: Nationwide Tax Care

Website: 

Location: Remote – Philippines or India

Position: Full-Time, 40 Hours per Week

Salary: $1,540 USD per month

Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. Central Time business hours



About Us



Nationwide Tax Care is a U.S.-based tax resolution company with over 15 years of experience helping individuals and businesses resolve federal and state tax liabilities.



We are looking for an experienced IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) to join our tax resolution team remotely. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience dealing directly with the IRS, obtaining transcripts, resolving tax debts, and representing taxpayers before the IRS.



This is a long-term opportunity with a well-established American company.



Key Responsibilities



IRS Representation & Tax Resolution



* Represent clients before the IRS using Form 2848 (Power of Attorney).

* Contact the IRS Practitioner Priority Service (PPS) to discuss client accounts, collection holds, balances, and resolution options.

* Prepare and negotiate Offers in Compromise (OIC).

* Handle Currently Not Collectible (CNC) cases.

* Establish Installment Agreements, including streamlined and non-streamlined arrangements.

* Request penalty abatements and resolve IRS notices.

* Communicate with IRS Revenue Officers and other IRS representatives.



IRS Transcripts & Compliance



* Obtain IRS Account Transcripts and Wage & Income Transcripts through authorized IRS channels.

* Work with Forms 2848 and 8821.

* Identify unfiled tax returns and outstanding tax liabilities.

* Review IRS collection activity, liens, levies, and garnishments.

* Verify taxpayer compliance before submitting resolutions.



Tax Preparation & Documentation



* Assist with preparing delinquent federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, Schedule C, and business returns.

* Review financial statements, bank statements, pay stubs, and supporting documents.

* Prepare IRS financial disclosure forms, including Forms 433-A, 433-A(OIC), and 433-F.

* Maintain accurate client records, case notes, and task updates in our case management platform, LOGICS.



Required Qualifications



* Active IRS Enrolled Agent (EA) credential – strongly preferred.

* Active PTIN and experience working with IRS CAF authorizations.

* Experience calling IRS Practitioner Priority Service (PPS).

* Familiarity with IRS e-Services and Tax Pro Account.

* Proven experience with IRS tax resolution, especially OIC, CNC, and installment agreements.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Ability to work independently during U.S. business hours.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to handle confidential taxpayer information securely.



Candidates without an EA credential may be considered for non-representative support positions if they have substantial IRS transcript and tax resolution experience.



Compensation & Benefits



* Fixed salary: $1,540 USD per month

* Full-time remote employment, 40 hours per week.

* Long-term, stable opportunity.

* Training on our internal procedures and LOGICS case management platform.

* Opportunity for increased responsibilities based on performance.



How to Apply



Start your application with “EA-READY” and answer the following questions:



1. Are you currently an IRS Enrolled Agent? When did you obtain your license?

2. Do you have an active PTIN and CAF number or experience obtaining CAF authorizations?

3. How many years of IRS tax resolution experience do you have?

4. Have you personally handled Offers in Compromise, CNC cases, and IRS installment agreements?

5. Have you called IRS Practitioner Priority Service and obtained IRS transcripts?

6. Have you prepared Forms 433-A(OIC), 433-F, and 656?

7. Can you work Monday through Friday during U.S. Central Time business hours?

8. Are you comfortable with a fixed salary of $1,540 USD per month?



We are looking for an experienced professional who can independently manage IRS resolution cases, not someone who only prepares tax returns.

title: Google flow/Veo3 video editor   AI Video Generation
description:
AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT

Create health and wellness reels and UGC videos.



I run a fast-growing
 and Instagram health and wellness brand built around a consistent AI avatar, along with a growing network of additional social media pages.



I am looking for an **experienced AI video creator and editor** who can take a script and turn it into high-quality, realistic short-form content from start to finish.



**This is NOT a training role.**



You should already be comfortable working with the tools below and be able to start producing quality content with minimal hand-holding.



The three biggest things I care about are:



* **Following instructions exactly**

* **Making the videos look as realistic as possible**

* **Communicating clearly and consistently**



If I provide a reference video, avatar image, product image, editing example, or specific instructions, I expect those details to be followed closely.



## TOOLS YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW



### Veo 3 / Google Flow / Capcut



You should know how to:



* Generate high-quality, photorealistic AI videos from written prompts

* Create realistic human movement, expressions, gestures, and speech

* Maintain consistent characters between clips

* Create vertical short-form content ready for Instagram and

* Match the pacing, camera angles, movements, and overall feel of reference videos

* Troubleshoot poor generations and improve prompts without needing constant guidance



### Veo3 / Nano Banana



You should have strong experience with:



* Nano Banana 1

* Nano Banana 2

* Nano Banana Pro

* Veo3

* Google Flow image generation and video generation

*Capcut



You should understand when to use each model depending on the task.



You must be able to generate **hyper-realistic images** while maintaining:



* Consistent facial identity

* Accurate clothing

* Accurate products

* Realistic hands

* Realistic skin texture

* Natural lighting

* Correct proportions

* Consistent environments



The goal is for viewers to have difficulty immediately recognizing that the content is AI-generated.



### CapCut



You should be highly comfortable editing short-form vertical content in CapCut.



You should know how to:



* Match a reference video's editing style closely

* Add and style captions

* Match fonts, placement, sizing, and timing

* Sync music properly

* Remove dead space

* Create tight cuts

* Color correct footage

* Match pacing

* Add overlays and product comparisons

* Make AI-generated footage feel like natural creator content



If I send you a reference video, you should be able to study it and recreate the editing style without needing every small detail explained.



---



# DAILY WORKFLOW



You will receive a script along with any necessary instructions, reference videos, avatar images, product images, or inspiration.



From there, you handle the entire production process:



**Script → Image Generation → Video Generation → Voice → Editing → Finished Video**



This includes:



1. Generating the necessary images with Nano Banana/Higgsfield

2. Creating realistic clips using Veo 3, Flow, HeyGen, or Grok

3. Keeping the avatar consistent

4. Keeping the voice consistent

5. Creating realistic product shots

6. Editing everything together in CapCut

7. Adding captions, music, overlays, and pacing

8. Delivering a finished vertical video that is ready to post



You must be able to deliver a **minimum of 6 finished videos per day**, approximately **5–6 days per week**.



Once you understand the format and style, the workflow is designed to be fast and repeatable.



---



# REALISM IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



I do not want videos that look like polished AI commercials.



Most of the content should feel like a real person casually filming on an iPhone.



That means paying attention to small details such as:



* Natural facial expressions

* Realistic blinking

* Natural hand gestures

* Realistic product handling

* Correct fingers and hands

* Slight camera movement

* Natural body movement

* Realistic lighting

* Accurate product packaging

* Consistent environments

* Consistent avatar appearance

* Consistent voice

* Natural speech pacing



You should notice these problems yourself and fix them rather than waiting for me to point out every issue.



---



# FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



I will often provide very specific instructions about:



* Avatar appearance

* Clothing

* Store/location

* Camera angles

* Product placement

* Product images

* Dialogue

* Voice

* Editing

* Captions

* Reference videos

* Clip pacing



I need someone who actually reads everything carefully and follows those instructions.



If I say to use a specific reference product, store, avatar, voice, or editing style, I should not have to repeat it several times.



Attention to detail is extremely important.



---



# COMMUNICATION



You must be:



* Reliable

* Responsive

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking a question when something is genuinely unclear

* Able to provide updates when needed

* Able to receive feedback without taking it personally

* Able to quickly correct mistakes



If there is a problem with a generation, missing asset, tool issue, or deadline, communicate it immediately instead of disappearing.



I am looking for someone I can work with consistently and trust with a high volume of content.



---



# WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should have:



* Proven hands-on experience with **Veo 3**

* Experience with **Google Flow**

* Deep familiarity with **Nano Banana 1, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro**

* Strong **CapCut** editing skills

* Strong prompt-writing ability

* Ability to maintain consistent AI characters

* Ability to generate realistic product shots

* Ability to recreate reference videos

* Ability to create completely new video concepts from scripts and inspiration

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong attention to realism

* Strong communication

* High output capacity



You must be able to produce **5-6 finished videos per day, 5–6 days per week.**



---



# WHEN APPLYING



Please include:



* Examples of AI videos you have personally created

* Examples using Veo 3

* Examples of Nano Banana

* Examples of realistic AI avatars

* Examples of short-form editing

* Examples showing realistic product placement or product handling if available



Also briefly explain which tools you use most often and your experience with:



**Veo 3, Google Flow, Nano Banana 1/2/Pro, Chatgpt, and CapCut.**



I am looking for someone who can come in and **produce high-quality content from day one.**

title: Experienced Operations & Sales Specialist – Automotive, Marketing & Customer Management
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced, and resourceful individual to support multiple growing US-based businesses, primarily involved in vehicle sales, car rentals, and automotive services.



This is NOT an entry-level virtual assistant position.



We need someone who can wear multiple hats, take initiative, solve problems independently, and handle a variety of responsibilities without constant supervision.



The ideal candidate is tech-savvy, organized, confident communicating with American customers, and genuinely interested in helping businesses grow.



We value results, reliability, common sense, and problem-solving ability over simply completing assigned tasks.



Key Responsibilities



Sales & Automotive Operations



Create, publish, update, and manage vehicle sales and rental listings on
 Marketplace and other advertising platforms.



Respond to customer inquiries, qualify leads, and schedule appointments.



Follow up with potential buyers and rental customers to help close deals.



Maintain vehicle inventory information, pricing, availability, and listing records.



Assist with rental customer management, payment reminders, overdue balances, and renewals.



Customer Communication & Phone Support



Answer incoming phone calls from US customers using a VoIP phone system.



Make outbound calls, follow up with leads, and handle customer questions.



Respond professionally to SMS,
 Messenger,
s, and other communication channels.



Coordinate appointments, customer requests, and follow-ups.



Maintain accurate customer communication records.



Marketing & Online Management



Manage
 Marketplace listings and
 Business Pages.



Create and update online advertisements.



Research and implement ways to generate more leads and improve listing performance.



Assist with social media marketing and other promotional activities.



Monitor inquiries and ensure customers receive timely responses.



Business Operations & Administration



Maintain spreadsheets, customer databases, calendars, and records.



Research vendors, products, services, and business opportunities.



Help coordinate daily tasks across multiple businesses.



Identify operational problems and suggest practical solutions.



Learn new tools, software, and business processes as needed.



Take on additional responsibilities and projects as the businesses expand.



Required Qualifications



Please apply ONLY if you meet the following requirements:



Previous professional experience supporting US-based businesses in sales, operations, marketing, or customer service.



Proven hands-on
 Marketplace experience is REQUIRED, preferably with vehicle sales or rentals.



Experience with VPNs, including setup, troubleshooting, and secure account management.



Excellent spoken and written English. Must be comfortable answering live calls and speaking confidently with American customers.



Experience using VoIP phone systems for inbound and outbound calls.



Strong computer skills and ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly.



Excellent organization, multitasking, and time-management skills.



Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



Reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, and quiet workspace.



Availability during US Pacific Time business hours.



Willingness to take initiative, solve problems, and step up when additional work is needed.



Preferred Experience (Not Required)



Automotive sales or rental industry experience.



Meta Business Suite,
 advertising, and lead generation.



Google Sheets, Google Drive, CRM systems, and Airtable.



AI tools, automation software, and online marketing.



Sales closing, appointment setting, and customer retention.



Compensation & Growth Opportunities



We believe in rewarding employees who produce results and contribute to business growth.



Base Pay: $2.50–$4/hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



Vehicle Sales Commission: Possibility to gain comission on cars sold with your help(on qualified employee/deals)



Rental Commissions: Additional bonuses for successfully acquired rental customers.



Performance Bonuses: Additional incentives for exceptional results, productivity, and initiative.



Opportunity for increased hours, higher base pay, and additional responsibilities.



Potential advancement into an Operations Manager or Team Lead position.



Commissions are paid on verified, completed transactions, with clear attribution and payment terms agreed upon before starting.



We are looking for a long-term team member who wants to grow with the businesses, not someone looking for a short-term side gig.



Who Will Succeed in This Role?



You are someone who:



Doesn't wait to be told what to do every minute.



Can figure things out, research solutions, and solve problems independently.



Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through.



Is comfortable handling multiple types of tasks throughout the day.



Understands that answering customers quickly and following up consistently generates sales.



Is proactive, dependable, adaptable, and willing to go the extra mile when needed.



Wants to learn, improve, and take on greater responsibilities over time.



If you only want repetitive tasks with detailed step-by-step instructions, this position is probably not for you.



How to Apply



We receive many applications and will only consider candidates who follow instructions carefully.



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



Describe your previous work experience supporting US-based businesses. What were your main responsibilities?



Explain your experience with
 Marketplace. Have you personally created and managed vehicle sales or rental listings?



Which VPN services have you used? Describe your experience setting them up and troubleshooting issues.



Have you answered live phone calls from US customers? Which VoIP phone systems have you used?



Describe a specific situation where you independently solved a business problem or took initiative without being instructed.



What experience do you have with sales, lead generation, customer follow-ups, or closing deals?



Which CRM systems, AI tools, or marketing platforms have you used?



What is your expected hourly rate in USD, and how many hours per week are you available?



Are you comfortable working US Pacific Time hours and occasionally taking on additional responsibilities?



Submit a 30–60 second voice recording in English introducing yourself, describing your relevant experience, and explaining why you would be a good fit.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "READY TO WORK".



Applications with generic responses, incomplete answers, or no voice recording will not be considered.



We are looking for a dependable, resourceful, results-driven person who can become a valuable part of our team and help our businesses grow.

title: TikTok Shop Manager / Creator & Affiliate Manager
description:
TikTok Shop Manager / Creator & Affiliate Manager | Remote, US / Europe hours | USD 4,000 to 5,000/month + bonuses



We are hiring a TikTok Shop Manager / Creator & Affiliate Manager for a performance creative agency through Ally. You will manage and coach a large creator roster in the US so their videos perform better every week, and run TikTok Shop so that content turns into sales.



---



You will:



- Be the main point of contact for a large creator roster and manage all communication with them



- Run creator calls once or twice a week that change what each creator makes next



- Give specific feedback on hooks, formats and what converts, and explain why



- Build the training system from scratch, in Loom videos and Notion pages, so creators can improve without a call



- Write briefs clear enough that a large creator roster can act on them at once, without a round of questions



- Read views and output per creator, and put your attention where it moves results



- Manage the TikTok Shop storefront and affiliate creators in Seller Center and Affiliate Center



- Keep every video and listing within TikTok Shop's content rules, especially for supplement and wellness claims



---



You have:



- Hands-on experience growing a TikTok Shop's sales (GMV), ideally in supplements, wellness or beauty. We will ask for the numbers and your exact role



- A portfolio in one of two shapes: you have been a creator yourself and can show your content, or you have worked as a creator, affiliate or influencer manager and can show results



- Proof you have coached creators to a better result, not just supported them



- Experience keeping a large roster on track without losing threads



- Clear, concise writing and speaking. This role lives on briefs and calls



- High EQ: you adjust how feedback lands and keep people engaged after hard feedback



- High agency: you find the answer rather than escalate it



- Comfortable with many threads at once and switching between coaching, writing and coordination in the same day



- Able to work US / Europe hours



- Nice to have: you already use AI tools in how you work



Not a fit if:  your proof is views or followers rather than sales.



---



Your first 90 days:



Day 30: Know where every creator stands, start weekly coaching, and get your first training materials in use



Day 60: Handle more creators and more of the programme on your own



Day 90: Run your own pod of around three clients end to end



Terms: Full-time contractor, remote, 3-month probation. Pay depends on location and experience.



---



How to apply:



Fill out the form: 



Record a 2–3 minute Loom. First, tell us about a TikTok Shop you grew: from what monthly GMV to what, over how long, and what you owned. Then pick one creator whose content got better because of you: what wasn't working, what you told them, what changed, and how you know it worked. Finally, show one thing you built that creators use without you.



No Loom, no review.

title: Property Management VA (UK Morning Shift)
description:
The working hours for this role are 8:15 AM – 4:15 PM UK time, six days a week with Thursdays off. 

***The hours may change***



We are a UK-based short-term rental company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA to join our team. You will play a key role in keeping our properties running smoothly, managing guest communications, coordinating with cleaning teams, and ensuring our listings are always up to date.

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation | Performance-Focused)
description:
Media Buyer + AI — Job Description

Restive Collective · Remote · Full-time



About the business

I'm Markus. I run Restive Collective, a marketing agency in Singapore. We run high-ticket client acquisition for business owners: ads that book qualified sales calls for premium offers — coaching, consulting and professional services.

We manage five figures a month in ad spend across our clients' accounts, plus our own. Every funnel we run has the same job: turn ad spend into qualified booked calls that close.



The job

Keep every funnel you run — our clients' and our own — at or under its cost-per-qualified-call ceiling, and grow the budget when it is.



You own two numbers:

1. Cost per qualified call booked on client campaigns, at each client's ceiling

2. Cost per qualified call booked on the agency's own book-a-call funnel

I'll share the current numbers and the ceilings at interview.



What you'll do

You run high-ticket book-a-call funnels on Meta, the same way across every account:

• Set up and run conversion campaigns to the booking or application page. You own targeting, budgets, bids and daily optimisation.

• Test new ads every week and switch off the ones that stop producing.

• Tag every lead with source, campaign and creative, so every booked call and every sale traces back to the ad that produced it.

• Report the numbers every day: spend, leads, cost per lead, cost per qualified call, and the one thing you changed.



1. High-ticket campaigns for clients and us. Our and client accounts at a time, each a book-a-call or application funnel for a premium offer. Every account has its own ceiling, agreed with the client. Your targets here are cost per lead, cost per application and cost per qualified call booked, per account.

2. Tracking that holds up. For every funnel, you set up the Meta dataset and tracking codes: the pixel and Conversions API (CAPI), standard events, UTM naming and CRM webhooks, so every lead, booked call and sale traces back to the ad that produced it. When a number looks off, you check the tracking before you touch the budget.

3. The numbers, every day. One end-of-day report in five lines per account: spend, leads, cost per lead, cost per qualified call booked, and the one thing you changed. One weekly review with Markus: what to kill, keep and scale, account by account. Non-negotiable

4. AI does the grunt work. You use AI tools daily for creative variations, ad copy, landing-page tests, audience research and reporting. One person with AI replaces the copywriter, designer and analyst we would otherwise need.



Tools you'll use: Meta Ads Manager, the HighLevel-based CRM for leads and pipeline, Google Sheets for the lead tracker, and whichever AI tools you already work with.



Who we're looking for

Must-haves (all four):

• You have personally managed SGD 3,000+ a month on Meta for at least a year, with the account access to prove it

• You know your numbers by heart: ask you cost per lead, cost per call and show-up rate on your last campaign

• You use AI tools every day for copy, creative and analysis, and can show us what you've built with them

• You communicate clearly and proactively. A daily end-of-day report, every working day, is non-negotiable — no chasing, no going quiet when a number is bad



Nice-to-haves:

• You've run high-ticket book-a-call or application funnels, not just lead forms

• You've managed more than one ad account at the same time, with different offers and ceilings

• You've worked with HighLevel, Zapier, Hyros or n8n

• You've set up Meta datasets, pixels and Conversions API (CAPI) yourself, not just worked in accounts where it was done for you



This job is not for you if:

• You want to manage social media posts and count likes and shares. Here, only booked calls and sales count, and both are tracked.

• You wait to be told what to test next. I expect you to bring the next test to me.

• You want one account to babysit. You'll run several at once, each with its own ceiling, and switching between them is the job.

• You want a standard 9-to-6 job. This job is about hitting numbers, not clocking hours, and you'll need to work weekends from time to time — when client spend is high, you check and report the numbers.

• You don't want to own an outcome. Every ad you run has a cost per qualified call against your name, and we review it weekly.



What you get

• Salary plus a performance bonus. You own a result and get paid for moving it. Figures at interview.

• Work anytime, anywhere. I judge outcomes, not hours or location. Just be contactable during Singapore working hours.

• Clock real experience on real ad spend, across industries. Five figures a month across several live accounts and offers. You'll run more real tests across more niches in your first quarter here than most buyers run in a year, and you won't wait for sign-off to launch one.

• Learn from the best. I review your numbers with you weekly, and you get access to the media-buying and business advisors I've paid close to 6-figures SGD to work with. Their playbooks and their feedback on your campaigns will skyrocket your skills.

• AI does the boring work. No resizing banners. No writing twelve headlines by hand. We pay for your AI tools, and you're free to try new ones whenever you like.

• Career progression. As the agency grows, you move up to higher-level work: funnel strategy, offers, new channels. And if you want to lead, you build and run the buying team under you.



How to apply

Please complete the application form below carefully. The questions are designed to show me how you think, not just what tools you've used.



Apply here: 



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

description:
PLEASE READ:

Hi there! Ishar CareConnect is a growing California home care agency, and we're seeking a well-versed Client Care Advisor (Sales) & Business Development Representative, someone who can turn a worried family's first phone call into a trusted, long-term relationship. If you're warm on the phone, confident talking about rates, and energized by building referral partnerships, we'd love to meet you. Come join our PH family and grow with us as we scale!

 

Please only apply if you have at least 12 months of paid sales, intake, or business development experience with a home care agency or senior care provider (USA-based). This is a must-have for the role.

 

Experience should include areas such as:

 

Private-pay home care sales and client intake

Presenting care proposals, rate quotes, and service agreements

Handling pricing questions and objections with families

Lead tracking and follow-up in a CRM or pipeline tracker

Referral partner outreach (hospital discharge planners, social workers, case managers, elder law attorneys, senior placement advisors, SNF and home health agencies)

Local marketing and lead generation

Handing off new clients to care coordination and onboarding

 

This role is the front door of our agency. You'll be the friendly, reassuring voice families hear first, and the person who builds the referral relationships that keep our client pipeline full. It's perfect for someone who is caring, organized, persistent without being pushy, and excited to wear a few hats as part of a close-knit, supportive team.

 

What you'll do:

 

Respond quickly to new leads by phone,
, and text, and run the first-contact call to understand the family's care needs

Present our care proposal and rate quote, answer questions honestly, and handle objections with empathy

Log every lead in our pipeline tracker with next steps and follow-up dates, and keep a steady follow-up schedule so no lead goes cold

Build and maintain relationships with referral partners, and track which sources send the best clients

Send the client service agreement for e-signature and follow up until it is signed

Hand each signed client off to our Care Coordinator with a complete, well-organized file, and set up the client folder in Google Drive

Report weekly on leads, proposals sent, clients signed, and referral source results

 

What we're looking for:

 

Minimum 12 months of paid sales or business development experience in the home care or senior care industry (required)

Clear, confident, professional English, written and verbal, with a strong phone presence

Comfort discussing pricing and asking for the sale in a caring, non-pushy way

Experience with a CRM or pipeline tracker (HubSpot, Zoho, Google Sheets, or similar) a plus

Experience with e-signature tools (Adobe Acrobat Sign, DocuSign, or similar) and Google Workspace a plus

Familiarity with California non-medical home care rules is a plus

Comfortable handling sensitive client information with care and discretion; familiarity with HIPAA or general confidentiality best practices is a plus

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet remote workspace

Availability to overlap with US Pacific Time business hours, with prompt response to new leads

 

This is an independent contractor position with room to grow. As our client base expands, we expect this role to evolve, and we prioritize promoting from within.

 

This is a non-medical, non-clinical role: no direct care duties and no medical decision-making. Full training is provided on our tools and workflows.

title: Video Editor & Ad Creative Specialist for DTC brand
description:
# DTC Performance Video Editor / Creative Strategist



We’re looking for an experienced **DTC video editor who understands direct-response creative strategy**, not just someone who can make videos look polished.



You’ll be editing
/Instagram/TikTok ads for e-commerce brands using UGC, AI-generated footage, product footage, testimonials, native-style content, statics turned into video, and other direct-response formats.



The ideal person understands that a winning ad is more than good editing.



You should understand:



* Hooks and scroll-stopping first 1–3 seconds

* Customer awareness levels

* Different marketing angles and avatars

* Problem → agitation → mechanism → solution structures

* Belief shifts and objection handling

* How to visually communicate a mechanism instead of relying only on voiceover

* Pattern interrupts

* Pacing and retention

* When to use captions, B-roll, screenshots, comments, reviews, demonstrations, etc.

* Native/UGC-style ads vs overly polished brand ads

* How to turn one script into multiple creative variations

* Why an ad may have high CTR but poor conversion, or poor hook rate despite strong copy

* Direct-response metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, CVR and ROAS



### What You'll Be Doing



You'll receive things such as:



* Scripts

* Hooks

* Customer research

* Creative briefs

* Raw UGC

* AI-generated clips

* Product footage

* Existing winning ads

* Competitor references



Your job is to turn them into **performance-focused DTC ads**, not simply assemble the clips in the order provided.



I want someone who can look at a script and think:



"This section is dragging."



"The visual isn't proving what the VO is saying."



"We need a pattern interrupt here."



"This hook needs the result shown before the explanation."



"This objection would be stronger with a review screenshot."



"We should test three different openings with the same body."



In other words, I want an editor who can **think like a creative strategist while editing.**



### Typical Creative Styles



You'll work on formats such as:



* UGC ads

* Native
-style ads

* Storytime ads

* Advertorial-style video

* Problem/solution demonstrations

* Before & after concepts

* Educational/mechanism ads

* Testimonial ads

* Reddit/comment-style ads

* Founder/expert formats

* VSL-style direct-response ads

* Mashups

* AI UGC + AI B-roll

* Competitor-inspired iterations

* Hook variations



Most videos will be designed for **Meta and TikTok**, usually 9:16.



### What I DON'T Want



I'm not looking for an editor whose main focus is:



* Cinematic transitions

* Fancy motion graphics

* Making everything look like a commercial

* Random zooms and sound effects with no strategic reason

* Following the script blindly

* Editing without understanding the target customer



A slightly ugly/native ad that converts is more valuable to me than a beautiful ad that doesn't sell.



### Requirements



You should have previous experience editing **DTC/e-commerce performance ads**.



Please be comfortable with fast testing and iteration. We may produce several variations of the same concept by changing hooks, opening visuals, pacing, proof, CTAs or sections of the body.



Experience with Meta ads is especially valuable.



Knowledge of tools such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or similar is fine—the specific software matters less than your creative judgment.



Experience working with AI-generated creative is a plus.



### When Applying



Please send:



1. 3–5 DTC ads you've personally edited.

2. The ad you're most proud of and why you think it worked.

3. Any performance metrics you're allowed to share.

4. An example of an ad where **you contributed to the creative strategy**, rather than simply receiving editing instructions.

5. Your rate per video or preferred pricing structure.

6. Roughly how many ads/variations you can produce per week.



Also answer this:



**If I give you a 60-second DTC script, what are the first things you think about before you start editing?**



I'm specifically looking at your answer to this question because I want someone who understands **performance creative, not just video editing.**



### Paid Trial



We'll start with a **paid trial creative**.



You'll receive the script, research, product information and available assets.



I'm interested not only in the final edit but also in whether you can identify opportunities to improve the hook, visuals, pacing and overall creative before/during the edit.



If the trial goes well, there is potential for consistent long-term work producing and iterating DTC creatives.

title: FACEBOOK ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER & AD EDITOR (FULL-TIME)
description:
ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER & AD EDITOR (FULL-TIME)



We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:



A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.





WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING



You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:



• AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

• Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

•
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

• UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

• Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

• Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

• VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

• Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.



You should know how to make videos that:



• Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

• Make the problem feel real and urgent

• Show the product clearly and persuasively

• Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

• Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

• Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

• Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

• Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.





THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



You'll be a strong fit if you:



• Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

• Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

• Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

• Can create multiple ad variations quickly

• Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

• Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

• Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

• Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

• Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.





SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



You need experience with:



• HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

• ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

• Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

• At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



you also have experience with:



• Meta/Facebook ad creatives

• Short-form paid social videos

• Long-form VSLs or sales videos

• Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

• Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY



• Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

• Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

• Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

• Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

• Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

• Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

• Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

• Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

• Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

• Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

• Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

• Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU



• Competitive compensation based on experience

• The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

• Clear creative direction and fast feedback

• Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.



If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: 3D Product Designer & Rendering Artist
description:
# 3D Product Designer & Rendering Artist



**Industry:** Beauty & Cosmetics  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time Contract  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time (U.S.)



### About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based cosmetics company seeking a creative and detail-oriented 3D Product Designer & Rendering Artist to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This role combines product development, technical design, and high-quality visual content creation. The ideal candidate can transform initial product ideas into detailed 3D concepts while also producing photorealistic renders, lifestyle imagery, and animations for e-commerce, social media, and marketing campaigns.



**Candidates must be available to work during our U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time. This is a required schedule, not flexible hours.**



### Key Responsibilities



- **Product Development:** Transform initial ideas, sketches, and references into creative 3D product concepts, including packaging, cosmetic products, and beauty equipment.

- **Technical & Functional Design:** Create detailed 3D models illustrating product components, functionality, assembly, and design specifications for manufacturing reference.

- **Photorealistic Rendering:** Produce realistic, high-quality renders of existing and upcoming products with accurate materials, colors, textures, and branding.

- **Lifestyle & Marketing Content:** Develop product lifestyle scenes and promotional imagery for websites, social media, advertisements, and product launches.

- **3D Animation & Video:** Create engaging product animations, motion graphics, and video content highlighting product features and functionality.

- **Creative Collaboration:** Work closely with U.S.-based product development and marketing teams, contributing original ideas, recommendations, and creative solutions.



### Qualifications



- Proven experience in 3D product modeling, rendering, and animation.

- Proficiency in Blender, Cinema 4D, KeyShot, SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar software.

- Strong understanding of lighting, materials, textures, composition, and photorealistic visualization.

- Ability to interpret product sketches, dimensions, and technical references.

- Experience developing functional product concepts and manufacturing-oriented designs.

- Ability to independently research, conceptualize, and recommend creative directions.

- Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or Premiere Pro is a plus.

- Experience in cosmetics, beauty products, packaging, or consumer product design is preferred.

- Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to participate in virtual meetings during U.S. business hours.



### What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who combines strong technical skills with creativity and initiative. The right candidate can take a project from concept to completion, contribute original ideas, solve design challenges, and deliver professional, brand-consistent visuals with minimal supervision.



### Schedule & Work Requirements



- **Location:** Remote, Philippines

- **Work Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT)

- **Availability:** Full overlap with our U.S. team's working hours is mandatory.

- **Work Arrangement:** Independent contractor

- Must be comfortable working overnight hours in the Philippines due to the time difference.



### How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a portfolio demonstrating:



- 3D product modeling and conceptual designs

- Photorealistic product and lifestyle renders

- Technical or functional product designs

- 3D animations or product videos



**Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.**

title: Ecommerce Marketing Manager - Klaviyo and Shopify (Skincare / Clinics, Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Work from home, full-time, with a growing Australian skin clinic group.



We're hiring an Ecommerce Marketing Manager for a Sydney skin clinic group that sells treatments and skincare online through Shopify. Clients book treatments, treatment series and skincare online, so although the business is built around its clinics, all of its marketing runs ecommerce style through Shopify and Klaviyo.



This is a focused specialist role for someone who lives in Klaviyo. You will own retention
 and SMS, manage every campaign EDM, and build the segments and lifecycle journeys that bring clients back at the right time. You will also keep the Shopify store and its high-converting landing pages sharp, look after GA4 tracking and site indexing, and work hand in hand with the socials and content team so every campaign lands as one.



There is no social media management, no Meta or Google ads creation, and no SEO programme: paid media is handled in-house. What matters is depth in Klaviyo and Shopify, and using data to make decisions.



The most important attributes

- Real depth in Klaviyo. You think in flows, segments and lifecycle journeys, and you understand that different treatments need different spacing between visits, so the timing of every message matters.

- You make the technical simple. You translate complex processes into clear, scalable systems that non-technical colleagues and management can use, each with a few key metrics that show what is driving growth, so decisions are quick and confident.



About the role

- Full-time, remote (work from home), starting as soon as possible.

- Sydney business hours, Monday to Friday.

- You report to the Digital Director and work as part of the clinic team's day-to-day marketing.

-
 and SMS copy is reviewed by the team before it goes live.



What you'll do

1. Retention and campaign marketing: Own Klaviyo end to end across
 and SMS (flows, campaigns, templates and the build behind them). Plan, build and send all campaign EDMs in line with the marketing calendar. Build treatment-based and post-purchase flows that respect the right spacing between treatments, from first purchase to repeat bookings and series renewals. Write
 and SMS copy for review, and keep improving the flows already running.

2. Customer segmentation and targeted marketing: Segment customers by treatment history, purchase behaviour and engagement, and analyse what each group responds to. Use those insights to target campaigns and flows so every client gets the most relevant message. Keep Klaviyo and Shopify customer data clean and in sync.

3. GA4 tracking, website mapping and indexing: Set up and maintain GA4 tracking so Shopify and Klaviyo performance is measured accurately. Map the website's structure and make sure key pages are correctly indexed by Google. Plan and run A/B tests across
s, SMS, flows and landing pages, and act on the results.

4. Systems and reporting: Build and maintain scalable systems across retention, campaigns, segmentation and tracking that anyone on the team can follow. Turn the data into simple reports and dashboards, built around a few key metrics, that non-technical colleagues and management can read and act on quickly. Find opportunities for further automation and put ideas forward to the team.

5. Shopify, landing pages and assets: Manage the Shopify store day to day (products, treatments, offers, banners and promotions, including peak sales such as Black Friday). Design and build high-converting landing pages, and create on-brand
 and onsite assets in Canva.

6. Team collaboration: Liaise with the socials and content team to align campaigns and the marketing calendar, so
, SMS, site and social work together. You do not run social.



Must-haves

- Strong, hands-on Klaviyo experience across
 and SMS: flows, campaigns, segmentation and templates.

- Proven ecommerce marketing experience on Shopify, including building landing pages.

- Retention and lifecycle marketing experience, ideally with repeat or subscription-style customers.

- Customer segmentation and analysis, using data to target campaigns.

- Confident with GA4 tracking and Shopify analytics, with a working understanding of site mapping and Google indexing.

- Able to turn complex, technical processes into simple systems and reports for non-technical colleagues.

- Able to create polished
 and web assets in Canva (or similar).

- Initiative: you test, recommend and put ideas forward, rather than waiting for a brief.

- Fluent spoken and written English (must-have).

- Available full-time during Sydney business hours, Monday to Friday.



Highly regarded

- Experience with skin clinics, medical aesthetics, dermatology or beauty brands.

- Clinic or appointment-based customer funnels and booking flows.

- Marketing automation beyond Klaviyo.

- SEO or paid ads experience (a plus, not required; neither is in scope for the foreseeable future).

- Copywriting for health, beauty or skincare, written responsibly.



Not part of this role

- Social media management or content posting.

- Creating or running Meta or Google ads (paid media is handled in-house).

- Running an SEO programme.



How to apply

Apply on OnlineJobs.ph with subject line KLAVIYO-300 - [Your Name]. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.



In your application, attach your updated CV, confirm you can work full-time in Sydney business hours at USD $300 per week, and answer these three questions:

1. Tell us about a Klaviyo
 and SMS programme you owned end to end. What flows did you build, how did you time messages for repeat or appointment-style customers, and what was the result (with numbers)?

2. Give an example of how you turned a complex ecommerce process into a simple system or report that non-technical colleagues could use to make decisions quickly. What were the few key metrics?

3. How do you segment customers in Klaviyo and Shopify, and how have you used those segments (and GA4) to target campaigns? Give one concrete example and the result.

We're a fast-growing DTC company building products people genuinely love and trust — and we're looking for Creative Strategists who live and breathe avatars, angles, and hooks. The difference here: when your creative wins, you win. Hit your targets and you earn a percentage of the ad spend your winning ads unlock. If you back your ideas, this is where you bet on yourself — and build real financial freedom doing it. 



Why this role is different 

Uncapped upside. Winning ads earn you a share of the spend they drive. Your ceiling is set by your results, not a fixed salary band. 

We invest in you. Courses, mentorship, and hands-on training from top creative and marketing talent. You'll leave every quarter sharper than you started. 

Products you'll actually care about. A wide and growing portfolio means you get to work on brands and products you're excited about — with new launches landing regularly. 

You're building the foundation. Our mission is to build iconic brands consumers love and trust. Great creative is how those products reach the world. This role sits at the heart of that. 



What you'll do 

Research relentlessly — deep-dive into our avatars (who we target), angles (what we say), and ad types (how we say it). 

Develop winning ad concepts and briefs that guide our designers and video editors to produce scroll-stopping creative for Meta and YouTube. 

Partner with the creative team to bring ideas to life with clarity, emotion, and precision. 

Work with our CRO team to keep messaging congruent across ads, landing pages, and funnels. 

Analyze performance data to learn which angles, hooks, and visuals drive results — then double down on what works. 



What success looks like 

A consistent stream of winning ad concepts that scale on Meta and YouTube 

Landing pages that measurably lift conversion 

Tight collaboration and clear communication across teams 

Fast, data-driven iteration — testing and learning as a default 



Who you are 

Proven experience as a Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Graphic Designer, or Video Editor 

Strong grasp of ad psychology, storytelling, and creative direction 

Obsessed with research, trends, and what makes people click 

Sharp prioritization — you know what matters and what doesn't 

A tester at heart — you love learning from data 

Excellent English communication 



How we work 

Team Player — we win together 

Hungry & growth-oriented — always leveling up 

Speed — move fast, learn fast 

Innovation — challenge the norm 

Effort & attitude — bring your best every day 



The details 

Full-time, fully remote (Philippines-based) 

Base pay plus performance incentive tied to winning ads 

A growth-focused culture surrounded by top creative and marketing talent 



Ready to build what's next? 



If you're obsessed with turning ideas into high-performing ads — and you want your pay to reflect the wins you create — we want to hear from you. 



Explore Our Brands

title: Remote Video Editor
description:
Do you know how to hook someone? Do you know how to tell a story? Can you make someone stop scrolling and watch?



If yes — we want to talk to you.



We're looking for a superstar video editor who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prove it. In return, we're offering a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus when your videos deliver results.



Ready to join Orca Brands? We're on a mission to be the best employer in the Philippines — offering real growth opportunities, hands-on training, a tight-knit culture, and a thriving e-commerce community. We run quarterly employee awards and offer top performers the chance to visit us in the USA.



If you are AVERAGE. DO NOT APPLY. THERE will be 2 - 3 tests you will need to pass and we only have 2 spots open.



About the Role



As Mr. Beast says, "the magic happens in the editing room." This role demands strong storytelling instincts, a deep understanding of e-commerce video trends, and the ability to craft videos that hook and hold attention — with minimal hand-holding.



You'll collaborate closely with our marketing and creative teams to bring products to life through visual storytelling that drives conversions and builds brand visibility.



Primary Responsibilities



Edit and produce high-converting video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

Transform raw footage and creative briefs into videos that capture and hold attention from first frame to last

Craft compelling narratives using motion graphics, text overlays, sound design, and effects

Optimize videos for platform-specific formats across mobile and desktop

Work autonomously — take scripts, clips, and hooks and turn them into polished, attention-grabbing content

Highlight key selling points, user testimonials, and product demonstrations through smart editing

Stay ahead of trends in video marketing, storytelling, and social media best practices

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and hitting deadlines



Qualifications



Proven experience as a video editor — ideally in e-commerce, social media marketing, DTC brands, or film

Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or comparable software

Strong understanding of social media ad formats, aspect ratios, and platform-specific requirements

Ability to edit fast-paced, conversion-optimized content

Exceptional storytelling skills — you know how to keep viewers engaged start to finish

Experience with motion graphics, text animation, and sound design

Ability to work independently and execute on creative direction with minimal supervision



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with A/B testing for video ads and building strong hooks

A sharp eye for compelling, scroll-stopping imagery and strong composition

Collaborative mindset — excited to work cross-functionally toward shared business goals

A hunger to improve, comfort with feedback, and a problem-solver's mentality



About Orca Brands



Orca Brands is a fast-growing e-commerce company dedicated to building high-quality beauty and wellness products. Our marketing team thrives on delivering compelling, high-performing video content that resonates with real audiences and drives real sales.



Learn more: 
 | 



To Apply



Submit your portfolio — especially videos that grab and hold attention. Show us you can bring a creative concept to life and make viewers stop, watch, and buy.

title: Client Success Coordinator – Accounting
description:
Most coordinators spend their day chasing. In this seat, you build the system that means nobody has to. You’ll run the ongoing client engine for Aureus Accounting: every client on track, every meeting worth having, and every team member’s time visible and billable.



The role in three sentences



You own the rhythm of our ongoing accounting clients from the day onboarding finishes. You keep Karbon accurate, timesheets complete and the team on target. Success is clients who stay, refer and tell us we exceeded what they expected.



Why this matters



Our clients are business owners who want more than compliance. They want a budget, a live tax plan, regular reporting and an accountant who knows their priorities. Your job is to make sure that happens for every client, every time, without anyone working late to cover a gap.



What you will do



Karbon integrity: keep every workflow on the right steps, statuses current and records clean, and raise it when a process needs fixing.

Team productivity: make sure every team member logs time daily and the billable team moves from 70% to 85%.

Client success: keep every package client on track with a current budget, Fathom reporting, tax plan and compliance schedule, and make sure every client meeting has an agenda before it starts.

What success looks like in your first 90 days



Karbon statuses current across your clients, with a monthly audit in place.

Every team member logging time daily.

Every ongoing client meeting running from an agenda sent in advance.

Who you are



You ask ‘who should do this?’ before ‘how do I do this?’

You trust a good template more than a heroic effort.

You can say no to work outside your role and keep the relationship intact.

You’re at your best talking with clients and keeping things moving.

You follow up until it’s done.

What you need to bring



3+ Accounting experience, in an accounting practice or an accounting or finance role (required).

Client service or coordination experience.

Strong written and spoken English.

Experience with Karbon, Xero, NowInfinity and Ignition is highly regarded.

Availability to work in the AU time zone



What we offer

Php45k-60k/month

LOCATION / ENGAGEMENT: fully remote | Independent Contractor



Send your application here:

title: Senior Paraplanner - Day shift
description:
Write advice that changes clients’ retirements, with a team that backs you and the tools to do it faster.



Aureus Private Wealth is growing, and our advisers need a senior paraplanner who can take a complex file and turn it into a clear, compliant Statement of Advice without being chased. If you’re the person advisers trust to get it right the first time, this role is built for you.



The role

You’ll prepare SoAs and RoAs for our Australian advisers across super, retirement, investments, SMSFs and personal insurance. You’ll work with our Paraplanning Team Lead, Research, Implementation and advisers. Over time, you’ll help shape how our paraplanning runs, including where AI can save hours.



What you’ll deliver



Quality advice documents: complex SoAs and RoAs that pass compliance first time.

Reliable turnaround: you manage your own queue and flag gaps or risks early.

Better process: templates, checklists and AI-assisted workflows that lift the whole team.

What success looks like in 90 days



You’re producing complex SoAs independently, on time.

Advisers rarely send work back.

You’ve put forward at least one improvement to how we work.

Who you are



You own your work and don’t wait to be asked.

You raise problems early and come with a fix.

You take feedback well and act on it.

You enjoy new technology and test it with a critical eye.

What you need to bring



3-5+ years preparing Australian SoAs and RoAs (essential)

Strong knowledge of super, retirement planning, investments, SMSFs and personal insurance

A solid understanding of ASIC requirements and advice compliance

Daily Xplan use, plus experience with research platforms

Bonus: experience with AI-assisted paraplanning tools such as Claude

What we offer



Fully remote, working 38hrs hours aligned to Sydney (AEST) business hours

A growing, well-resourced team that invests in AI and process improvement
