title: YouTube Content Editor
description:
About Quarantine Garden Queen

Quarantine Garden Queen is a growing YouTube and social media brand focused on transforming ordinary outdoor spaces into beautiful, functional backyard sanctuaries. Our content features real DIY projects, gardening, outdoor living, and backyard transformations. Our tagline is “Where Outdoor Spaces Become Everyday Escapes.”

We are seeking a dependable, creative YouTube editor who can turn raw footage into engaging, polished videos that keep viewers watching.



Primary Responsibilities

• Edit approximately one long-form YouTube video per week from footage supplied by the creator.

• Create engaging openings, effective story structure, and strong pacing.

• Select clips, add appropriate music, sound, text overlays, transitions, and branding.

• Create two YouTube thumbnail variations for A/B testing.

• Edit and repurpose footage into engaging vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts, including hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-ready exports.

• Organize source files, editable project files, and final exports in Google Drive.

• Complete agreed revisions and provide proactive progress updates.



Required Qualifications

• Portfolio showing at least three long-form YouTube videos personally edited.

• Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable editing software.

• Ability to create effective YouTube thumbnails using Canva, Photoshop, or similar tools.

• Understanding of YouTube storytelling, audience retention, pacing, and viewer engagement.

• Demonstrated skill editing short-form vertical videos with compelling opening hooks, readable captions, and mobile-friendly framing.

• Clear communication, attention to detail, reliable delivery, and ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with DIY, home improvement, gardening, lifestyle, or transformation videos.

• Familiarity with YouTube Studio audience-retention analytics and platform-specific short-form trends.



Weekly Deliverables & Collaboration

• Target: one to two completed long-form YouTube video, two thumbnail variations, and an agreed number of short-form vertical videos per week; scope and deadlines set in advance based on footage, complexity, and available hours.

• Provide timely revisions, organized editable files, and final exports.

• Collaborate using Slack, Google Drive, Canva, and Hubstaff, with agreed check-ins.

• Notify the team promptly if any issue may affect a deadline.



*****  How to Apply *****

Please submit through the job posting/application process:

• Resume and portfolio, including links to at least three long-form YouTube videos you personally edited.

• Two examples of YouTube thumbnails you created, plus at least two short-form videos you personally edited for Reels, TikTok,
, or YouTube Shorts.

• Your editing software, weekly availability, and a brief explanation of how you improve viewer retention.

• A short description of your role in each portfolio sample.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview and will be asked to walk through their previous editing work. We seek someone ready to manage the editing process independently, rather than someone requiring extensive training.

title: Video Editor for Instagram Shorts (Claude Code / AI Workflow)
description:
We're looking for a video editor who can turn raw footage and creator clips into strong Instagram Shorts for a growing food / creator account. You should already use Claude Code in your editing workflow and be able to show how it helps you produce better videos faster.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit Instagram Shorts with strong hooks, clear stories and natural pacing.

- Use Claude Code for practical editing work: reviewing transcripts, planning cuts and B-roll, creating captions, sound design, and visual polish.

- Keep the speaker sounding natural, with room to breathe.

- Choose cuts and pattern interrupts that support retention.

- Add clear, native-style captions, relevant B-roll and creator clips.

- Keep text inside platform safe areas.

- Make the hook flow into the short and keep any product mention natural.

- Fix audio, caption, timing and visual glitches.

- Deliver organized project files and clean exports, and apply feedback accurately.

- Study strong reference videos and explain the editing choices you would adapt.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven short-form editing work for Instagram Shorts, UGC or direct-response ads.

- Sustained work on similar projects. Tell us how long you worked with each relevant client and what you owned.

- Good judgment on hooks, pacing, captions, B-roll and retention.

- Hands-on Claude Code experience plus confidence in an editing tool such as Remotion, CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

- Clear communication and attention to detail.



TO APPLY

1. Send links to your 3 strongest relevant edits. State exactly what you did on each.

2. Pick one example and explain the hook, pacing and visual decisions. Share results you can substantiate, with context for the metrics.

3. Send a 3-minute screen recording walking through how you edit a past video, including how you use Claude Code in your editing workflow, what it produces, and what you check or change yourself. Do not include confidential client material.

4. Tell us your relevant experience, editing software, availability and expected rate.



Please send specific examples and explanations rather than a generic application. If your video looks good, we will invite you to Slack and arrange an interview.



PAY

$500 USD per month base, plus view-based bonuses, with $1,000 USD per month in on-target earnings. On-target earnings include the base and performance bonuses; bonuses depend on performance.

title: Independent Facility Sales Representative
description:
WE ARE HIRING

Independent Facility Sales Representative



Remote | Independent Contractor | U.S. Healthcare Staffing Sales



Company: Main Forte Staffing  

Company Location: Palm Bay, Florida, USA  

Work Location: Remote — Philippines-based applicants welcome  

Contract Type: Independent Contractor  

Initial Contract: 30-Day Paid Trial



 Compensation



₱25,000–₱35,000 per month + performance-based commissions**



- Preferred starting offer: ₱30,000 monthly contractor service fee.

- Qualified sales meeting bonus: ₱1,000 per completed, qualified meeting.

- New facility acquisition commission: 10% of collected gross profit generated during the new facility's first four weeks of staffing services.

- Payment terms: Established in the written independent contractor agreement.

- Contract renewal: Based on performance and mutual agreement.



This is a negotiated independent contractor service fee, not an employee salary. Actual compensation will depend on qualifications, experience, agreed scope, and verified results.



About Main Forte Staffing



Main Forte Staffing is a Florida-based healthcare staffing company focused on connecting qualified Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) and Home Health Aides (HHAs) with healthcare facilities that need dependable staffing support.



We are seeking an experienced, confident, and results-oriented Independent Facility Sales Representative to identify prospective facility clients, build relationships with decision-makers, and generate new staffing business.



This is a professional B2B sales position—not an entry-level virtual assistant or data-entry role.



Key Responsibilities



Facility Prospecting and Lead Generation

- Research healthcare facilities throughout Florida.

- Identify administrators, Directors of Nursing, HR managers, and staffing coordinators.

- Contact nursing homes, assisted living facilities, rehabilitation centers, and other appropriate healthcare organizations.

- Qualify facilities with potential CNA and HHA staffing requirements.



Sales and Business Development

- Conduct outbound calls and professional
 outreach.

- Present Main Forte Staffing's services with confidence and professionalism.

- Identify staffing shortages and temporary coverage needs.

- Handle common objections and develop relationships with facility decision-makers.

- Follow up with prospects and advance qualified opportunities toward proposals and service agreements.

- Coordinate negotiations and contract discussions with authorized management.



Client Relationship Development

- Schedule qualified meetings with facility decision-makers.

- Identify facility vendor-registration requirements.

- Maintain professional follow-up communications.

- Coordinate successful client handoffs to Main Forte Staffing management.



CRM and Sales Reporting

- Update the Facility CRM and Sales Pipeline accurately.

- Document decision-maker contacts, staffing needs, objections, and next steps.

- Provide agreed progress and performance reports.

- Maintain confidentiality and protect company information.



Required Qualifications



- Proven experience in U.S. B2B sales, outbound prospecting, or business development.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong telephone confidence and professional communication.

- Demonstrated experience handling objections and difficult sales conversations.

- Ability to communicate with U.S. business owners, administrators, and management personnel.

- Experience using CRM software or sales tracking systems.

- Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet calling environment.

- Ability to coordinate with prospects during appropriate U.S. business hours while independently managing work.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous U.S. healthcare staffing sales experience.

- Experience selling services to nursing homes, assisted living facilities, or rehabilitation centers.

- Experience securing new staffing accounts or service agreements.

- Familiarity with CNA/HHA staffing needs and healthcare facility vendor onboarding.

- Proven ability to generate qualified meetings and advance opportunities through the sales process.



Initial 30-Day Performance Objectives



During the initial engagement, the representative will work toward the following objectives:



- Research and verify 40–60 potential facility clients.

- Develop 8–12 meaningful decision-maker conversations.

- Generate 3–5 qualified sales meetings.

- Identify opportunities for proposals and service agreements.

- Maintain accurate CRM and Sales Pipeline documentation.



These objectives are used to evaluate the trial and do not constitute guaranteed sales outcomes.



Independent Contractor Arrangement



The representative will provide services under a written Independent Contractor Agreement and generally retain control over their working methods and schedule.



Main Forte Staffing retains final authority over pricing, staffing commitments, contract approval, and execution.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should provide:



1. Updated resume highlighting U.S. B2B sales experience.

2. A brief summary of past sales achievements, including qualified meetings or accounts acquired.

3. A 60–90-second English voice introduction demonstrating professional sales communication.

4. Expected monthly service fee within the advertised compensation range.

5. Availability for an online interview and live sales role-play.



Company Website: 



Main Forte Staffing

Building Reliable Healthcare Staffing Partnerships

title: Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher — Virtual Assistant
description:
WE ARE HIRING

Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher — Virtual Assistant



Company: True Profit Dispatch  

Website: 
  

Position: U.S. Freight Dispatcher (Dry Van & Reefer)  

Engagement: Independent Contractor  

Location: 100% Remote — International Applicants Welcome  

Compensation: Proposed $6–$9 USD per hour, based on experience, plus performance-based incentives  

Availability: Must be available to coordinate dispatch activities during agreed U.S. business-hour coverage periods



About True Profit Dispatch



True Profit Dispatch is a U.S.-focused freight dispatching business specializing in helping trucking companies and owner-operators operate efficiently and profitably.



We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly motivated **Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher** who understands U.S. trucking markets, negotiates effectively with freight brokers, and prioritizes driver profitability.



We are not looking for someone who simply books loads. We want a dispatcher who understands the difference between keeping a truck moving and keeping a truck profitable.



Key Responsibilities



1. Load Searching and Booking

- Search DAT, Truckstop, and other authorized freight load boards.

- Find profitable loads for both dry van and refrigerated trailers.

- Evaluate rates using total miles, including loaded and deadhead miles.

- Identify strong and weak freight markets.

- Plan profitable routes and return loads.

- Verify broker credentials, payment history, and load details.

- Review rate confirmations before booking.



2. Broker Negotiations

- Communicate professionally with U.S. freight brokers by phone and
.

- Negotiate competitive rates based on current freight conditions.

- Prepare and present effective counteroffers.

- Identify opportunities for higher-paying freight.

- Negotiate detention, layover, additional stops, and other accessorial charges.

- Build productive, long-term relationships with reliable brokers.

- Avoid booking loads that do not meet agreed profitability requirements without authorization.



3. Dry Van Dispatch Operations

- Coordinate general freight shipments and delivery schedules.

- Verify equipment requirements and shipment details.

- Monitor pickup and delivery appointments.

- Coordinate with drivers regarding routes and load status.

- Resolve scheduling conflicts and report service issues.

- Monitor detention and layover opportunities.



4. Reefer Dispatch Operations

- Book temperature-controlled freight.

- Confirm commodity requirements, temperature setpoints, and reefer operating instructions.

- Coordinate reefer trailer availability, washouts, and fuel requirements.

- Monitor pickup and delivery appointments.

- Maintain accurate seal, temperature, and shipment documentation.

- Escalate temperature discrepancies and potential cargo claims.



5. Driver and Broker Communication**

- Maintain timely communication with drivers and brokers.

- Provide shipment updates and appointment confirmations.

- Coordinate delays and operational issues.

- Respect driver hours-of-service limitations.

- Escalate safety, mechanical, and compliance concerns.



6. Reporting and Administrative Support**

- Maintain accurate load records in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Update dispatch dashboards and truck availability information.

- Record gross revenue, loaded miles, deadhead, and booked RPM.

- Track detention, layover, and accessorial payments.

- Organize rate confirmations, bills of lading, and proof-of-delivery documents.

- Prepare daily status reports and weekly performance summaries.



Minimum Qualifications



- At least 1 year of U.S. freight dispatching experience preferred.

- Experience with both dry van and reefer freight strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with DAT, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. freight lanes and trucking geography.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident broker negotiation and telephone communication skills.

- Ability to calculate gross RPM and understand cost-per-mile profitability.

- Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets,
, and digital communication.

- Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup.

- Strong time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.



Preferred Experience



- Dispatching owner-operators and small trucking fleets.

- Reefer commodity and temperature requirements.

- Booking profitable return loads.

- Managing multiple trucks.

- Broker credit and authority verification.

- Detention and layover recovery.

- Familiarity with the Southeast, Midwest, Texas, Northeast, and Western U.S. freight markets.



Performance Expectations



Contractor performance will be evaluated using agreed service and business outcomes, including:



- Profitability of booked freight.

- Quality of broker negotiations.

- Reduction of avoidable deadhead.

- Load documentation accuracy.

- Effective driver and broker communication.

- Appointment and shipment coordination.

- Timely reporting.

- Consistent adherence to agreed dispatch procedures and safety requirements.



Compensation and Engagement



- Proposed rate: $6–$9 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Performance-based bonuses may be offered under separately agreed criteria.

- Initial paid trial engagement.

- Opportunity for an ongoing service relationship.

- Independent contractor agreement required.



The contractor is responsible for applicable independent-business and tax obligations, subject to governing law.



How to Apply



Applicants should submit:



1. Resume and relevant dispatching experience.

2. Description of dry van and reefer freight experience.

3. Freight load boards previously used.

4. Number of trucks previously managed.

title: US Senior Tax Associate
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.

title: Virtual Assistant — Client Acquisition & Order Coordination
description:
Virtual Assistant — Client Acquisition & Order Coordination



Company: MaxYoMind LLC — Custom Printing & Embroidery. Location: Remote (company based in Mount Laurel, NJ; Eastern Time hours). Type: Part-time, 20 hours per week. Compensation: $3.50 per hour, plus a $25 bonus for every order you help close. For orders over $1,000, you earn 2% commission on the order total instead of the $25 bonus.



About MaxYoMind: MaxYoMind is a custom printing and embroidery company in Mount Laurel, New Jersey. We produce custom apparel and printed goods — embroidery, screen printing, DTF printing, heat-transfer vinyl, custom hats and caps, team uniforms, jackets, and paper/memorial printing — for local businesses, churches, schools, sports teams, organizations, and individuals. We are also building a youth vocational training program inside our shop. We are quote-based: customers request a quote, approve a mockup, pay by invoice, and we produce in-house. We are hiring a Virtual Assistant to grow the front of the business — finding customers, taking orders, marketing the company, and making sure every order is fulfilled and gets to the customer. Production itself is done by our in-house team; this role owns everything before and after the machines run.



The Role in One Sentence: You are the engine that brings in customers and the coordinator who makes sure no order — from first message to the customer's hands — ever falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Finding Customers (Lead Generation & Outreach): Research and build prospect lists of businesses and organizations that need custom printing: churches, schools, sports leagues and teams, restaurants and delis, realtors, construction and service companies, nonprofits, event organizers, and local retailers. Run outreach campaigns by
, phone, and social media DMs following company scripts and templates: introduce MaxYoMind, identify the decision-maker, and book quote requests. Follow up on every lead systematically — most orders come after the second or third touch, not the first. Watch for institutional opportunities: school and government bid notices, team uniform seasons, church and organizational events, and seasonal demand. Keep the prospect/lead tracker current: who was contacted, when, what they said, and the next follow-up date.

2. Marketing the Business: Prepare marketing content for the company's social media (Instagram,
, TikTok): captions, post ideas, and content calendars featuring finished work, services, and promotions — for the owner's review and posting process. Draft
 outreach and follow-up campaigns to past customers and new prospects. Keep online listings accurate and active and flag review opportunities. Track what works: report weekly on outreach volume, responses, quotes generated, and content performance.

3. Taking Orders (Intake & Quoting Support): Respond to inquiries fast — same business day, ideally within the hour during work hours — by
, phone, and website form. Gather complete order details from customers: items, quantities, sizes, colors, artwork/logo files, deadlines, and delivery method. Coordinate artwork and mockups with the production team and send them to customers for approval. Prepare quotes from the company's price menus and send invoices (Square) once the customer approves. Confirm payment status before an order is released to production.

4. Making Sure Orders Are Fulfilled & Reach the Customer: Track every open order on the order board: status, deadline, blanks status, production stage, and next action — reviewed daily. Coordinate blank-garment ordering with suppliers (e.g., SanMar) so materials are in hand before production dates; flag stock problems and confirm substitutes with customers early. Chase anything stuck: missing artwork, unapproved mockups, unpaid invoices, out-of-stock items — and escalate to the owner before a deadline is at risk. Arrange customer pickup at the shop, and pack and ship orders for customers who need shipping: prepare shipping labels, confirm addresses, send tracking numbers, and verify delivery. Send completion messages, confirm the customer received everything, and close the order out — including asking for a review and noting reorder potential.

5. Customer Care & Administration: Be the friendly, reliable point of contact. Handle routine questions about services, pricing ranges, turnaround, and order policies (all confirmed orders are final — store credit only). Maintain organized records: orders, invoices, artwork files, and customer history.



What This Role Does NOT Do: No production work — you will not print, stitch, or operate equipment. No spending or ordering on company accounts beyond what the owner approves. No public posts, ads, or commitments go out in the company's name without the owner's approval.



Requirements: 1+ years as a virtual assistant, sales/outreach assistant, customer service representative, or order coordinator. Experience with print shops, apparel, e-commerce, or B2B services is a strong plus. Sales mindset: comfortable doing outreach and follow-ups every day. Organization: you live in trackers and checklists. Communication: clear, professional written English; friendly and confident on the phone and in messages. Tools:

title: Executive Assistant (Procurement & Bids)
description:
Job summary:

Be the CEO's right hand on public-sector bids. Own every deadline, document and submission, and use Claude to keep it all on track.



Meet Mosaic Effect:

Mosaic Effect is an expert-led privacy, cybersecurity and AI governance consultancy. We win most of our work through public-sector procurement: federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector tenders, supply arrangements, vendor rosters, and contract roles placed through staffing agencies.



The machinery is already built: daily portal and
 sweeps, one opportunity tracker, a stage-gated proposal process, templates, and a submission guide for every portal we use.



The role:

You are the CEO's executive assistant for everything procurement. You own the calendar and the paperwork: no deadline missed, every addendum read the day it posts, every submission in early, complete and on the record.

You take instructions and carry them through precisely. You don't write the technical substance of proposals; the CEO and our consultants do that. You make sure it comes together, gets checked and goes in on time.

You report directly to Sukhpreet Singh, CEO, and work with our consultants, staffing agencies and public-sector buyers.



Who this is for

• You follow instructions to the letter, and you ask when something is unclear instead of guessing.

• You can hold a dozen close dates in your head and never drop one.

• You read the fine print in a solicitation before anyone asks you to.

• You'd rather be done two days early than submit at the last minute.

• You already use Claude or similar AI tools every day, and you always check their work.

• You keep confidential information confidential.



What we expect from you

The work follows each bid from first sighting to final debrief.



1. Find and log opportunities (daily and weekly)

    ◦ Run the daily procurement digest (portal scrapes, bid-notice
s, agency requisitions) and log what's new in the opportunity tracker.

    ◦ Run the weekly procurement pulse across federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector sources for privacy, cybersecurity and AI-consulting work.

    ◦ Coordinate the portal assistant's weekday sweeps of login-only portals. A portal nobody reached is logged as "not checked", never "nothing found".

    ◦ Track signals that aren't bids yet: job postings that could become contracts, upcoming vendor rosters, contract-award intelligence from access-to-information requests, and loss debriefs.



2. Qualify and plan

    ◦ Prepare a one-page bid brief and a compliance matrix for each opportunity: mandatory requirements, scoring, insurance, security, certifications, references and submission method.

    ◦ Flag hard blockers early (insurance limits, WSIB, ISO 27001, clearances, certifications, vehicle-holder-only eligibility) and bring each to the CEO as a go/no-go decision.

    ◦ Build each bid's timeline backward from the close and hold the T-48-hour tripwire: everything is complete two days before close, or the CEO hears about it that day.



3. Run bid production

    ◦ Set up the bid folder from templates and keep documents versioned (v0.x drafts, v1.0 approved).

    ◦ Collect inputs on time: consultant résumés and consents, references and referee consent, corporate documents, insurance certificates, signatures and forms.

    ◦ Run the completeness check against the compliance matrix before review, and track feedback through the green-light gates.

    ◦ Send buyer questions within the question period once the CEO approves them. Download every addendum and Q&A the day it posts and update the matrix.



4. Submit and keep records

    ◦ Assemble the final package and, after CEO approval, submit through the correct portal or by
 at least 24 hours before close.

    ◦ Save proof of submission (receipts, confirmation numbers, screenshots) and file the submitted set.

    ◦ Track outcomes, request a debrief on every loss and log the lessons.



5. Agencies, rosters and registrations

    ◦ Manage staffing-agency requisitions: right-to-represent forms, résumé versions and availability confirmations, with a strict one-person, one-channel rule per requisition.

    ◦ Maintain vendor registrations and portal accounts: CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, BC Bid, Alberta Purchasing Connection, SaskTenders, Biddingo, bids&tenders and others. Track renewal dates, document fees and supplier profiles.

    ◦ Keep corporate compliance documents current and ready to attach: certificate of status, insurance certificates, WSIB/WorkSafeBC, security clearance records and supplier numbers.



6. Report

    ◦ Keep the opportunity tracker current every day: stage, close date, next action and owner.

    ◦ Send the CEO a short daily status: what closes in the next 14 days, what's blocked and what needs a decision.

    ◦ Keep an accurate work log. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.



Working with AI and Claude

AI runs a large part of our daily machinery, and Claude is the main tool you'll work with. You direct it, check it and own the result.

• Use Claude to summarize solicitations, draft compliance matrices and bid briefs, and spot mandatory requirements.

• Use Claude to draft buyer and agency
s, daily status notes and tracker updates for the CEO's approval.

• Run and supervise the AI-assisted daily digest and portal sweeps, and confirm each source was actually checked.

• Check every AI output against the source documents before it's used. AI drafts; you verify.

• Give clear, specific instructions to Claude, and improve the prompts and checklists the team relies on.



Requirements

• Exceptional organization and deadline discipline across many parallel close dates.

• Careful reading of solicitation documents: mandatory requirements, evaluation criteria, forms, and insurance and security clauses.

• Strong Word and Excel skills: tracked changes, document assembly, PDF packaging and trackers.

• Clear, concise written English for drafting
s to buyers and agencies.

• Daily, hands-on use of Claude or similar AI tools, with the habit of checking their output.

• Discretion with confidential commercial information.

• Can work EST Timezone.



Nice to have

• 2+ years in executive assistance, bid or proposal coordination, procurement administration or contract administration, ideally with Canadian public-sector tenders.

• Hands-on use of Canadian procurement portals such as CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, Ariba, Jaggaer or BC Bid.

• Familiarity with federal supply arrangements and methods of supply (TBIPS, TSPS, SBIPS, ProServices), standing offers and vendor-of-record arrangements.

• Exposure to privacy, cybersecurity or IT consulting procurement.

• Experience with staffing-agency requisitions and right-to-represent processes.



Results

• Zero missed deadlines and zero late or incomplete submissions.

• Every addendum and Q&A downloaded and reflected in the bid within one business day of posting.

• A go/no-go decision on every live opportunity within two business days of intake.

• Every submission in at least 24 hours early, with proof on file.

• A tracker that's accurate at any moment, with no "unknown" status older than a week.

• A debrief requested on every loss.



How we work

• The CEO approves anything that leaves the company: submissions, prices, signatures, declarations, and
s to buyers or agencies. You prepare each one so it only needs a yes.

• Portal logins live in a password manager. Credentials are never shared by
 or stored in documents.

• Everything lives in one shared folder, one tracker and one log.



How to apply

Interested?

- 2-week paid trial: You learn our systems, complete the recurring tasks with supervision and write down what you learn so you only ask once.

- Month 1: Recurring tasks are done on time with little checking needed, and you keep your own checklists and procedures.

- Month 3: You issue invoices on your own, rosters and events run without reminders, and you’ve delivered at least one improvement that saves us measurable time.



Must have

- 2+ years’ VA or admin experience with overseas clients (Australian clients preferred)

- Daily, practical use of ChatGPT and/or Claude for real work

Big pluses

- Rostering or scheduling experience

- You’ve built automations, templates or AI workflows that removed manual work



Schedule

Monday–Friday, 3 hours a day, in a fixed block between 9am and 5pm Sydney time. Sydney is currently 3 hours ahead of the Philippines (2 hours from April to October), so the role falls roughly between 6am and 2pm Philippine time. Tell us which block you can commit to.

title: Graphic Designer – Static Ads & E-Commerce
description:

You have a strong eye for modern design and know how to communicate ideas clearly through visuals.

You do not just want to create attractive graphics. You want to design creatives that capture attention, communicate a clear message, and contribute to measurable results.

At FUSSKLEIDUNG, your main focus will be creating static performance creatives for our paid advertising campaigns. You will also support the visual development of our brand across social media, our online store, landing pages, and other marketing channels.

• Conceptualize and design static performance creatives for our paid social campaigns.

• Develop different creative concepts, designs, and variations for ongoing testing.

• Translate marketing messages, promotions, and product benefits into visually compelling advertisements.

• Collaborate with our marketing team to understand which creatives perform well and turn those insights into new design approaches.

• Create organic content for our social media channels.

• Design shop banners, product graphics, landing page elements, and other visual marketing materials.

• Continuously improve our visual brand identity and ensure a modern and consistent appearance across all channels.

• Work closely with our performance marketing, content, and e-commerce teams.

• Proactively contribute your own ideas and incorporate relevant design trends into our creative processes.



– What We Offer –

• 100% Remote Work: This is a fully remote position that allows you to work professionally from home.

• Visible Impact: Your designs will be used directly in our advertising campaigns, social media channels, and online store. You will be able to see how your work influences both our brand and our marketing performance.

• Creative Freedom: You will receive clear goals and structured briefs while still having room to develop your own visual ideas and approaches.

• Ownership Instead of Micromanagement: You will independently manage your tasks and take responsibility for the quality and timely delivery of your work.

• Direct and Honest Feedback: Our feedback is clear, constructive, and focused on improvement. We value open communication without unnecessary politics.

• Structured Work Environment: You will work with clear processes, established workflows, and defined creative strategies rather than constant chaos or unclear priorities.

• Meaningful Development: You will improve through real responsibility, regular feedback, and hands-on experience across different creative formats.

• Professional Software and Tools: We provide and cover the cost of all software, licenses, and digital tools required for your role, including Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and other necessary applications.

• Paid Time Off: You will receive 10 paid vacation days, 5 paid sick days, and 10 selected paid Philippine public holidays per year.



– Your Profile –

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Communication Design, Multimedia Arts, Fine Arts, Media Design, or a comparable creative field.

• You have relevant professional experience in graphic or media design, ideally within e-commerce, direct-to-consumer brands, or performance marketing.

• You have a strong understanding of aesthetics, typography, color, visual hierarchy, composition, and image selection.

• You can create designs that look modern and professional while also being clear and attention-grabbing.

• Ideally, you have already created static ads for Meta, social media campaigns, or other digital advertising channels.

• You understand that performance creatives must do more than look good. They must communicate a clear message and support measurable business results.

• You are highly proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or comparable professional design software.

• You can quickly understand different target audiences, products, offers, and communication angles.

• You work in a structured and reliable manner and can implement feedback quickly and carefully.

• You show initiative and are motivated to take responsibility for the visual development of a growing brand.

• A strong portfolio with relevant design samples is mandatory.



– Role Details –

• Contract Type: Full-time Independent Contractor

• Working Hours: 8 working hours per day plus a 45-minute unpaid break.

• Flexible Start Time: You can start your workday between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. Philippine Time. Your schedule should allow for sufficient collaboration and overlap with our team in Germany.

• Monthly Compensation: USD 1,000–1,200, depending on your experience and the quality of your portfolio.

• Work Setup: As this is a fully remote position, you must have your own reliable computer, a stable internet connection, and a suitable home-working environment. All professional software, licenses, and digital tools required for the role will be provided and paid for by FUSSKLEIDUNG.



– About Us –

FUSSKLEIDUNG is a direct-to-consumer outdoor footwear brand with more than one million customers across German-speaking Europe and annual revenue in the eight-figure range.

Our team currently consists of approximately 30 employees and continues to grow.

We have developed from a start-up into a structured e-commerce company with clear processes, defined responsibilities, and high standards for quality and execution.

We do not operate like a traditional retailer. We develop and manage our own products, from the initial idea through to marketing and sales.

Our day-to-day work is defined by ownership, reliability, and a strong focus on execution. We make data-driven decisions, work in a structured way, and move projects forward quickly.

At the same time, we still have ambitious plans. We see significant growth potential in our existing markets and plan to expand the FUSSKLEIDUNG brand internationally over the coming years.

This creates an environment with genuine ownership, meaningful creative freedom, and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to actively shape the visual identity of FUSSKLEIDUNG and make a direct contribution to both our brand and our continued growth.

Applications without a relevant portfolio cannot be considered.

title: B2B COLD CALLER: 150+ DIALS A DAY. TOP PAY. ZERO HAND-HOLDING.

Rejection still bothers you.

Fluent, clear, confident English

A quiet workspace, a quality headset, and stable fast internet with a backup

No voice message, no reply. A generic CV on its own, no reply. If the subject line or WhatsApp number is missing, you didn’t read the post, so no reply.



If you’re the best caller on every team you’ve worked on and you’re tired of being underpaid, apply. Everyone else, please don’t waste your time or ours.

title: Experienced Cold Caller — US Business Owners (B2B Outbound) | 6+ Hours Daily
description:
Read this whole post before applying. Applications that don’t follow the instructions at the bottom will not get a reply.



We book meetings for US plumbing and HVAC companies. You call the business owner cold — he did not ask for the call and is not expecting it — qualify him in a few questions, and book a specific meeting time. We run the meeting and close it.



We give you the lead list, the script, the dialler and the training. You are not finding leads and you are not selling. You make the calls and book the meetings.



Pay:

$50 for every qualified meeting that actually happens

$600 when a client signs from one of your meetings — that’s 40% of the setup fee. A bigger client at $3,000 setup pays you $1,200

7.5% of that client’s monthly fee, every month they stay with us



An average month once you know the script is around 18 meetings. With two closes that’s about $2,100.



This is commission-only for the first month. No base, no hourly, no guaranteed minimum. After one month, if you’re delivering 10–12 held qualified meetings, we get on a call and set up a base on top of the commission. I don’t put anyone on a base before I’ve seen them work.



If commission-only doesn’t work for your situation right now, don’t apply. I’d rather you keep your time and I keep mine.



This role is NOT for beginners. If you have never cold called a stranger who did not ask to hear from you, please do not apply.



Requirements — all of them, no exceptions:



1. At least 1–2 years of outbound COLD calling. Truly cold: people who did not request a call. Inbound, customer service, warm leads, opted-in leads and follow-ups do not count.

2. Experience calling business owners (B2B) is a strong plus. Calling US homeowners also counts.

3. Fully fluent, clear English. A busy US owner must understand you in the first three seconds.

4. 6+ hours of dialling a day, Monday to Friday, starting 8:00 AM US Eastern (9:00 PM Manila). This is a night shift. Only apply if you can hold it every week.

5. Comfortable with high volume, 150+ dials a day, and with hearing “no” all day without it affecting the next call.

6. Your own computer, headset, quiet room and stable internet, plus a real backup for power and internet (inverter, generator, mobile data).

7. Every call is recorded. If that bothers you, this isn’t for you.



Who we want: someone driven and hungry who always wants more. Someone who doesn’t stop at 150 dials because the number is hit, but keeps going as long as the leads and the hours allow. Takes coaching, fixes what isn’t working, and never blames the list.



Timeline: we’re hiring over the next two weeks and review every complete application within 3 days.



To apply, your application message must include all of the following:



1. Your WhatsApp number with country code

2. How many years of cold outbound calling you have, and who you were calling (business owners or homeowners, and which country)

3. Your average dials per day in your last cold-calling role

4. In 3–4 sentences: the hardest cold call you’ve made, and what you actually said

5. A link to a 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) of you reading this as if on a real call: “Hi, is this the owner? I’ll be quick — I work with plumbing and HVAC companies on the estimates that never turned into jobs. Roughly how many estimates does your team send out in a week?”



Applications missing any of the five will not get a reply.

title: Senior Expert SEO / AEO / GEO & Google Business Page and Ads — Plastic Surgery
description:
**IMMEDIATE HIRE NEEDED**



AP Aesthetics is a growing plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgery practice based in Southlake, Texas, serving the Dallas–Fort Worth metropolitan area and patients traveling nationally for specialized surgical care.



We are seeking an experienced Senior SEO, AI Search Optimization, and Paid Digital Advertising Specialist to take ownership of our online visibility, organic search performance, Google Business Profile, and paid advertising campaigns.



Our objective is to become one of the most prominent plastic surgery practices in Dallas–Fort Worth across Google Search, Google Maps, AI-generated recommendations, and procedure-specific searches.



This is a senior, hands-on position, not a general virtual assistant or entry-level social media role.



We have hired a dedicated Business Systems and Automation Developer who manages our website functionality, Microsoft 365, APIs, CRM integrations, and technical development. You will work directly with this developer to optimize our website, implement tracking, develop marketing campaigns, and improve our digital presence.



We want someone who independently identifies opportunities, implements solutions, and demonstrates measurable results.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMIZATION (SEO)



Conduct comprehensive technical, on-page, and off-page SEO audits.



Develop competitive SEO strategies targeting plastic surgery and aesthetic procedures throughout Dallas–Fort Worth.



Perform advanced keyword research, competitor analysis, search-intent mapping, and content-gap analysis.



Optimize website titles, metadata, headings, internal links, URLs, images, schema markup, and website architecture.



Collaborate with our developer to improve Core Web Vitals, mobile performance, indexing, crawlability, redirects, and technical SEO.



Develop and optimize procedure pages, physician profiles, educational resources, and appropriate location-specific pages.



Implement ethical link-building and digital PR strategies to strengthen our practice's online authority.



Monitor organic rankings, website traffic, qualified leads, and consultation conversions.



AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION (AEO / GEO)



Improve our visibility in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI-powered search platforms.



Develop strategies that make our practice, physicians, credentials, and specialized surgical services accurately discoverable and attributable.



Optimize content structure, expert authorship, entity recognition, structured data, and authoritative references.



Identify search queries where competing plastic surgeons are recommended but our practice is absent.



Track AI-generated brand mentions, citations, and search visibility.



Repurpose physician-led podcasts, transcripts, educational videos, and clinical expertise into original, medically accurate website content.



Our content must reflect our actual surgeon, experience, and practice. We are not interested in generic, mass-produced AI articles.



LOCAL SEO AND GOOGLE BUSINESS PROFILE



Fully optimize and maintain our Google Business Profile.



Improve Google Maps visibility and local search rankings.



Maintain accurate business information, categories, services, photos, and practice updates.



Develop compliant reputation management and patient review strategies.



Manage local business citations, directories, and consistent business information.



Monitor local search performance throughout Southlake, Dallas, Fort Worth, Grapevine, Keller, Westlake, and surrounding communities.



GOOGLE ADS AND PAID SEARCH MANAGEMENT



Independently develop, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.



Conduct paid keyword research, geographic targeting, competitor analysis, and negative keyword optimization.



Manage Google Search campaigns and other appropriate advertising formats.



Optimize bidding strategies, campaign budgets, ad copy, landing pages, and conversion paths.



Establish accurate tracking for consultation requests, telephone calls, qualified leads, and confirmed appointments.



Monitor cost per lead, cost per qualified consultation, conversion rates, advertising efficiency, and lead quality.



Recommend advertising budget adjustments based on actual performance.



We require demonstrated experience managing meaningful Google Ads budgets and improving campaign performance.



ANALYTICS, PIXELS, AND CONVERSION TRACKING



Configure and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console, and Google Ads conversion tracking.



Coordinate with our developer regarding Meta Pixel, Meta Conversions API, TikTok Pixel, and other approved advertising integrations.



Implement geographic targeting and appropriate geofencing strategies where permitted.



Establish UTM tracking, campaign attribution, event tracking, and reporting.



Coordinate with our designated CRM to measure the lead journey from search or advertisement to consultation booking.



Identify and correct duplicate conversions, missing tracking events, and inaccurate reporting.



Ensure all tracking and advertising practices comply with applicable HIPAA requirements, healthcare advertising rules, privacy regulations, and platform policies.



CONTENT MARKETING AND CONVERSION OPTIMIZATION



Develop an SEO-driven content calendar covering plastic surgery, aesthetic medicine, and specialized reconstructive procedures.



Work with our surgeon and marketing staff to develop credible, medically reviewed educational content.



Optimize website calls to action, consultation forms, booking buttons, landing pages, and conversion funnels.



Recommend improvements to website user experience and patient acquisition workflows.



Coordinate with video editors and social media personnel to repurpose content for YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, and our website.



Ensure social media and video content support our broader search visibility and lead-generation objectives.



ADDITIONAL SKILLS — HIGHLY DESIRABLE



Graphic design using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or Figma.



Landing page design and conversion rate optimization.



WordPress SEO and technical website optimization.



Google Ads certification.



Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Suite experience.



YouTube SEO and YouTube Shorts optimization.



CRM experience.



Social media marketing and content repurposing.



Looker Studio, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and other professional SEO tools.



Experience working with plastic surgery, dermatology, medical aesthetics, cosmetic medicine, or other competitive healthcare practices.



Graphic design and social media experience are valuable complementary skills, but advanced SEO, AEO/GEO, and Google Ads expertise are the primary requirements.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS



At least five years of substantial professional SEO experience, preferably in competitive U.S. markets.



Proven experience personally managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns.



Strong knowledge of technical SEO, local SEO, keyword research, and conversion tracking.



Familiarity with modern AI search optimization strategies.



Ability to independently audit websites and recommend actionable improvements.



Experience collaborating with website developers and automation specialists.



Excellent written English and communication skills.



Ability to use analytics and performance data to guide decisions.



Availability for 40-50 dedicated hours per week, with at least five hours of daily overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.



Willingness to disclose existing employment or client commitments and comply with our outside-engagement, confidentiality, and data security requirements.



FIRST 30 DAYS — EXPECTED DELIVERABLES



Complete a comprehensive website SEO, AI search visibility, Google Business Profile, and Google Ads audit.



Perform competitor research and keyword opportunity analysis for DFW plastic surgery.



Identify high-priority technical, content, and local search improvements.



Develop a coordinated implementation plan with our systems developer.



Audit analytics, pixels, conversion tracking, and campaign attribution.



Present a prioritized 90-day marketing strategy with measurable objectives and realistic milestones.



ONGOING PERFORMANCE MEASURES



Organic search visibility for priority procedures and locations.



Google Maps and local search performance.



Qualified organic and paid leads.



Consultation bookings and lead-to-consultation conversion rates.



Google Ads efficiency and lead quality.



AI search visibility, relevant brand mentions, and citations.



Consistent monthly performance reporting with actionable recommendations.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide the following:



Your resume and professional portfolio.



Two or three websites where you personally led SEO improvements, with measurable before-and-after results.



Examples of Google Ads campaigns you managed, including approximate budgets, conversion metrics, and outcomes.



A brief explanation of how you would improve a plastic surgery practice's rankings in Google Search, Google Maps, and AI-generated recommendations.



Your experience with GA4, GTM, Google Search Console, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and marketing attribution.



Your experience collaborating with website developers and CRM automation specialists.



Any graphic design, content creation, or social media marketing experience.



Confirmation that you accept $1800 USD/month, can provide 40-50 dedicated hours per week, and can maintain at least five hours of overlap with U.S. Central Time.



To confirm that you read this posting, begin your application with the phrase: DFW SEARCH STRATEGY.



We will prioritize candidates who provide verifiable performance results, specific project examples, and clear explanations of work they personally performed.



Selected applicants will be invited to a technical interview and may be asked to complete a short paid assessment using publicly available website and search information.



We are looking for a long-term specialist who will take genuine ownership of our digital growth, not someone who simply produces generic SEO reports or follows a checklist.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

8. Document & File Organization

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

Position Overview:

title: Social Media Content & Growth Specialist
description:
Part-Time | 12–15 Hours/Week Initially | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



The New Pink Paradigm™ | U.S.-Based Women's Wellness & Breast Cancer Survivor Brand



About Us



The New Pink Paradigm™ (NPP) is a growing, survivor-led movement dedicated to helping women affected by breast cancer rediscover their voice, embrace new possibilities, and live life more fully, on their own terms.



We offer books, guided journals, digital experiences, webinars, and educational programs designed specifically for breast cancer survivors.



Our message is thoughtful, encouraging, sometimes provocative, and always respectful. We believe in asking meaningful questions, opening conversations, and helping women recognize that their lives are about more than a diagnosis.



We are now ready to significantly expand our social media presence, strengthen our community, and build consistent interest in our products and programs.



Who We're Looking For



We're seeking a creative, proactive Social Media Content & Growth Specialist who enjoys developing ideas, creating compelling content, growing audiences, and helping turn engagement into meaningful business results.



This is not simply a posting or Canva design position.



We want someone who thinks strategically, brings original ideas, understands organic social media growth, and enjoys building something from the ground up.



You'll work directly with the founder and have access to an extensive library of original content, including books, journal prompts, interviews, webinars, educational materials, and personal stories.



Our initial focus is breast cancer survivors. You do not need a medical background or personal experience with breast cancer, but you must be comfortable working with sensitive health-related topics, learning about our audience, and communicating with empathy and authenticity.



Platforms



Our initial priorities are:






Instagram



TikTok



YouTube, particularly YouTube Shorts



We also have an X account that may be incorporated as our strategy develops.



Key Responsibilities



Content Strategy & Creation



Develop creative content ideas aligned with our mission, audience, and business goals.



Create engaging short-form videos, Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok videos, carousels, and graphics.



Repurpose existing books, interviews, webinars, and founder-provided content into engaging social media posts.



Write strong hooks, captions, and calls to action in natural, conversational American English.



Develop monthly content calendars and organize content into efficient production batches.



Recommend founder-led video ideas and prepare simple scripts or talking points when appropriate.



Audience Growth & Community Development



Develop and implement organic growth strategies across our platforms.



Research audience interests, relevant trends, and content opportunities.



Encourage meaningful conversations, shares, saves, and community participation.



Help grow an engaged audience of women who connect with our message.



Monitor engagement and identify opportunities to improve reach and audience connection.



Marketing & Business Growth



Support launches and ongoing promotion of books, journals, webinars, and digital programs.



Create content that encourages interested followers to visit our website, join our
 community, register for events, or explore our products.



Understand the difference between content designed for awareness, engagement, and sales.



Track meaningful performance indicators, including follower growth, engagement, website traffic, and conversions when data is available.



Recommend improvements based on performance rather than simply repeating the same posting routine.



What We're Looking For



Demonstrated experience managing and growing social media accounts organically.



Strong short-form video editing and content creation skills.



Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.



Ability to independently develop content ideas and creative strategies.



Excellent written English, especially for a U.S. audience.



Proficiency with Canva, Metricool, Capcut, or similar tools, and social media scheduling platforms.



Comfortable using AI tools thoughtfully to support research, brainstorming, and content production.



Experience promoting digital products, books, courses, webinars, or online services is highly desirable.



Organized, dependable, responsive, and comfortable working independently.



Willingness to collaborate, receive feedback, and continually improve.



Experience with women's wellness, personal development, education, coaching, or mission-driven brands is a plus but not a requirement..



How We'll Work Together



We prefer a collaborative monthly planning and batch-production approach.



We'll establish overall messaging, priorities, upcoming launches, and content themes together. You'll then take ownership of developing, creating, scheduling, and optimizing the content.



We value initiative and creativity. We do not want to micromanage someone who knows their craft.



At the same time, this is a collaborative role. You should enjoy exchanging ideas, understanding the founder's vision, and bringing your own recommendations to the table.



We expect to begin with approximately 12–15 hours per week, with the possibility of expanding as our social media presence and business grow.



How to Apply



Please include:



A brief introduction explaining why this opportunity interests you.



Links to two or three social media accounts you've personally helped manage or grow, explaining your specific role.



Examples of short-form videos or other content you've created.



One example of measurable growth or business results you've helped achieve. Please distinguish between results you directly managed and campaigns you supported.



Your hourly rate and availability for part-time work.



Your experience, if any, promoting books, digital products, webinars, or online courses.



One additional question:



Imagine you're helping introduce a new brand dedicated to breast cancer survivors who want to live more fully and reclaim their personal voice.



What is one creative social media idea you would suggest to begin attracting the right audience?



We are not looking for a lengthy marketing proposal. We simply want to get a sense of how you think creatively.



The Opportunity



This is an opportunity to help build the social media presence of a growing movement with an established foundation, original intellectual property, multiple products, and significant room for expansion.



We're looking for someone who wants to contribute ideas, develop professionally, and grow with us over time.



If you enjoy meaningful content, creative independence, audience development, and seeing your work contribute to real business results, we'd love to hear from you.



The New Pink Paradigm™



Your Healing Journey. Your Way. No Apology.

title: Virtual Appointment Setter for a U.S. Strength Gym
description:
# Virtual Appointment Setter for a U.S. Strength Gym



**Location:** Remote, based in the Philippines  

**Compensation:** Fixed monthly salary preferred, equivalent to $4.25 to $6.25 USD per hour based on experience and agreed weekly hours  

**Schedule:** Preferred coverage between 9 AM and 5 PM Pacific Time. We’re open to a flexible schedule that gives new leads a fast response during agreed coverage hours.



Nightmare Muscle Gym is a strength gym in Sacramento, California. We welcome everyone from first time lifters to competitive athletes. You’ll be the first person many prospective members hear from, and your job is to help them feel comfortable enough to come in and see the gym for themselves.



You’ll work directly with our **lead generation specialist** and **gym general manager**. Our lead generation specialist brings in inquiries, you contact prospects and book tours, and our general manager coordinates the visit and shares the outcome so you know who needs a follow up.



**What you’ll do**



- **Respond quickly to new leads.** Aim to call within five minutes during your agreed coverage hours. If they don’t answer, send a short, personal text and set a reminder to follow up.

- **Book gym tours.** Ask what the person wants from a gym, answer questions about memberships, pricing, equipment, access, day passes, and coaching, then offer two available tour times.

- **Help people show up.** Send confirmations and reminders. Give the gym team a quick note about what each visitor is looking for.

- **Follow up with existing leads and missed appointments.** Help people reschedule, reconnect with older inquiries, and check in with visitors who are still d
. You can batch this outreach at flexible times around inbound coverage.

- **Keep the lead tracker current.** Record contact attempts, tour bookings, attendance, and next steps so everyone knows where each lead stands.



We’ll provide training on the gym, current pricing, common questions, and call and text templates. We may need extra hours in the first two weeks for training and to work through existing leads. We’ll track response time, tours booked, and tours attended.



**What we’re looking for**



- Clear spoken English and strong written English for calls and texts.

- Experience in appointment setting, inbound sales, or customer service by phone.

- A warm, confident phone presence and the ability to give people a clear next step.

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and consistent availability during agreed hours.

- Conversational Spanish is welcome and entirely optional. Experience with gyms, local service businesses, or GymMaster is a plus.



**How to apply**



Use **Nightmare Muscle Appointment Setter** as your subject line. Include a short summary of your phone experience

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
# Software Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer — Product & Systems



**Location:** Remote (Worldwide / Philippines)  

**Type:** Full-Time Independent Contractor (40 hours/week)  

**Schedule:** Requires at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time (between 6:00 AM and 7:00 PM CT)  



---



## About the Role & the Platform



We build a modern, multi-tenant SaaS platform that powers core business operations—managing real-time scheduling, reservations, customer accounts, memberships, communications, and automated payment processing.



Businesses rely on our software to run their daily operations end-to-end. When software fails here, the impact is immediate and painful: if a payment webhook drops, a business loses revenue; if a concurrency check fails, two customers are double-booked for the same resource; if state fails to update after a cancellation, a customer is left confused and frustrated.



We are looking for an analytical, product-minded **Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer** who takes pride in finding what breaks before real users ever encounter it.



---



## Our Philosophy: Power Tools, Not Autopilot



We build and ship with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLMs for automated test generation and synthetic data). We embrace them and expect you to leverage them to move faster.



However, **we do not put QA on autopilot.**



AI tools are notorious for testing only the "happy path." They write tests that pass on the surface, hallucinate assertions, miss subtle race conditions, overlook state leaks across tenants, and have zero intuition for how real humans actually navigate software in stressful, fast-paced environments.



We are looking for someone who uses AI as a power tool to accelerate test creation and explore edge cases, but who possesses the **deep QA fundamentals, technical skepticism, and engineering judgment** to inspect diffs, verify what the AI produced, and drill into the dark corners AI forgets to look.



---



## What You’ll Do



You won't just follow static test checklists or passively file "it broke" tickets. You will act as the critical bridge between product requirements and production reliability:



* **Own End-to-End & Exploratory Testing:** Test newly shipped features across desktop web, mobile web, and tablet interfaces before release. Push past the obvious path to test real-world user behavior, interruptions, and awkward workflows.

* **Investigate Root Causes (DevTools & Systems Deep Dive):** When something breaks, you don't just screenshot the UI. You open browser DevTools, inspect the Network tab (request payloads, headers, response status codes), review console errors, check database state or API contracts, and provide developers with clean, reproducible isolation of the root issue.

* **Tackle Concurrency & Financial Edge Cases:** Test the hard problems: double-booking race conditions, duplicate payment webhooks, expired credit packs, cancellation cut-off windows, timezone/DST shifts, and multi-tenant data isolation (ensuring Tenant A never sees Tenant B's data).

* **AI-Assisted Test Automation (Playwright & TypeScript):** Help build, maintain, and expand our automated regression suites using Playwright. Use AI to draft tests quickly, but enforce robust assertions, resilient locators, and clean test architecture.

* **Advocate for UX and Product Quality:** Think like a product owner. If a flow is confusing, if an error message doesn't explain what went wrong, if a button lacks a loading spinner, or if a mobile layout feels cramped, you flag it and help improve it without waiting for an official ticket.

* **Gate Releases & Communicate Clearly:** Assess release readiness. Clearly communicate blockers, risks, and test coverage to the team in concise written updates.



---



## Who You Are



* **Proven QA Experience:** 3+ years in software quality assurance for modern web and mobile SaaS applications, with hands-on experience in both exploratory testing and test automation.

* **Deeply Analytical Mind:** You love puzzles and edge cases. You naturally ask: *"What happens if the user double-clicks this? What happens if their network drops mid-checkout? What happens if they cancel 1 minute after the policy deadline?"*

* **DevTools & Technical Fluency:** Comfortable inspecting HTTP requests, REST APIs, JSON payloads, browser local storage, and database relationships. You understand the architecture behind modern web applications (TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL).

* **Product Thinker:** You don't just test against a spec; you evaluate whether the feature actually solves the customer’s problem and feels intuitive to use.

* **AI-Proficient & Critical:** You actively use AI tools to generate test ideas, write automation scripts, or analyze edge cases, but you review every line of output and never trust an AI-generated green checkmark without verifying it yourself.

* **Exceptional Written Async Communication:** You write concise, high-signal bug reports with clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and relevant logs. You default to visibility—sharing progress daily and raising blockers early.



---



## Role Details



* **Position:** Full-time Independent Contractor (40 hours/week).

* **Working Hours:** Flexibility on your primary hours, but **must provide at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time (CT)** between 6:00 AM and 7:00 PM CT (Monday through Friday).



---



**In your application, please provide:**

* A link to your resume or CV.

* Your earliest available start date.

* Your specific available daily working hours and confirmed US Central Time overlap window.

* Your desired compensation
