title: Senior Accountant – E-Commerce & Bookkeeping
description:
SENIOR ACCOUNTANT – E-COMMERCE & BOOKKEEPING



Synergy Wetsuits | Remote – Philippines | Independent Contractor



Rate: $10–$13 USD/hour DOE

Schedule: Monday–Friday, starting at 12:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Hours: 20 hours/week initially, with flexibility for up to 30 hours

Experience: 5+ years of professional accounting experience required





ABOUT THE POSITION



Synergy Wetsuits is looking for an experienced, hands-on accountant to independently manage our bookkeeping, reconciliations, and month-end financial reporting.



We're a U.S.-based e-commerce company operating through Shopify, Amazon, wholesale, and international markets. Our accounting systems include QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise, Webgility, and Airwallex.



This isn't a basic bookkeeping position. We need someone who understands accounting principles, investigates discrepancies, recognizes errors, and takes ownership of resolving them—not someone who simply enters transactions or waits for instructions.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage daily bookkeeping, including AP, AR, vendor payments, deposits, refunds, journal entries, and general ledger maintenance.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and clearing accounts.

• Reconcile Shopify and Amazon settlements, including sales, fees, refunds, taxes, and deposits.

• Investigate Webgility integration issues, incorrect postings, missing transactions, and reconciliation discrepancies.

• Handle multi-currency transactions, foreign exchange differences, inventory accounting, and COGS.

• Independently manage month-end close, including balance sheet reconciliations, adjusting entries, and financial reporting, by the second Thursday of the following month.

• Identify accounting errors, investigate root causes, and implement lasting corrections.

• Improve accounting procedures, internal controls, and automation to reduce manual work.





QUALIFICATIONS



• 5+ years of professional accounting experience, preferably with U.S.-based businesses.

• Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, financial statements, and journal entries.

• Advanced QuickBooks experience; QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise preferred.

• Proven experience independently managing reconciliations and month-end close.

• E-commerce accounting experience, preferably Shopify and Amazon.

• Knowledge of inventory accounting, COGS, and multi-currency transactions.

• Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookups, and financial analysis.

• Excellent English communication, attention to detail, and independent problem-solving.

• Accounting degree or CPA qualification preferred.

• Experience with Webgility and Airwallex is a plus.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Someone who takes ownership of the numbers, follows through, and doesn't consider a task complete until the results have been verified.



If an account doesn't reconcile, you investigate why. If something looks wrong, you research it and determine the appropriate correction.



We don't expect you to know our business on day one. We do expect you to bring the accounting knowledge and initiative needed to learn it.



Our goal is to have someone who can independently manage our complete accounting function, continually improve processes, and help automate repetitive work.





WORK SCHEDULE & COMMUNICATION



• Monday–Friday, 12:00 PM–4:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time (20 hours/week initially).

• Flexibility to extend to 6:00 PM Pacific for up to 30 hours/week, with prior approval.

• Manila time: 4:00–8:00 AM (PST) or 3:00–7:00 AM (PDT), the following day. Extended hours end at 10:00 AM or 9:00 AM, respectively.

• Schedule follows U.S. Pacific Time, including daylight saving adjustments.

• Must be punctual, available during scheduled hours, and proactive in communicating issues.

• Expected to independently troubleshoot accounting and software problems before escalating, and to raise unresolved issues promptly during business hours.

• Provide a brief end-of-shift update covering completed work, pending items, and follow-ups.

• Routine questions and nonurgent issues should be addressed during scheduled working hours.

• Additional approved hours may be available during month-end close or special projects.





COMPENSATION



• $10–$13 USD/hour, depending on qualifications and experience.

• Long-term independent contractor opportunity.

• Weekly hours may be adjusted as accounting processes are streamlined and automated.





ABOUT SYNERGY WETSUITS



Founded by triathlete and coach Stefan Laursen, Synergy Wetsuits designs premium wetsuits, tri suits, and swim accessories for athletes worldwide. We're headquartered in Minden, Nevada, with U.S. and international e-commerce operations.





HOW TO APPLY



Apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph with all three components:



1. RESUME



Submit your current resume as a PDF or viewable link.



2. WRITTEN ANSWERS



Please answer all nine questions.



1) How many years of accounting experience do you have? What were your primary responsibilities?



2) Which QuickBooks versions have you used? Have you worked with QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise?



3) Describe your experience independently managing month-end close and financial reporting.



4) Tell us about a complicated reconciliation discrepancy you personally resolved. How did you investigate and correct it?



5) What experience do you have with Shopify, Amazon, or other e-commerce settlement reconciliations?



6) Describe your experience with inventory accounting, COGS, and multi-currency transactions.



7) Give an example of an accounting process you improved or automated.



8) Describe a time you encountered an accounting or software issue you couldn't immediately resolve. What steps did you take to troubleshoot it, and when did you escalate?



9) Confirm your availability for Monday–Friday, starting at 12:00 PM Pacific Time, initially 20 hours/week with flexibility for up to 30 hours, and your expected hourly rate in USD.



3. INTRODUCTION VIDEO



Submit a 60–90 second video introducing yourself, highlighting your accounting experience, and explaining why you're a strong fit. Include a viewable Google Drive, Dropbox, or Loom link.





SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES



Selected applicants will complete our formal Contractor Application Form, a practical accounting assessment, an interview, and applicable background verification.





IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Begin your application with this exact sentence:



"Accurate accounting requires understanding, not just data entry."



Applications missing this sentence, a resume, screening answers, or an introduction video will be considered incomplete.



Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Expert Xactimate Estimator & Insurance Supplement Specialist — Public Adjusting Experience Required
description:
JB’s Home Services and Contracting is a veteran-owned residential contracting company in Northwest Florida. We are hiring a part-time, remote Xactimate expert with substantial experience supporting U.S. public adjusting firms and residential insurance restoration projects.



This is a long-term opportunity working directly with our owners and construction team. You must already have advanced estimating skills and be able to review files, identify missing information, and prepare accurate estimates independently.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Build detailed Xactimate estimates from field notes, photographs, measurements, plans, and existing estimates.

- Compare insurance carrier estimates against our documented repair scope, line by line.

- Identify omitted work, incorrect quantities, duplicate charges, pricing discrepancies, and necessary related repairs.

- Prepare itemized contractor supplemental estimates supported by photographs, measurements, invoices, product information, and technical documentation.

- Write clear explanations supporting proposed repairs and estimate revisions.

- Create and revise sketches, select appropriate line items and price lists, and provide PDF estimates and editable ESX files.

- Understand and track replacement cost value, actual cash value, depreciation, deductibles, prior payments, and estimate revisions.

- Maintain organized project files and track outstanding documents, revisions, deadlines, and follow-up dates.

- Draft estimate correspondence and scope clarifications for management review.

- Coordinate with our field team to obtain missing photographs, dimensions, and repair details.

- Help develop consistent estimating templates, documentation standards, and review procedures.

- Enter approved scopes and supporting documents into ServiceTitan. Training on our internal workflow is available.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- At least three years of substantial, hands-on Xactimate estimating experience.

- Direct experience supporting U.S. public adjusting firms and preparing residential property damage estimates and supplements.

- Strong knowledge of roofing, storm damage, water damage, demolition, drying, and interior reconstruction.

- Ability to explain and support your line-item selections and quantities.

- Understanding of overhead and profit, taxes, depreciation, and applicable estimating conventions.

- Excellent written English and confident spoken communication.

- Strong organization, accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, headset, and backup arrangements.

- Ability to complete estimates independently and meet agreed deadlines.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Xactimate Level 2 or Level 3 certification.

- Florida residential insurance restoration experience.

- Experience with XactAnalysis, CompanyCam, ServiceTitan, EagleView, or similar tools.

- Experience reviewing repair requirements against manufacturer instructions and applicable building codes.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This is a part-time position with consistent availability required during U.S. Central Time business hours. Weekly hours and working times will be agreed upon with the selected applicant.



Pay is negotiable based on demonstrated expertise. Include your expected hourly rate in USD.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Your estimates accurately reflect the documented work. Each proposed supplement has a clear explanation and supporting evidence. Files stay organized, deadlines are tracked, and our team knows what is ready and what still needs attention.



Accuracy and defensible documentation matter. Every proposed charge must connect to the actual project.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using the subject:



XACTIMATE EXPERT — [Your Name]



Include the following:



1. Your résumé and total years using Xactimate.

2. A description of your experience supporting public adjusting firms and restoration contractors.

3. Two redacted Xactimate estimates you personally prepared, including at least one supplement example. Remove all customer and confidential information.

4. A brief example of a missing scope item you identified and how you documented it.

5. Any Xactimate certifications or adjusting licenses you hold.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD, weekly availability, and earliest start date.

7. Whether you currently have access to a properly licensed Xactimate account or would need company-provided access.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid practical estimating exercise.



ROLE SCOPE



This position performs contractor estimating and administrative support. Activities requiring a public adjuster license are reserved for appropriately licensed professionals.

title: Amazon Brand Protection Specialist: Unauthorized Sellers and Pending Trademark Brands
description:
MontBlack Inc. is an e-commerce distributor. We sell established consumer brands on Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop. Our brands are known and have real demand. Some have a trademark application that is still pending and no full Brand Registry access yet. We need an experienced specialist who can remove resellers and unauthorized sellers from these listings, and who can help move each brand into Brand Registry faster.



What you will do



Audit each listing and map every seller: stock, price, Buy Box share, and when they first appeared.

Separate legitimate resellers from counterfeit, unauthorized, and hijacker offers.

Remove sellers on brands without a registered trademark, using the methods Amazon still accepts: authorization and distribution records, listing and condition violations, and policy complaints backed by evidence.

Advise on the fastest path to Brand Registry access while the application is pending.

Once access is granted, file and manage cases through Brand Registry, Report a Violation, and Amazon’s other brand protection tools.



Handle Amazon’s responses and appeals, including the case where Amazon says a seller is “authorized by the brand.”

Run test buys and record lot codes, expiration dates, and condition problems when a case needs proof.

Trace where resellers buy their stock so the brand can cut supply at the source.

Work with our legal counsel on cease and desist letters when a seller does not leave.

Send a weekly report: sellers removed, sellers remaining, cases open.



What you need



At least 2 to 3 years of hands-on Amazon brand enforcement.

Proven results on brands with a pending trademark and limited or no Brand Registry access. This is the experience we care about most.

Working knowledge of Brand Registry, Report a Violation, Project Zero, Transparency, and how Amazon reviews and rejects cases.

Strong written English and clear case documentation.

Comfortable using Keepa or a similar tool to track sellers and stock.



Nice to have



Experience with food and consumable brands.

Experience working with trademark counsel.



Who should not apply



General virtual assistants and generalist Amazon consultants.

Agencies sending a template proposal.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time (9hrs), 8-hour shift with a 1-hour lunch break

Schedule: At least 5 hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours



About the Role



Triple Line Brands is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to support the day-to-day advertising work for consumer brands across their Amazon marketplaces.

This is an execution and analysis-focused role. You will carry out advertising plans set by a Senior Amazon PPC Strategist, build and optimize campaigns, maintain account hygiene, analyze performance data, and prepare accurate reports. The Strategist will own account strategy and higher-judgment decisions, while you will own the accuracy, quality, documentation, and timely completion of assigned PPC work.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, identifying inconsistencies, following structured processes, and translating clear performance targets into specific campaign changes.





What You’ll Do



Build, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns based on approved advertising plans.

Conduct keyword and product-targeting research, search-term analysis and harvesting, negative targeting, and routine account reviews.

Translate account-specific ROAS, ACOS, CPC, conversion, and budget-pacing goals into appropriate bid, placement, targeting, and budget adjustments.

Download, organize, analyze, and validate advertising and performance data using Excel or Google Sheets.

Review datasets, reports, and dashboards for missing information, duplicates, incorrect filters, formula errors, unusual results, and inconsistencies between sources.

Monitor sales, spend, TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, and other relevant performance measures.

Diagnose significant performance gaps or fluctuations, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions for Strategist review.

Compile, check, and submit PPC performance reports accurately and on time.

Maintain campaign hygiene, including organized structures, naming conventions, targeting, budgets, and campaign uptime.

Document campaign changes, actions taken, test progress, results, and follow-up items.

Support the Senior PPC Strategist with data preparation, reporting, account research, audits, and other PPC-related tasks that help brands progress toward their goals.

Flag risks, blockers, unclear instructions, data issues, or decisions outside your guidelines to the Senior PPC Strategist.

Apply department standards and share practical feedback that could improve campaign execution, reporting, quality assurance, and team workflows.





What We’re Looking For



At least two years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience, with the full two years spent managing multiple Amazon advertising accounts or marketplaces at the same time for established consumer brands with meaningful ad spend.

Amazon agency experience is preferred.

Comfortable managing approximately 10 to 12 substantive brand-marketplace assignments when fully ramped, subject to account complexity and workload capacity.

Strong data analysis skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Experience reviewing and validating PPC datasets, reports, dashboards, or analytical models.

Ability to diagnose performance problems, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions.

Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, bidding, placements, budget management, keyword targeting, product targeting, search-term harvesting, and negative targeting.

Ability to translate quantified performance goals into specific campaign optimization actions.

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filters, and data validation.

Ability to identify reporting errors, inconsistencies between data sources, and meaningful changes in account performance.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to learn new brands, products, tools, and workflows quickly.

Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple accounts and evolving priorities.

Organized, dependable, receptive to feedback, and proactive about communicating risks, blockers, and opportunities to improve team processes.

Familiarity with Helium 10, SmartScout, My Real Profit, Atom11, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Amazon DSP experience is a strong advantage, with advanced proficiency preferred but not required.

Experience working remotely with US-based brands or cross-functional teams is an advantage.





Why Join Us



You’ll work on a varied portfolio of Amazon brands with clear strategic direction and defined performance goals. You’ll receive account-specific coaching from a Senior PPC Strategist and support from advertising leadership while strengthening your campaign execution, data analysis, and reporting skills.





How to Apply



Please include a link to your résumé in your application and make sure we have permission to view it. If you have a portfolio of relevant Amazon PPC work, feel free to include a link to it as well.





Salary posted is negotiable

.

). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at the offices we serve and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners.



THE JOB

You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator, managing partner or owner.



Your standard is 150 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once.



Your work:

You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them.

You follow up by
, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you.

You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted.

You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking.



Your rules:

You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call.



Most calls end at the front desk or in voi
. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing.



HOW WE SELL

This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a business: its customers, its staff and its reputation.



HOURS

20 hours per week, Monday to Thursday, 5 hours a day. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is currently 11 PM to 1 AM and 2 AM to 5 AM, and it shifts by one hour when US clocks change in March. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers.



PAY

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer.

$25 for every walkthrough that actually happens.

$50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice.

Bonuses are extra and not promised.



TRIAL

The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d
 whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one.



WE PROVIDE

A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week.



YOU NEED

You must have worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company: commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services. At least 3 years of outbound cold calling appointment setting, and at least part of it for a cleaning company, booking appointments with US businesses. If you have not worked in outbound sales for a cleaning company, do not apply.

You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's.

A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script.

Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes.

Clear, neutral spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call, with no heavy accent and no strong regional pronunciation.

A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed.



HOW TO APPLY

Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, $5 to $7 per hour, [your name]. We do not read messages without it.



Then send:



1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. Then imagine you reached the office manager at a dental office and said: "Hi, this is [your name] with Keeper Facility Care. We provide janitorial service to offices near you. Are you the person who d
 on cleaning?" The manager says: "We already have a cleaner." Answer in your own words and ask for a 15 minute walkthrough. We listen for clear, neutral English and a natural tone. Make sure the link opens without a login.

2. Your cleaning company experience: the company name, your role, how long you worked there, who you called, calls per day, and your best measurable result, such as appointments booked per week. Then your total years of cold calling appointment setting.

3. The CRMs you have used.

4. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Your upload speed, your headset model, and a yes or no: can you work the hours above every week?



Applications that do not follow these instructions are not reviewed. Finalists do a 10 minute live role-play call with Johan.



Applications close Wednesday, November 18 at 11:59 PM Philippine time. We reply only to finalists, by Friday, November 20.



Johan Montenegro, Keeper Facility Care

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)



Compensation: Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 100,000+ per month, depending on individual sales performance. This role offers a competitive compensation structure with commissions and performance incentives that reward high achievers.



Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.



Leave: One week paid leave per year.



About the Client



Our client is Australia's leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.

Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating long-term career opportunities for motivated individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, customer-focused sales role centred on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires excellent multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence in managing time-sensitive situations.



Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

Quality Control & Administration

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

 and fax.

- Answer patient
s with warmth and clarity

- Experience working with Australian clients or companies

Working hours



This is a part-time 5-hour shift, 8:30am to 1:30pm Sydney time (5:30am to 10:30am Philippine time), Monday to Friday. These are chosen to overlap with Australian clinic hours (Sydney and Melbourne time, which is currently 3 hours ahead of Manila).



Pay and growth

• Introduce our construction training and job placement program



• Explain the skills and preparation trainees receive



• Identify contractors with current or upcoming hiring needs

• Schedule follow up calls with interested contractors

To qualify toward the project goal, each contractor must:



• Operate a legitimate construction business



• Have a current or upcoming need for workers



• Agree to consider, interview, or hire qualified program graduates



• Agree to pay hired graduates a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour



• Complete and sign the required contractor participation agreement

Qualifications



• Strong spoken and written English



• Confident and professional telephone presence



• Experience with outbound calling, recruiting, appointment setting, sales, or lead generation



• Comfortable speaking with construction company owners and hiring managers



• Strong organizational and follow up skills



• Able to work independently and meet strict deadlines



• Able to complete a high volume of calls within 7 to 10 days



• Comfortable working in a performance based position



• Experience in construction recruiting, workforce development, or employer outreach is preferred, but not required



Compensation



This is a performance based independent contract position with total earning potential of $2,500.



• $1,000 after 20 qualified construction contractors sign the required participation agreements within 7 to 10 days

All results must be verified before payment is issued. Incomplete agreements, invalid companies, duplicate contractors, or contact information without signed agreements will not qualify for payment.

• Your availability and time zone



• The number of outbound calls you can complete each day

We are looking for someone who is persuasive, organized, professional, and capable of producing verified results within the required timeline.

title: Online Operations & Business Manager
description:
The Online Operations & Business Manager (OBM) for The Promoted is responsible for supporting the CEO, Courtney O’Connell, in executing the vision of The Promoted, LLC with clarity, structure, efficiency, and calm.



This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. It combines executive support, hands-on business operations, project management, technical administration, and marketing execution.



The OBM works closely with the CEO (and future support team) to manage projects end-to-end, maintain operational integrity, and ensure that launches, programs, and internal systems run smoothly without relying on the CEO to mentally hold everything together.



Equally important, the OBM serves as the CEO's operational right hand anticipating deadlines, establishing priorities, and proactively communicating what needs to get done and by when.



Most importantly, this role is NOT just administrative support. The OBM owns outcomes, protects founder energy, and ensures that work being delivered is aligned to the brand, tested, and ready to meet standards of excellence before it goes live.



This is a hands-on role. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable creating a project plan, updating a website, troubleshooting a checkout issue, analyzing business performance, and reminding the CEO that a critical deliverable is due Friday. They don't just coordinate work, they take ownership of getting it done.



The position will start out part-time and is expected to become a full-time role managing additional VA team members, as required.



This role is organized into four core areas:



1. Executive Priorities & Accountability

2. Business Operations & Team Coordination

3. Technology, Website & Customer Experience

4. Growth, Marketing Execution & Reporting



1. EXECUTIVE PRIORITIES & ACCOUNTABILITY



The OBM serves as the CEO's operational right hand, proactively managing priorities, deadlines, and commitments to ensure the most important work gets done on time.



The OBM anticipates what's coming, works backward from important milestones, protects the CEO's time, and ensures she knows exactly what requires her attention and when.



Responsibilities include:

Partnering with the CEO to execute strategic priorities.

Helping the CEO manage her calendar based on the business cycle and helping her protecting dedicated time for strategic work, content creation, coaching, and business development.

Maintaining a master business calendar covering launches, webinars, podcast production, coaching programs, marketing campaigns, and other key business activities.

Working backward from important milestones to establish realistic timelines, deadlines, and deliverables.

Proactively communicating what the CEO needs to complete, by when, and why it matters.

Providing weekly priority briefings and timely reminders about upcoming commitments and deadlines.

Respectfully holding the CEO accountable to agreed-upon deadlines and following up on outstanding deliverables.

Recommending what should be delegated, postponed, or eliminated to protect the CEO's time and focus.

Maintaining alignment between leadership decisions and execution.



The desired outcome: The CEO no longer needs to mentally track every deadline, remember what's coming next, or independently determine what needs her attention. The OBM provides the foresight, structure, and accountability that allow her to focus on leading, coaching, creating, and growing the business.



2. BUSINESS OPERATIONS & TEAM COORDINATION



The OBM is a systems thinker who thrives on structure, clarity, and clean workflows.



This person takes ownership of the day-to-day operations of The Promoted, ensuring the business runs smoothly, issues are resolved proactively, and work moves forward without constant CEO involvement.



Responsibilities include:



Creating and maintaining project boards and processes.

Setting up and organizing project management software, Google Drive, and internal documentation such as SOPs.

Managing onboarding workflows for members, clients, and contractors.

Managing day-to-day administrative and operational needs, including recurring tasks, business documentation, and internal coordination.

Serving as the first point of contact for routine operational issues, resolving them independently whenever possible.

Overseeing customer service workflows, including responding to or coordinating resolution of client questions, access problems, billing inquiries, and payment issues.

Monitoring subscriptions, payment plans, failed payments, and other customer account issues, escalating exceptions appropriately.

Managing and improving recurring business processes to reduce manual work and unnecessary CEO involvement.

Identifying inefficiencies and recommending improvements.

Coordinating communication between team members and contractors.

Coordinating and following up with virtual assistants, contractors, and external partners to ensure responsibilities and deadlines are clear. (Future responsibility) 

Managing special projects and cross-functional initiatives.

Ensuring commitments made in meetings are documented, assigned, tracked, and completed.



The desired outcome: The business operates reliably and efficiently, with clear systems, accountability, and minimal need for the CEO to manage routine execution.



3. TECHNOLOGY, WEBSITE & CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE



The OBM is the hands-on administrator of The Promoted's online business platforms, ensuring our website, course portals, funnels, checkouts, and automations work reliably and provide an excellent customer experience.



The ideal candidate is technically confident, resourceful, and comfortable learning new platforms, investigating problems, and implementing solutions without requiring constant direction.



Responsibilities include:



Maintaining and updating our Kajabi website, landing pages, sales pages, checkout pages, and course portals.

Uploading and organizing program materials, videos, downloads, and other digital resources.

Setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting forms,
 sequences, tags, automations, and integrations.

Managing the backend administration of coaching programs, digital products, webinars, and online courses.

Investigating and resolving website, registration, checkout, payment, and customer access issues.

Managing customer onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth and professional experience.

End-to-end testing of launches, funnels, and workflows.

Verifying registration,
, tagging, checkout, and replay flows.

Ensuring pages, links, and assets are accurate and on brand.

Acting as the last line of defense before launches or updates go live.

Identifying opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve the reliability of our systems.

Coordinating with external technical specialists when an issue requires expertise beyond the role's capabilities, while retaining ownership of resolution.



The desired outcome: Our technology works, our customers are supported, and the CEO is no longer the person troubleshooting backend problems or managing routine website updates.



4. GROWTH, MARKETING EXECUTION & REPORTING



The OBM supports launch execution and growth initiatives by translating strategy into organized, measurable execution. The CEO owns overall marketing strategy and core messaging, while the OBM owns the operational execution and coordination required to bring those initiatives to life.



Responsibilities include:



Supporting launches, promotions, and live webinars, maximizing efficiency and conversions.

Translating launch strategy into execution-ready project boards.

Coordinating timelines across internal team members and external agencies.

Ensuring launch assets move through clear create → review → test phases.

Monitoring dependencies and flagging risks before they become fires.

Tracking and reporting on key business metrics, including leads, registrations, webinar attendance, conversion rates, sales, revenue, and campaign performance.

Creating and maintaining clear, accurate KPI dashboards and recurring business reports.

Monitoring payment performance, failed transactions, and revenue-related issues in coordination with the company's payment and financial systems.

Identifying trends, opportunities, and areas of underperformance to help the CEO make informed decisions about marketing, list-building, and sales priorities.

Coordinating
 marketing campaigns, promotional schedules, and launch communications.

Supporting webinar setup, registration, reminders, replay delivery, and post-event follow-up.

Conducting post-launch reviews to identify lessons learned and opportunities to improve future results.

Maintaining accurate records and reporting processes so the CEO has reliable visibility into business performance.



The desired outcome: Marketing initiatives launch smoothly, performance is measurable, and the CEO has timely, actionable information about what's working and where attention is needed.



THE DAY-TO-DAY



This role may include, but is not limited to:



Communicating the CEO's most important deliverables for the week and month.

Creating and managing project boards.

Translating launch plans into clear execution timelines (we have detailed processes to reference, so part of the OBM role will ensure they're optimized and followed).

Coordinating tasks across VAs and contractors. (future responsibility) 

QA testing funnels, webinars,
s, and checkouts.

Supporting launch execution from pre-launch through debrief.

Organizing assets, documentation, and internal resources.

Proactively identifying and removing bottlenecks, including following up with the CEO or team members on outstanding decisions and deliverables.

Improving workflows and systems to reduce CEO involvement in routine execution.

Making updates to the Kajabi website, landing pages, and course portals.

Resolving customer access, billing, and payment issues.

Maintaining business reporting dashboards and reviewing key performance metrics.



A typical week will include a mix of recurring operational responsibilities, forward-looking planning, technical execution, and special projects. Priorities will shift during launches and other high-activity periods.



CORE OUTCOMES THE OBM IS RESPONSIBLE FOR



The CEO has a clear, proactively managed calendar and always knows what she needs to complete and by when.

Day-to-day business operations run smoothly, with routine issues handled independently and proactively.

Team alignment, management, and communication. (future responsibility)

Creating repeatable systems for future launches and programs.

Website pages, funnels, automations, and payment processes are maintained, tested, and functioning properly (all live in Kajabi)

Customers experience seamless onboarding, program access, billing, and support.

Accurate business reports provide clear visibility into marketing performance, sales, and operational health.

Launches, webinars, and programs are executed on time, with clear ownership and minimal last-minute emergencies.



THIS POSITION IS FOR SOMEONE WHO:

Is resourceful, self-sufficient, and proactive.

Takes full ownership and pride in their work.

Is obsessed with organization, checklists, and clean systems.

Communicates clearly and confidently (and isn't afraid to speak up).

Spots problems and proposes solutions.

Thrives in fast-moving environments with multiple priorities.

Adapts quickly as strategy evolves.

Is technologically savvy and systems-oriented.

Can receive direct feedback without defensiveness.

Values quality, integrity, and follow-through.

Has high standards of excellence and can spot mistakes and shortcomings.

Understands that calm execution is a competitive advantage.

Is personally aligned with and values the mission of the organization.

Is exceptionally skilled at managing up and respectfully holding a busy, visionary founder accountable.

Can turn big-picture ideas into realistic plans, deadlines, and specific next actions.

Anticipates needs before being asked and confidently communicates what must happen next.

Is comfortable challenging priorities, and pushing back when timelines or workloads are unrealistic.

Enjoys both managing projects and rolling up their sleeves to execute the work.

Can independently troubleshoot technology, investigate issues, and find solutions.

Is comfortable working with numbers, tracking performance, and translating data into useful business insights.

Has strong attention to detail and takes pride in catching errors before they affect customers or the brand.

Understands how to balance recurring responsibilities with larger projects and changing priorities.

Is comfortable supporting creative execution while respecting the CEO's voice, vision, and final approval.

Excited to grow with the company, taking on additional managerial responsibilities as we scale.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Project management experience.

Online launches and webinar-based funnels experience.

Familiarity with James Wedmore / Business by Design style launches (we follow his launch and business management processes, so you will have access to those).

Hands-on experience with Kajabi or a comparable online course and website platform, including website updates, funnels, checkout processes,
 automations, and customer administration.

Experience with Google Workspace, Google Analytics, Google Drive, and project management software.

Experience creating business reports and tracking KPIs using spreadsheets, dashboards, or analytics tools.

Familiarity with online payment systems, customer subscriptions, and troubleshooting billing or checkout issues.

Experience with tools such as Canva, Zoom, ManyChat, and
 marketing platforms is a plus.

Experience supporting a founder or executive in a fast-moving small business is highly desirable.

Working inside mission-driven, online education or coaching brands.

Experience with every platform is not required. We place a high value on technical confidence, resourcefulness, sound judgment, and the ability to learn new tools quickly.



WHAT WE DO



The Promoted is a leadership development and executive coaching company helping ambitious, high-performing corporate professionals accelerate their careers and step into bigger leadership roles by cultivating their authentic executive presence and intentionally shaping how they are perceived as leaders. Founded by Courtney O'Connell, a former Fortune 500 SVP and Head of HR with more than 20 years of corporate experience, The Promoted brings an insider's perspective to career advancement. We help talented professionals understand what really drives promotion decisions and why doing great work alone isn't always enough to get ahead.



Through executive coaching, leadership development programs, digital courses, and content, including our Inside the Promotion Room podcast, Courtney helps professionals become more self-aware, communicate with greater authority, navigate workplace dynamics, and build the leadership reputation that opens doors. Her approach combines practical corporate insights with meaningful personal development, helping people move beyond simply working harder to becoming the kind of leaders others trust with greater responsibility.



We're a growing, mission-driven business passionate about helping people realize their potential and take greater ownership of their careers.



MEET OUR CEO



Courtney O'Connell spent more than 20 years in corporate America, working her way from administrative assistant to Fortune 500 SVP and Head of HR. Along the way, she spent years in the rooms where promotion decisions were made and saw firsthand why some talented people moved up while others, often just as capable, were overlooked.



Today, she coaches ambitious leaders to hone their authenticity and executive presence to get the promotion they're after, and she hosts the podcast Inside the Promotion Room, where she shares what most professionals never get to hear about how careers really advance.



Through her coaching programs, Courtney helps high performers recognize the habits and patterns that may be holding them back, understand how others experience them, and become more intentional about how they lead. Her work focuses on the things that rarely show up in a job description but make all the difference in getting ahead: self-awareness, emotional intelligence, influence, communication, and the ability to earn trust at the next level.



Her message is simple: Doing great work gets you noticed for what you can do. How you show up as a leader determines what people trust you to do next.



OUR TEAM VALUES



Integrity — We do what we say we're going to do.

Candor — We communicate respectfully and freely.

Excellence — We deliver the highest quality content and coaching support.

Love — We care deeply about each other and our clients, and it shows.

Fun — We work hard, and we like to have fun, too.



WHERE TO FIND US

TO APPLY



We will NOT be accepting messages as applications. To apply for the job, you must fill out the Job Application here.

title: Senior Graphic Designer / Video Editor
description:
Commitment: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Required time zone and collaboration hours: 9 AM - 2PM ET



About Blunt



Blunt makes trend-forward phone cases and tech accessories that let people express their style. We care about the details: the design, the product, and how it all comes together on screen.



About the role



We’re looking for an experienced Graphic Designer / Video Editor who can create both static and video ads for paid social. You’ll work from briefs provided by our Creative Strategist, turning the direction, messaging and concepts into polished ads with strong hooks, clear messages and reasons to buy. The strategist owns the overall creative strategy and briefs; you bring the design and editing judgment to execute them well and suggest useful variations.



Strong visual taste matters here. Your work should feel fashion-forward, polished and right for Blunt, with thoughtful typography, composition, color and product presentation. You should be comfortable taking a concept through execution and using performance feedback to make the next version better.



What you’ll do



- Design high volume static performance ads, including product-led creative, offers, benefits and new concepts for testing.

- Edit short-form performance videos from product footage, creator content and existing brand assets.

- Execute the Creative Strategist’s briefs through effective opening frames, pacing, captions, sound and calls to action, and suggest hook or execution variations within the brief.

- Create meaningful variations of messages, visuals and edits so the team can learn what works.

- Deliver placement-ready assets for paid social, including the right aspect ratios, captions, safe zones and export specifications.

- Use creative results and feedback to improve your work while keeping it consistent with Blunt’s brand.

- Keep source files and exports organized, and communicate clearly about revisions and delivery.



What we’re looking for



- Strong hands-on experience producing both static ads and performance video edits for ecommerce or consumer brands.

- A portfolio that demonstrates your personal contribution in both formats.

- An understanding of paid social creative: hooks, product benefits, offers, storytelling, testing and iteration.

- A high standard for typography, layout, color, imagery and motion, with the judgment to make creative that feels right for Blunt.

- Confidence working independently from a brief, offering ideas and responding thoughtfully to feedback.

- Strong understanding of fashion / lifestyle / social trends

- Strong command of professional design and video-editing tools, such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects or equivalent tools. Your portfolio should demonstrate the quality of your work in both disciplines.

- Comfortable using AI tools in your design and editing workflow to explore ideas, speed up production and improve execution. You should be able to judge and refine the output so the work stays accurate, polished and consistent with Blunt.

- Clear written communication and the ability to manage a full-time, 40-hour weekly commitment, meet deadlines and collaborate during the agreed team overlap.



What success looks like



You consistently deliver well-crafted static ads and video edits that feel recognizably Blunt, communicate a clear product benefit and give the marketing team distinct ideas to test. You can explain your creative choices, use feedback to improve the next version and deliver organized, ready-to-use assets on time.



How to apply



Please apply here: 



The application will ask for your portfolio, examples of static ads and video edits, your contribution to each, and a short explanation of how you use performance feedback. Share results where you have permission, and clearly distinguish your own work from team work.

title: E-Commerce Ebay Jewelry Listing & Auction Sourcing Virtual Assistant (AI-Assisted)
description:
About the Role

We are a growing California-based vintage and fine jewelry reselling business looking for a detail oriented

Virtual Assistant in the Philippines. You will work directly from clear Standard Operating

Procedures (SOPs) to prep daily product photos, generate SEO-optimized eBay drafts using our

custom Google Gemini AI workflows, research sold price comparables, and scout undervalued bulk

jewelry lots across US online auctions.

Schedule & Compensation



CATEGORY DETAILS

Hours & Schedule Part-time to start ([15–20] hours/week) with flexible asynchronous hours,

scaling up as listing volume grows.



-Base Compensation $[3-6]/hour USD depending on experience, paid reliably on a [weekly/biweekly]

schedule via Wise or PayPal.

-Sourcing Bonuses Performance bounties ($[3–5] per winning lot) for auction leads you scout

that we successfully purchase.

-Training & Support Full written SOPs, designer hallmark cheat sheets, custom AI prompt

templates, and asynchronous Loom video feedback.



Core Responsibilities

-Photo Editing & Prep: Download daily jewelry photo batches from Google Drive, crop to a centered

1:1 square ratio, and adjust brightness and contrast so hallmarks and stamps are crisp.

AI Analysis & Price Comping: Run edited photos through our Google Gemini prompt rules to

identify makers and materials, verify 1-year eBay sold comps, and create under-80-character titles.

-eBay Draft Creation: Upload photos in logical order, enter descriptions and flaw disclosures, input

baseline comp pricing via eBay Multi-User Account Access (MUAA), and save strictly as drafts.

-Online Auction Scouting: Browse US auction platforms ( HiBid, LiveAuctioneers etc....)

using our visual hallmark guides to log promising bulk jewelry trays onto our daily Buy Sheet.

B2B Lead Research: Compile regional contact lists of estate liquidators, cleanout crews, and thrift

networks for direct bulk-buying outreach.Asset & Tracker Management: 

Move completed photo sets into archived Google Drive folders and

update our daily Google Sheets tracker with draft counts and flagged items.



Requirements:

-E-Commerce Experience: Prior experience drafting listings on eBay (or Poshmark) and

researching sold market comparables rather than active asking prices.

-Jewelry & Terminology Knowledge: Familiarity with jewelry styles, settings, clasps, gemstones,

metals, and industry terminology to accurately verify AI outputs and write precise descriptions.

-Sharp Visual Attention to Detail: Ability to inspect macro photos for tiny metal stamps (925, 14K,

designer marks) and flaw pointers so mandatory title disclosures are never missed.

-Tech & AI Comfort: Proficiency with Google Drive, Google Sheets, Canva (or batch editors like

FastStone or Photopea), and following structured AI prompt workflows.

-Strong Written English: Clear, natural English comprehension for writing clean item descriptions

and communicating asynchronously.

-Reliable Setup: Fast, stable internet connection and a computer capable of smoothly uploading

and editing high-resolution DSLR photos.





How to Apply (Read Carefully)

To demonstrate your attention to detail, applications that do not follow every step below will be

automatically skipped:

1. Use this exact subject line: Vintage Jewelry VA – [Your First Name] – READ

2. In 2–3 sentences, summarize your past experience with eBay drafting, product research, or

online arbitrage sourcing.

3. Name your preferred tool for quickly cropping and brightening a batch of 50 product photos.

4. Briefly explain why checking Sold listings instead of Active listings matters when pricing a

vintage item on eBay.

5. Include a link to your resume or portfolio (please do not attach large zip files).

title: NetSuite Administrator / Financial Systems Specialist
description:
The Purpose of Your Role



You will own and deliver NetSuite projects that improve the efficiency and accuracy of our financial processes. Working closely with U.S. finance and accounting leadership, you will translate business requirements into practical configurations, implement and test solutions, and support their ongoing use.



Your immediate priorities are accounts payable automation, financial reporting, and automated bank connectivity. You will maximize native NetSuite capabilities, minimize unnecessary third-party applications, and provide hands-on implementation and functional support.



The Company You’ll Join



OCD Anxiety Centers is dedicated to transforming the lives of individuals struggling with OCD, anxiety, and related disorders. We provide evidence-based, compassionate care and foster a supportive and innovative environment for our team. Join us and make a meaningful impact on clients, their families, and the community.



The Team You’ll Work With



You will work remotely from the Philippines with our U.S.-based finance leadership and accounting team. You will collaborate with internal users, banks, NetSuite support, and technical partners as needed. We value clear communication, independent ownership, reliable follow-through, confidentiality, and practical problem solving.



## Key Performance Indicators



Success will be measured against priorities, baselines, targets, and timelines agreed with the CFO or designated finance leader. Targets will reflect the existing configuration, available features, and work within this role’s control.



**AP Process Improvement**

- Implement agreed AP improvements and track invoice processing time, manual entry or correction effort, and duplicate-invoice exceptions against the approved baseline.



**Accurate and Timely Reporting**

- Deliver assigned financial statements, reports, saved searches, and dashboards by agreed deadlines.

- Validate financial outputs against NetSuite transactions and general ledger balances and resolve discrepancies.



**Reliable Banking Imports**

- Validate the completeness and accuracy of assigned bank and credit card imports.

- Resolve or escalate connection failures, missing or duplicate transactions, and matching exceptions within agreed timelines.



**Tested Project Delivery**

- Complete agreed configuration and SuiteFlow milestones against documented requirements, with testing, Finance acceptance, and implementation notes before production deployment.



**Support and Controls**

- Resolve or escalate assigned support requests according to agreed priorities.

- Maintain documented permissions, approval workflows, and segregation-of-duties controls.



**Documentation and Team Adoption**

- Maintain current process instructions, configuration records, and report definitions.

- Deliver training and confirm that designated finance users can complete agreed tasks.



The supervisor will review results and priorities regularly and establish updated goals to support continued growth, operational efficiency, and the company’s finance needs.



## Competencies



**Functional Expertise**

- Apply NetSuite configuration and administration skills to practical finance and accounting needs.



**Accounting Knowledge**

- Understand AP, general ledger, financial reporting, and bank reconciliation processes.



**Problem Solving**

- Investigate root causes and translate business requirements into working solutions.



**Accuracy and Control Awareness**

- Validate financial data, protect sensitive information, and test and document changes.



**Ownership and Follow-Through**

- Manage priorities independently, meet commitments, and escalate blockers promptly.



**Communication and Collaboration**

- Explain issues clearly, communicate progress, and train finance users effectively.



## Responsibilities



Prioritize native NetSuite functionality and Oracle-provided SuiteApps, subject to account licensing, enabled features, and supported bank connections.



### Accounts Payable Automation



- Configure and optimize available NetSuite AP automation, including Bill Capture where provisioned and enabled.

- Implement invoice intake, data capture, coding, approval, and processing workflows that reduce manual entry and duplicate-payment risk.

- Configure vendor records, approval routing, and appropriate accounting controls.

- Evaluate existing AP processes and implement practical improvements using native NetSuite functionality.

- Support AP reporting, payment processing workflows, and audit trails.



### Financial Reporting and Analytics



- Develop and maintain financial statements, custom reports, saved searches, and dashboards.

- Create departmental and location-level profit-and-loss statements, budget-to-actual reports, and other operational financial analyses.

- Configure reporting for monthly close and management needs; support reporting dimensions, classifications, and financial data integrity.

- Automate recurring reporting wherever practical.

- Train finance personnel to use, modify, and maintain reports.



### Banking Integration and Automation



- Evaluate, configure, and maintain automated bank and credit card imports using the Bank Feeds SuiteApp and other supported NetSuite connectivity options.

- Configure account mappings and transaction-matching rules; support reconciliation workflows.

- Troubleshoot failed imports, missing or duplicate transactions, and connectivity issues; coordinate with banks and NetSuite support as required.

- Reduce manual bank statement downloads and CSV uploads where supported automated connections are available.

- Apply appropriate security, access controls, and segregation of duties to banking processes.



### NetSuite Administration and Process Improvement



- Review existing configurations, identify improvements, and configure roles, permissions, SuiteFlow workflows, forms, fields, and system preferences as appropriate.

- Troubleshoot accounting and operational system issues and provide ongoing functional support to the accounting team.

- Gather requirements, test enhancements, obtain approval, implement changes, and document outcomes.

- Support data imports, validation, and routine system maintenance.

- Recommend native solutions before custom development or third-party tools; provide process documentation and user training.



The Skills and Expertise You Have



Required Qualifications



- At least 3 years of hands-on NetSuite administration or functional consulting experience.

- Demonstrated experience configuring NetSuite financial and accounting modules.

- Strong understanding of U.S. accounting processes, particularly AP, general ledger, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting.

title: Credentialing and Billing Specialist
description:
Position Summary:



The Credentialing and Billing Specialist manages provider credentialing and payer enrollment and supports accurate, timely billing for ASun Star’s behavioral health and related services in New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The specialist tracks each provider’s enrollment status by payer, program, and service location, then applies that information to billing so claims are submitted under the correct provider and location.



This role works closely with clinical leadership, intake, scheduling, and finance to resolve credentialing, authorization, and claims issues that can delay reimbursement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Credentialing and Payer Enrollment



    Prepare, submit, and track initial credentialing, recredentialing, enrollment, and revalidation applications for individual providers and ASun Star entities, as applicable.

    Maintain current provider records, including licenses, NPIs, taxonomy codes, malpractice insurance, and CAQH profiles and attestations where required.

    Coordinate payer roster updates, group affiliations, practice location additions, and provider departures across New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

    Confirm and document payer approvals and effective dates by provider, program, and location. Communicate enrollment status and billing start dates to leadership, intake, and scheduling.

    Track renewal deadlines, follow up on outstanding applications, and escalate delays that may affect service scheduling or reimbursement.



Billing and Claims Follow-Up



    Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and authorization requirements. Monitor authorization dates and remaining units where applicable, and flag gaps to the appropriate team.

    Review claims against service records and payer requirements. Check dates of service, procedure codes, modifiers, units, place of service, and rendering and billing provider information before submission.

    Submit claims and monitor clearinghouse and payer responses for rejected, denied, or unpaid claims.

    Investigate discrepancies, coordinate corrections with the responsible staff, and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, or appeals within payer deadlines.

    Review remittance advice and coordinate with finance to reconcile payments, adjustments, and outstanding balances.

    Maintain a follow-up list for aging claims and report recurring issues, including credentialing mismatches, authorization gaps, and documentation delays.



Compliance and Reporting:



    Maintain organized, audit-ready credentialing and billing records and protect confidential provider and client information in accordance with HIPAA and ASun Star policies.

    Provide regular updates on pending enrollments, upcoming renewals, claim denials, aging balances, and issues that require leadership action.

    Identify recurring problems and recommend workflow improvements to reduce preventable denials and payment delays.



Qualifications:



Required



    High school diploma or equivalent.

    At least two years of experience in healthcare credentialing, provider enrollment, or medical billing, with hands-on experience in both credentialing and claims follow-up.

    Working knowledge of insurance eligibility, prior authorizations, claims submission, remittance advice, and denial resolution.

    Familiarity with CAQH, payer portals, electronic health record or practice management systems, clearinghouses, and Excel.

    Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, maintain accurate records, and communicate clearly with payers and internal teams.



Preferred:



    Experience billing for outpatient mental health, substance use disorder treatment, applied behavior analysis (ABA), or other behavioral health services.

    Experience with New Jersey and Pennsylvania Medicaid, managed care organizations, or commercial insurance plans.

    Experience enrolling individual providers and group practices across multiple locations.

    A relevant credential such as Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or Certified Professional Biller (CPB).

title: OA Sourcing VA — Amazon Canada FBA
description:
About the role



We are hiring one full-time Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing VA for a Canadian Amazon FBA business. You will find products at Canadian retailers that we can resell profitably on 
, check each one in Keepa and SellerAmp, and submit it as a lead to our shared lead database.



This is a volume-and-accuracy role. We need someone who can find 10 to 15 good leads a day, match listings correctly, and act on feedback the first time it is given. If you are used to submitting 3 to 5 leads a day, this role is not a fit.



Requirements

Please read each of these before applying. Applications that miss any of them will not be considered.

• Volume: 10 leads per day minimum, 15 per day target, within an 8-hour shift.

• Canada only: every lead must come from a retailer that ships from inside Canada. A .ca domain is not enough; 
 sites ship from the US. US-shipping leads are rejected.

• Accurate matching: pack size, count, size, colour and variant must match the Amazon listing exactly.

• Takes feedback: when we correct something, it should not need to be said twice.

• Experience: at least 1 year of paid OA sourcing work, with Keepa and SellerAmp. 
 experience is a plus but not required.

• Computer: desktop or laptop with 16GB RAM or more, Google Chrome as your main browser.

• Internet: 25 Mbps or faster, plus a backup connection (mobile data is fine).

• Exclusive: no other Amazon sourcing clients while working with us. Other part-time work must not overlap your shift.

• Hubstaff: time tracking runs for your whole shift, including the trial.

If you read this far, start your application with the word MAPLE.



Pay, hours and tools

• Pay: $4 USD per hour, paid weekly.

• Bonuses: performance bonuses based on profit per unit and margin become available after your first 3 months.

• Hours: 8 hours a day, 40 hours a week, tracked in Hubstaff.

• Tools provided: Keepa, SellerAmp and a VPN. You do not need your own subscriptions.

• Long-term: this is a permanent, full-time position on a growing team.



Hiring process

1. Application review: answer every question below in your own words. Generic or template answers are rejected.

2. Keepa graph test: shortlisted applicants get a Keepa graph screenshot and write a 4 to 5 sentence analysis. This step is required, no exceptions.

3. Paid 8-hour trial: one full 8-hour day, paid at the regular hourly rate. Hubstaff must run for the whole trial; untracked time is not paid. We will give you feedback on the completion of the the trial.

4. Offer: we d
 within a few days of the trial.



Application questions

Answer every question. Short, specific answers beat long ones.



1. What is your internet download and upload speed in Mbps? Attach a speedtest.net screenshot. What is your backup connection?

2. What computer do you use? Give the device, RAM, operating system, and confirm Chrome is your main browser.

3. How long have you done paid OA sourcing, for which marketplaces and categories, and which sourcing methods do you use?

4. What was your daily lead quota in your last OA job, as a number? Over your last month there, how many leads did you actually submit per day on average?

5. Are you working for anyone else right now (Amazon or not)? If yes, how many hours a week and when does it end?

6. Name 3 Canadian retailers you would source from that ship from inside Canada. Then explain how you would check whether a .ca website really ships from Canada.

7. An 
 listing is a 3-pack of a 400ml shampoo selling for $24. A retailer sells the single 400ml bottle for $5. Is this a lead? Walk through what you would check.

8. Give one real ASIN you sourced (any marketplace), with the buy price, the Amazon sell price, and why it was a good lead.

9. Describe a time you got the same correction from a client twice. What did you change after the second time?

10. Where did you work most recently, what was your role, and why are you leaving or why did you leave?

title: SEO Link Building & Directory Submission Specialist
description:
Job Description



Firestarter SEO is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented SEO Link Building Specialist to help execute link-building campaigns across multiple client accounts.



We will provide pre-vetted websites and specific instructions on where we want links placed. Your job is to complete the actual submissions, outreach, and placements.



For example, if we provide a business directory, you'll be responsible for visiting that website, creating an account if necessary, submitting our client's business information, and ensuring the listing is published correctly.



This is an execution-focused position. We are not looking for someone to develop link-building strategies or research new opportunities. We need someone who can take an assigned website or opportunity and handle the process from start to finish.



Responsibilities



Work through pre-approved lists of websites, directories, and link-building opportunities.



Complete business directory submissions, citation listings, and website registrations.



Create accounts, fill out submission forms, and upload required business information when necessary.



Execute guest post submissions, link insertions, and other approved backlink opportunities.



Contact website owners or editors when outreach is required.



Follow provided instructions for business information, target URLs, anchor text, and descriptions.



Track all submissions, including completed, pending, rejected, and published placements.



Verify that listings and backlinks are live and accurate.



Flag websites requiring payment, additional information, or approval before proceeding.



Maintain organized records of login credentials and completed submissions using approved secure systems.



Qualifications



Previous experience with SEO link building, directory submissions, or citation building.



Familiarity with business directories, guest posting, and backlink placements.



Ability to navigate different websites, create accounts, and complete submissions independently.



Strong attention to detail, particularly with business names, addresses, phone numbers, and URLs.



Comfortable using Google Sheets and project management tools.



Reliable communication and ability to manage multiple assignments.



What We Provide



Pre-vetted websites and directories.



Client business information and submission details.



Target URLs and anchor text requirements.



Clear instructions and ongoing assignments.



What We're Looking For



Someone who can take a website we provide and own the entire submission process, from visiting the site to completing the listing or link placement and documenting the results.



We value accuracy, efficiency, and consistency. This position has the potential for ongoing work across multiple client campaigns.



How to Apply



Please provide:



Your experience with directory submissions, citation building, and backlink placements.



Examples of similar work you've completed.



Your preferred hourly rate or per-submission pricing.



How many submissions you can realistically complete per week.



Any tools or platforms you've used to manage link-building campaigns.



Important: We provide the websites and opportunities. This role is focused on completing submissions and securing placements, not selling backlink packages or generating prospect lists.

title: Amazon Wholesale Product Research Specialist ([Part-time / Full-time], Remote)
description:
We're an Amazon wholesale business looking for an experienced product researcher to find

profitable products in our supplier catalogs. This role is wholesale only. If your background is

mainly online or retail arbitrage, this won't be a good fit.



Hiring a Product Research VA | 1



What you'll do

• Work through supplier price lists (CSV, Excel, PDF) and match items to Amazon listings

using:

– UPC scans

– Manual title searches, including multipack and bundle listings

– Reverse sourcing from competitor storefronts and brand catalogs

• Evaluate each match on:

– Profitability after FBA fees

– Sales rank and historical sales velocity

– Price history and seasonality

– Number of competitive FBA sellers and buy box behavior



• Reject products when:

– Amazon is on the listing

– The listing is misbranded or search suppressed

– The pack size or variation doesn't match

– The UPC doesn't trace back to the brand

– The item is likely hazmat or meltable

• Log every approved and rejected product in our research template, with links and a short

reason





Requirements

• Proven Amazon wholesale product research experience

• Can read Keepa charts well enough to spot price spikes, seasonality, and stock-outs

• Comfortable with large price lists in Excel or Google Sheets

• Understands FBA fees and ROI calculations

• Can explain clearly why a product is or isn't viable



Details

• Hours: [20-40 hrs/week]

• Tools provided: [SmartScout / Keepa / etc.]

• Pay: [$3.5 per hour] plus a performance bonus for approved SKUs we purchase

• Supplier pricing is confidential

• Long-term role with raises based on performance



How to apply. Start your application with the word "Keepa," then answer:

1. How long have you done Amazon wholesale product research, and for what kinds of

businesses?

2. Walk us through your process from a price list to a profitable SKU.

3. Describe one product you approved and one you rejected, and explain why.

5. Your availability and expected pay.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test using a sample price list.
