title: Manager, Billing & Financial Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.



This is a 1st-line management role for a detail-obsessed, process-driven leader who has run billing and collections teams before. You are not just doing the work — you are building the systems, the SOPs, and the team discipline that make the work run without constant supervision. You manage the specialists; you own the numbers; you report up to leadership with clean, confident data.



Key Responsibilities:

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Own end-to-end billing operations — from invoice generation through delivery, dispute resolution, and closed-loop reconciliation across all MedPro and MP1 service lines

• Oversee accurate and timely processing of all financial transactions: vendor payables, service billings, manifest entries, client invoices, and payment applications

• Ensure all billing records align with service agreements, contracts, and pricing structures — identifying and correcting discrepancies before they reach the client or vendor

• Manage the billing cycle calendar: maintain a disciplined, predictable cadence for invoice runs, payment postings, and month-end closes

• Build and enforce quality controls that reduce error rates, prevent duplicate payments, and maintain clean accounts across all transaction types

Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

• Own the collections process: proactively work aging receivables, contact clients with outstanding balances through defined outreach workflows, and escalate chronic non-payers through the appropriate path

• Maintain current and accurate AR aging reports — tracking open balances, days sales outstanding (DSO), and collection trends with weekly reporting to leadership

• Resolve billing disputes and discrepancies with professionalism and speed — balancing firmness in collections with the client relationship standards MedPro and MP1 are built on

• Identify and flag accounts at risk; recommend credit holds, payment plans, or escalation paths in partnership with leadership

• Ensure all collections activity is documented, auditable, and compliant with applicable regulations

Accounts Payable & Vendor Payments

• Manage the accounts payable function — ensure all vendor invoices are received, approved, accurately coded, and paid on schedule

• Maintain the vendor master list; manage vendor relationships for routine billing and payment inquiries

• Reconcile AP aging reports, resolve vendor disputes, and ensure no invoices age beyond terms without documented reason

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all expense submissions, manifests, and purchase-related documents are processed accurately and on time

• Support month-end AP close activities: accruals, reconciliations, and documentation for financial reporting

Team Leadership & Performance Management

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of billing specialists, collections specialists, and AP/transaction processors — setting clear expectations, running weekly check-ins, and delivering structured feedback

• Build and maintain the performance scorecard for the team: accuracy rate, turnaround time, DSO, collection rate, and AP aging metrics — with visible accountability at every level

• Design and document SOPs for every process the team touches — billing, collections, AP, manifest processing, and dispute handling. If it is not written down, it does not exist

• Identify skill gaps, cross-training opportunities, and development paths that build team depth and reduce single-point-of-failure risk

• Escalate issues and risks to leadership proactively — full transparency, clean data, solution-first framing

Systems, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Own the financial operations technology stack — CRM billing modules, AP platforms, reporting dashboards — ensuring data integrity and team adoption

• Build and maintain weekly and monthly reporting packages for leadership: transaction volumes, AR aging, DSO, collection performance, billing error rates, and AP status

• Identify inefficiencies in the current billing, collections, and AP workflows and lead process improvement initiatives with measurable impact

• Support system migrations and platform changes as needed — including data mapping, testing, and team training for any new financial operations tools

• Ensure all financial operations are compliant with applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory standards



Required: Qualifications



•	Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field

•	Experience: 5–7 years of accounting and financial operations experience, with at least 2 years owning a process area or managing a team

•	Volume: Experience in a high-volume, transaction-intensive environment, with large numbers of invoices, payments and customer accounts

•	Process design and controls: Demonstrated experience designing or improving processes and internal controls

•	Technology: Demonstrated use of technology and automation to improve throughput and accuracy. Strong Excel capability required. Experience with Salesforce, Striven or a comparable CRM/ERP preferred. Familiarity with AI-enabled finance tooling a plus

•	Service management: Experience defining and managing service levels and turnaround standards

•	Offshore teams: Experience working with or managing offshore resources, including daily collaboration across time zones

•	Order-to-cash: Working knowledge of billing, accounts receivable and collections. Experience in a recurring-revenue or service-contract business preferred

•	People leadership: Demonstrated experience managing or developing a team, with accountability for their output

•	Location: This is a fully onsite role based at the Naperville, IL office. It is not available on a remote or hybrid basis. Candidates must be able to commute to Naperville daily

•	Other: Strong written and verbal communication. This role is client- and vendor-facing, and works daily with a team in a different time zone





Nice-to-Have:

• Experience supporting a U.S.-based company remotely from the Philippines in a finance operations capacity

• Familiarity with medical waste, healthcare services, or regulated industry billing (e.g., manifest-based billing, compliance service invoicing)

• Exposure to Salesforce-linked billing workflows or CRM-based invoicing and collections management

• Background in process documentation, SOP creation, or financial controls implementation

• Experience with system migrations affecting billing or AP workflows



Compensation & Benefits:

• Salary Range: $10-$11/hr

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment!



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home



Application Process

1. To submit your application, please
 the following to 

2. Your most updated resume

3. Use the following subject line:

[Your Full Name] – Manager, Billing & Financial Operations - Remote



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Dashboards and work queues that help billing teams manage tasks, exceptions, and follow-up.

Customer-facing features and internal applications that reduce repetitive work.

Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.

Familiarity with background jobs, asynchronous processing, and data transformation.

Clear English communication and the ability to work independently while collaborating with a distributed team.

Browser automation using Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools.

AI/LLM integrations, structured outputs, and workflows that include human review.

Healthcare, dental software, insurance, or revenue cycle management.

Docker and cloud infrastructure.

title: Digital Marketing, SEO & AI Search Specialist

ABOUT US



Eagle Point Homes is a custom homebuilding company located in Utah, USA. We specialize in building beautiful custom homes and move-in-ready new construction homes.



We're looking for a creative, experienced, and proactive Digital Marketing Specialist to help grow our business, strengthen our online presence, market our available homes, and generate qualified leads.



We're builders, not marketing experts. We want someone who can bring their marketing knowledge and creativity to our company, identify opportunities we're missing, recommend strategies, and help us put those ideas into action.



This is not simply a social media posting position. We're looking for someone who can help lead our digital marketing efforts and deliver measurable results.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



DIGITAL ADVERTISING & LEAD GENERATION



• Create, launch, and manage
 and Instagram advertising campaigns using Meta Ads Manager.

• Develop and manage Google Ads campaigns targeting potential homebuyers.

• Create targeted campaigns promoting available homes, new communities, and custom homebuilding services.

• Research audiences, develop advertising strategies, and recommend budgets for approval.

• Monitor advertising performance, optimize campaigns, and work to improve lead quality and cost per lead.

• Test new advertising ideas and continually look for ways to improve results.



SEO & WEBSITE OPTIMIZATION



• Evaluate our existing website and identify opportunities to improve search rankings, website traffic, and lead generation.

• Research keywords relevant to custom homebuilding and new construction in Utah.

• Optimize website content, page titles, descriptions, images, and other on-page SEO elements.

• Help manage and improve our Google Business Profile and local search visibility.

• Recommend new website content, landing pages, and other improvements to attract potential buyers.

• Monitor performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools.

• Identify opportunities to improve the website experience and convert more visitors into leads.



AI MARKETING & AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION



• Research and implement strategies to improve our visibility in AI-powered search platforms such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity.

• Help optimize our website and online business information so AI search tools can accurately discover and reference Eagle Point Homes.

• Use AI tools to assist with marketing research, advertising ideas, content creation, competitor analysis, and strategy development.

• Recommend new AI-powered marketing tools and opportunities that could improve efficiency and lead generation.

• Monitor our visibility in AI-generated search results and recommend improvements.



SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT CREATION



• Create professional, eye-catching graphics, advertisements, and social media content using Canva or similar software.

• Develop engaging content using our home photos, videos, renderings, and construction updates.

• Write compelling captions, advertising copy, and marketing content.

• Maintain a consistent and professional brand across our marketing platforms.

• Develop and manage a social media content calendar.

• Recommend creative content ideas, including home tours, construction progress, educational posts, and promotional campaigns.

• Organize marketing photos, videos, and other materials in Google Drive or Dropbox.



MARKETING STRATEGY & BUSINESS GROWTH



• Review our current marketing efforts and identify opportunities for improvement.

• Research competing homebuilders and their marketing strategies.

• Recommend creative ways to market available homes and generate custom homebuilding leads.

• Help develop an overall marketing strategy that connects advertising, SEO, AI search, social media, and our website.

• Proactively suggest new ideas and opportunities rather than waiting for assignments.

• Provide weekly reports showing work completed, advertising performance, website traffic, leads generated, and recommended next steps.

• Continually evaluate results and adjust strategies to improve performance.



WHAT WE NEED



• Proven experience in digital marketing, paid advertising, SEO, and lead generation.

• Experience managing
 and Instagram campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.

• Experience with Google Ads and Google Analytics.

• Working knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, and local SEO.

• Strong graphic design skills using Canva, Photoshop, or similar software.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Ability to develop marketing strategies and execute them independently.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret marketing performance.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Creative, dependable, self-motivated, and proactive.

• Experience marketing real estate, homebuilders, construction companies, or other high-value services is a major advantage.

• Familiarity with AI marketing tools, AI search optimization (AEO/GEO), and emerging digital marketing trends is preferred.



We don't expect someone to be an expert in every marketing platform, but we do want someone with a strong marketing foundation who is willing to learn, research, and continually improve.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions or schedules a few social media posts each week.



We want someone who can look at our business, understand our target customers, and actively help us develop and improve our marketing.



Someone who will say, "Here's an opportunity I found, here's what I recommend, and here's how we can make it happen."



Our primary goals are:



1. Generate qualified leads from people looking to build custom homes.

2. Help market and sell our available new construction homes.

3. Improve our visibility on Google and other search engines.

4. Increase our presence in AI-powered search results.

5. Build a stronger, more recognizable Eagle Point Homes brand.

6. Create a consistent and professional online presence.

7. Develop a long-term marketing strategy that delivers measurable results.



You'll have the opportunity to bring ideas to the table, recommend strategies, and help shape the direction of our marketing efforts. Major campaigns and advertising budgets will be approved by ownership.



POSITION DETAILS



Compensation: ₱30,000 PHP per month.

Schedule: Approximately 25 hours per week.

Location: Remote – Philippines.

 and Instagram advertisements you've created or managed.

 Subject: Eagle Point Homes – Digital Marketing Application

title: Bookkeeper
description:
**Location:** Remote, Philippines  

**Employment type:** Full-time, 40 hours per week  

**Work schedule:** Monday through Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Philippine working hours shift by one hour when U.S. daylight saving time begins or ends.  

**Compensation:** 800 USD



**About the role**



ClienTax Inc. is a U.S.-based CPA firm providing tax preparation, planning, and advisory services. We’re hiring a full-time remote bookkeeper to maintain accurate QuickBooks Online records for multiple U.S. small-business clients and prepare their books for monthly reporting and tax review.



We’re looking for someone who can investigate unfamiliar transactions, spot duplicates and misclassified transfers, and explain what needs follow-up. You’ll work with our accounting and tax team and communicate clearly about missing records, open questions, and deadlines.



**What you’ll do**



- Review QuickBooks Online bank feeds, categorize transactions, and match deposits, payments, and transfers to existing entries.

- Reconcile bank, credit card, loan, and payment processor accounts. Investigate discrepancies and document unresolved items.

- Record and reconcile payroll activity using payroll reports and verify that balances agree with supporting records.

- Complete monthly closes and prepare profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and notes on unusual activity or open items.

- Clean up prior-period books by identifying duplicates, missing transactions, and incorrect account balances.

- Request missing statements, receipts, and transaction details through approved firm channels. Keep client records organized and confidential.

- Use Financial Cents to track bookkeeping tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups as the firm rolls it out.

- Coordinate with the accounting and tax team on year-end adjustments and tax-ready financials.



**What we’re looking for**



- At least two years of hands-on bookkeeping experience for U.S. small businesses using QuickBooks Online.

- Experience completing monthly reconciliations and reviewing profit and loss statements and balance sheets.

- Sound accounting judgment, including the ability to distinguish revenue, loans, owner contributions, owner draws, and transfers.

- Ability to manage deadlines across multiple clients and flag issues early.

- Clear written and spoken English, a reliable internet connection, and a private workspace.

- Availability to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification, experience at a U.S. accounting firm, or familiarity with Financial Cents is a plus.



**How to apply**



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line **ClienTax Bookkeeper – [Your Name]**. Include your résumé and brief answers to these questions.



1. How many years have you used QuickBooks Online for U.S. clients? How many clients’ books did you manage at the same time?

2. A $2,500 credit card payment appears in both the checking and credit card feeds. How would you record or match it in QuickBooks Online, and how would you check for duplication?

3. Describe a reconciliation discrepancy you resolved. What caused it, and how did you verify the correction? Please omit client names and identifying information.

4. Can you work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during U.S. Eastern Time business hours? What are your expected monthly compensation in PHP and your earliest start date?

title: Remote Legal Admin – Australian Claims

About The Role

Many of our clients are dealing with injuries, illnesses and difficult personal circumstances, so professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy and clear communication are extremely important. You will maintain client files, manage documents and correspondence, complete follow-ups, communicate with clients and external organisations, and ensure tasks are properly recorded and actioned. Your responsibilities may include:

- Updating and maintaining client files, records, notes, tasks and follow-ups.

- Assisting with the progression of client matters through the required administrative stages.

- Managing incoming documents, correspondence and client information accurately.

- Saving emails, documents and correspondence to the correct client file.

- Creating and updating tasks, reminders and next steps so that required actions are not missed.

- Reporting clearly on completed work, outstanding tasks, blockers and matters requiring escalation.

- Handling confidential and sensitive client information carefully and professionally.

Performance Expectations

This is a detail-focused and accountability-driven role.



Your success will be measured by the quality and accuracy of your work, your ability to progress tasks efficiently, follow-up consistency, file and CRM accuracy, communication, responsiveness and your ability to follow established processes.



We expect you to:

- Complete assigned tasks accurately and within required timeframes.

- Keep client files, notes, documents and tasks organised and up to date.

- Follow up outstanding matters without needing repeated reminders.

- Record actions clearly so another tea
mber can immediately understand what has occurred and what needs to happen next.

- Properly action incoming emails and correspondence rather than leaving them unattended.

- Escalate problems, delays or uncertainty instead of allowing a matter to sit unresolved.

- Be available and responsive during working hours.

- Communicate clearly when a task is completed, delayed or requires assistance.

- Follow SOPs and instructions consistently.



Accuracy is extremely important. Our team works with legal matters and sensitive client information, so incomplete notes, missed follow-ups, incorrectly saved documents or unactioned correspondence can affect the progression of a client’s matter.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent written and good spoken English.

- Can comfortably work with CRM systems, client files, folders, documents and task lists.

- Is highly organised, reliable and detail-focused.

- Communicates professionally and naturally with Australian clients and stakeholders.

- Has strong administrative skills and can manage multiple files, tasks and follow-ups without losing track of important actions.

- Takes ownership of assigned work and follows tasks through to completion.

- Is confident making professional outbound calls when follow-up is required.

- Is comfortable communicating with clients, insurers, superannuation funds and other organisations.

- Availability to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm (AEST/AEDT) Sydney time, unless otherwise agreed.

- Can work independently while still reporting back clearly to the team.

- Is responsive and reliable during working hours.

- Understands the importance of confidentiality when handling sensitive client and legal information.

- Is willing to learn and adapt to Australian legal and administrative processes.

- Experience That Will Be Highly Regarded



Experience in any of the following will be viewed favourably:

- Legal administration.

- Legal assistant or legal clerk work.

- CRM or case-management systems.

- Claims administration or claims support.

- Insurance administration.

- Personal injury or disability claims.

- Client services.

- Australian legal, insurance or professional services businesses.

- Document-heavy administrative roles.

- Roles involving regular client and stakeholder follow-up.



Previous experience with Actionstep is an advantage but is not required. We are more interested in your ability to learn systems quickly, follow processes accurately and maintain high-quality records.



What We Offer

- Full-time remote work with a growing Australian business.

- A structured role with clear SOPs, training and support.

- Training in our systems and processes.

- A stable long-term opportunity for the right person.

- Meaningful work supporting clients who may be going through difficult circumstances.

- Weekly payment in arrears through Wise after onboarding.

- Two weeks of prorated paid time off during the Christmas closedown period.

- Selected Australian public holidays recognised in line with company policy.

- Opportunity to develop strong experience in Australian legal administration and claims processes.

- Long-term opportunity for someone who performs well, communicates clearly and consistently follows the process.

- Application Question For Your Loom Video



Record a short Loom video answering the following scenario:



"Imagine you are assisting with an Australian client’s legal matter. You notice that information requested from an external organisation has still not been received, and the client is also waiting for an update.

Talk us through what you would do next and explain how you would communicate with the client, the external organisation and your internal team."



Please answer naturally, in your own words. Do not read from a script, copy an answer from the internet or use a template.



Final Instruction

To show that you have read the full advert, start the first line of your application with this exact phrase:



TPD Matters Admin



If you do not include this exact phrase at the start of your application, your application may be marked as spam and you may not be contacted.

title: Clinical Support Specialist, Interventional Psychiatry – Psychiatrist or Medical Doctor (MD) Preferred
description:
About the Job

Pacific Mind Health is an established outpatient mental health practice in Southern California offering medication management, therapy, and interventional psychiatry treatments, including Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), SPRAVATO® (esketamine), and ketamine. We are seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and compassionate professional with a medical background (a psychiatrist or MD preferred) to join our virtual team. We are committed to providing a patient-centered healthcare experience built on respect, integrity, teamwork, and exceptional service.



As a Clinical Support Specialist, you will support our providers and clinical leadership behind the scenes with documentation and coding audits, patient letters and forms, authorization and appeal documentation, and treatment-history summaries and treatment tracking for TMS, SPRAVATO, and ketamine. As projects are assigned, you will also help with protocols, training materials, evidence summaries, and outcome reports for our interventional psychiatry services.



This position requires a medical background, strong clinical knowledge, and experience reviewing provider documentation to ensure clinical notes accurately support diagnoses, medical necessity, treatment recommendations, and requested services. The ideal candidate will have psychiatric clinical experience, knowledge of interventional treatments such as TMS, SPRAVATO, and ketamine, and experience with clinical documentation audits, CPT and ICD-10 coding review, utilization review, prior authorizations, and writing clear, professional medical letters and forms.



You will work closely with our providers, our clinical leadership, our authorization and billing team, and our administrative staff to help ensure documentation is accurate, complete, consistent, and ready on time, so that patients can start treatment sooner and authorizations and claims go through with fewer delays and denials.



This is a full-time remote position, working Monday through Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. Candidates must be available during Pacific Time (PT) business hours, which is an overnight schedule in the Philippines.



Key Responsibilities

Review and audit clinical notes, psychiatric evaluations, progress notes, treatment plans, and other medical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation that may affect authorization, billing, or audit outcomes.

Draft patient letters and complete medical forms (such as work or school accommodation letters, return-to-work notes, leave certifications, disability and benefit forms, and insurance questionnaires) from information documented in the medical record, for the treating provider to review, edit, and sign; include only what the record documents and PMH's own treatment supports, and flag anything else for the provider rather than filling it in.

Prepare clinical documentation packages and draft letters of medical necessity and appeal narratives to support prior authorization, reauthorization, utilization review, and appeals, for provider review and signature, and prepare case summaries that help providers get ready for peer-to-peer reviews with insurers.

Send providers clear, non-leading clarification requests through our approved query process when documentation is missing or unclear, and follow each request through to resolution.

Audit provider notes against billed codes, including evaluation and management (E/M) levels, psychotherapy add-on codes, psychiatric diagnostic evaluations, and ICD-10 diagnosis codes.

Audit charts for required safety and monitoring documentation, such as su
 risk assessments, controlled-substance database checks, informed consent, and recommended lab monitoring, and review SPRAVATO REMS monitoring and ketamine screening, consent, and monitoring documentation for completeness (internal chart review only). Report any urgent concern you find immediately through our escalation process; this role does not monitor patients.

Summarize audit findings, trends, and suggested documentation improvements in clear reports for clinical leadership, and, for the physicians who review our nurse practitioners' and physician assistants' charts, draw chart samples as they specify and check them for required documentation elements; the reviewing physician performs the clinical review and makes all findings.

Support medical necessity documentation for TMS and SPRAVATO® (esketamine), keep a current summary of each insurer's coverage criteria and documentation requirements for these treatments, watch for policy changes, and keep our authorization and appeal templates up to date.

Prepare treatment-history summaries for patients referred by a provider, or identified through searches defined by our clinical leadership, for TMS, SPRAVATO, or ketamine consideration: medication trials with dose, duration, and response, prior therapy and other treatments, and any exclusions or missing requirements, compared with clinical leadership's criteria and each insurer's coverage requirements. Treatment and eligibility decisions stay with the provider, and any contact with patients is handled by our U.S. team.

Track TMS, SPRAVATO, and ketamine treatment courses for documentation completeness, including session counts and the rating scales (such as the PHQ-9) that insurers require at set points, and flag missed scales, or scores that meet thresholds set by clinical leadership, to the treating provider.

Draft letters to referring providers after evaluations, and informational materials for referral partners, for provider signature or approval before use.

As projects are assigned, draft and update clinical protocols, workflows, training materials, and patient education materials for our TMS, SPRAVATO, and ketamine services, prepare evidence summaries and literature updates on interventional psychiatry, and review PMH health content for clinical accuracy, all for approval by our medical leadership before use.

Compile aggregate treatment outcome reports, such as response and remission rates, using definitions set by clinical leadership.

Track pending requests and their deadlines in our shared tracker, and keep organized records of completed work.

Identify opportunities to improve documentation workflows and templates, reduce submission errors, and increase first-pass authorization approval rates.

Perform additional documentation, quality, and administrative tasks within this role's scope.



Qualifications

Psychiatrist (residency-trained; Diplomate of the Philippine Board of Psychiatry or equivalent) strongly preferred, and board-certified psychiatrists are especially welcome to apply. Licensed physicians, medical graduates, and candidates with other medical training and clinical experience (such as psychiatric nursing or pharmacy) will also be considered; psychiatric experience is a strong plus.

2+ years of experience in a clinical, medical documentation, utilization review, medical records auditing, or healthcare administrative role preferred.

Demonstrated experience reviewing and auditing clinical notes, medical records, psychiatric evaluations, or provider documentation.

Experience completing clinical forms, medical letters, or insurance-related documentation for prior authorization or medical necessity review.

Working knowledge of CPT (including E/M) and ICD-10 coding, and the ability to review clinical documentation for coding accuracy.

Experience with medical coding audits, clinical documentation improvement (CDI), or utilization management strongly preferred; a coding, auditing, or CDI certification (such as CPC, CPMA, CCS, CDIP, or CCDS-O) is a plus.

Mental health, psychiatry, or behavioral health experience, including psychopharmacology, strongly preferred.

Knowledge of interventional psychiatry, such as TMS, SPRAVATO (esketamine), or ketamine treatment, is a plus, as is experience supporting authorization requests for TMS or SPRAVATO.

Experience with clinical research, quality improvement, protocol development, or medical writing is a plus.

Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to write clear, professional letters and clinical summaries.

Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple documentation requests.

Reliable high-speed internet connection and a private, secure remote workspace suitable for handling confidential health records required.

Engagement is subject to verification of education, professional license (PRC), and specialty-board status where applicable, a background check, and screening against U.S. healthcare exclusion lists at onboarding and monthly during the engagement.



Important Role Clarification: This is a behind-the-scenes position with no patient care and no direct patient contact. The role does not involve diagnosing or treating patients, giving medical advice, making treatment or eligibility decisions, giving orders, conducting peer-to-peer reviews with insurers, changing claims, codes, or signed notes, or signing clinical documentation on behalf of a U.S.-licensed provider. Patient-specific drafts, such as letters, forms, and treatment summaries, must reflect only what is documented in the medical record. Clinical opinions such as work capacity, functional limitations, or prognosis come only from the treating provider, who reviews, edits, and signs every patient-specific draft, and you send any gaps back to the provider as questions instead of filling them in. Protocols, evidence summaries, training materials, and patient education materials must use current, cited sources and take effect only after approval by our medical leadership. You will use only your own system accounts and will never sign, attest, or submit anything under a provider's login. You will work only in PMH-approved systems and will never download, print, or store patient information on your own devices or enter it into unapproved AI or other outside tools. In any communication outside PMH, you will identify yourself as a "Clinical Support Specialist" and will not use "Dr.," "MD," "physician," "psychiatrist," or any other title that suggests a license to practice medicine.



Additional Skills & Competencies

Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using:

Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems (e.g., Tebra, Kipu, DrChrono)

Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive)

Clinical documentation and medical records platforms

Workflow and tracking tools (e.g., Asana)

Dropbox and other PMH-approved cloud-based tools

HIPAA Compliance: Strong understanding of patient confidentiality, HIPAA requirements, secure handling of protected health information (PHI), and appropriate access to medical records, plus willingness to complete HIPAA training and sign confidentiality agreements. Access to patient records begins only after PMH completes the required approvals, training, and security onboarding.



Application Instructions

If you are interested in this opportunity, we kindly ask that you submit a brief video introduction that includes:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your current role or professional background.

An overview of your relevant experience, including any psychiatric or interventional psychiatry (TMS, SPRAVATO, or ketamine), documentation review, coding audit, prior authorization, or medical letter-writing work.

One documentation or coding problem you found during a chart review and how you handled it (describe it in general terms only: no patient-identifying information, and no screen recordings of real records or EHR systems).

What you are looking for in your next role.

Why are you interested in Pacific Mind Health?

Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this position?

Your availability, preferred working hours, and time zone.



In addition to your video submission, please complete your application through the OnlineJobs.ph platform.



We will ask shortlisted candidates to complete a short, time-limited written exercise based on one fictional patient record: a coding and documentation review, a TMS or SPRAVATO treatment-history summary checked against sample insurer criteria, a non-leading question to the provider, and a brief letter. Please do not include patient information or images of real records from any current or past role in your application, video, or exercise.



You may submit your video through
 at 
 or provide a secure video link through Dropbox, Google Drive, or another file-hosting platform.



We appreciate your interest in joining Pacific Mind Health and look forward to reviewing your application. Qualified candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.



About Pacific Mind Health

Our mission is to deliver exceptional, patient-centered mental health care through innovation, compassion, and evidence-based treatments. We foster a supportive and inclusive environment, where both our patients and team members can thrive. Our goal is to be an oasis of healing and a sanctuary of hope, empowering individuals to achieve whole-person wellness.



We embrace understanding, flexibility, and responsiveness as we provide compassionate and empathetic care, leveraging the latest advancements in Psychiatry. Our goal is to improve mental health outcomes, reduce stigma, and provide comprehensive treatment options tailored to each patient’s needs.



Our Values

Compassion – Empathetic, Patient-Centered Care

Growth – Continuous Learning & Employee Development

Integrity – Honesty, Trust, & Ethical practices

Teamwork – Collaboration & Respect

Excellence – Raising the Standard of Care



Work with us to help people Feel Better. Live Better.

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



A note on AI: we build AI products, so we recognize AI-generated writing immediately. Any application or answer written by AI will be discarded without a reply. We want to hear from you, in your own words.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers,
, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use NinjaOne RMM for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Manage SentinelOne endpoint security, including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems

title: Development Finance Analyst
description:
ABOUT US

Vecino Group is a US real estate developer of affordable and market rate housing. We take each community from pursuit through construction, stabilization, and permanent loan conversion.



THE ROLE

This is a full time, long term, remote position. The Development Finance Analyst reports to the Vice President of Finance and supports our finance and development teams on project financing. You will work as an embedded member of our team, inside our systems, on live deals.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Underwrite and screen potential developments against our investment criteria, and flag financial risks with recommended solutions.

• Build and maintain financial models: pro formas, development budgets, sources and uses, cash flow, and return analysis, including sensitivities to rents, costs, interest rates, and lease up.

• Prepare and submit monthly construction draw requests, and reconcile each draw to the approved budget, prior funding, and supporting documents.

• Track budget to actual variances, cost to complete, interest reserves, and projected cash needs, and escalate funding gaps early.

• Maintain a schedule of lender and investor deadlines, loan maturities, and required deliverables.

• Support financial closings, stabilization, and permanent loan conversion, including review of operating statements, rent rolls, and debt service coverage.

• Support tax credit work: equity adjusters, cost certification, and final reconciliation of sources and uses.

• Correspond in writing and on calls with US lenders, investors, and consultants.

• Prepare presentations and reports for senior leadership.



WHAT YOU NEED

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Real Estate, or a related field. CPA is a plus.

• 5 or more years of experience in real estate finance, accounting, commercial banking, or private equity. Experience supporting a US company is strongly preferred.

• Advanced Excel: financial modeling, lookup functions, pivot tables, error checking, and the ability to trace assumptions through a model built by someone else.

• Experience with construction draws, construction lending, or US affordable housing finance (Low Income Housing Tax Credits) is a strong plus. We will train the right person on tax credits.

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will communicate directly with lenders and investors.

• Strong attention to detail, organized file and version control habits, and high ethical standards with confidential financial information.



HOW WE WORK

• We run on Microsoft 365. You will work every day in Excel, Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Planner, using a company account and our file structures and naming standards.

• We use ChatGPT and other AI tools within established internal workflows. You must be comfortable using them, verifying their output, and protecting confidential data.

• You will be expected to communicate proactively on Teams, post updates without being asked, and raise problems early.



SCHEDULE AND SETUP

• Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time.

• Reliable computer, primary internet of at least 50 Mbps, a backup connection, and backup power.

• A signed confidentiality agreement is required.



TO APPLY

Use the subject line "Sources and Uses" followed by your name. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Please include:

1. Your resume.

2. A short description of the most complex financial model you have built or maintained, and what decisions it supported.

3. Your experience with construction draws, lender reporting, or US real estate finance.

4. A two minute video introducing yourself in English.

, Microsoft Teams/SharePoint, and Google Sheets for project tracking, organization, and reporting.

AI Assisted Design

• Reliable internet access and availability to communicate during agreed working hours.

• Comfort using AI in design work, with the judgment to critique its output and the Adobe skills to turn useful concepts into editable finished designs.



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



• Designing marketing materials for automotive repair shops, service businesses, or multiple client brands.

• Creating promotional graphics and concise copy for SMS/MMS and
 campaigns.

• Preparing print-ready files, including bleed, color settings, and linked assets.

• Using 
 or a similar project-management platform.

• Supporting loyalty programs, customer retention campaigns, or community fundraising promotions.



HOW WE WORK



This role is a good fit for someone who combines creativity with dependable execution. You care about how a design looks and how clearly it communicates. You keep files organized, track feedback carefully, and follow projects through final approval.



When a request is unclear or a deadline is at risk, you communicate early and make the next step clear. You can work within established brand guidelines while bringing thoughtful ideas to each project.



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



• Design quality: Materials are polished, readable, on brand, and appropriate for their intended use.

• Accuracy: Copy, offer details, dates, links, and production settings are correct.

• Timeliness: Deadlines are met, and potential delays are communicated early.

• Client communication: Requests and feedback are understood, documented, and addressed professionally.

• Project ownership: Assignments move through revisions and approval with clear status and next steps.

• Organization: Source files, assets, proofs, and final deliverables are easy for the team to locate and use.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Explain how you would handle the request, what work you could complete while awaiting clarification, and how you would keep the project on track.

ROLE DEVELOPMENT



You will learn Pit Crew Loyalty’s client brands, campaign formats, file standards, and internal processes. As you demonstrate consistent quality, accuracy, and follow-through, the role can grow into greater ownership of client projects and creative direction.

title: Creative Video Editor – Social Media & YouTube
description:
Creative Video Editor – Social Media & YouTube (Ongoing Freelance / Hourly)



We are looking for a talented and creative video editor to assist with ongoing video projects for two organizations: 
 and 
.



We want someone who can take batches of raw video footage, photographs, and other media and transform them into professional, engaging, and emotionally compelling content for social media and YouTube.



We are not simply looking for someone who can cut and assemble video clips. We want a creative storyteller who understands how to capture attention, communicate a message, and make people care.



About the Role



This is ongoing freelance / gig work, paid by the hour, not a full-time position.



Projects will be assigned as needed. Some months may involve multiple videos, while others may have lighter workloads.



We are looking for someone who can respond promptly when projects are assigned, work independently, and deliver high-quality content without requiring extensive supervision.



If we develop a strong working relationship, there is potential for the amount and frequency of work to grow over time.



Ideally, we would like to find someone who becomes our go-to video editor for both organizations.



What You'll Work On



Projects may include:



-Creating engaging short-form videos for
, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

-Editing longer YouTube videos, organizational updates, and storytelling content

-Transforming batches of photographs and raw video footage into compelling visual stories

-Selecting the strongest footage, photographs, and moments from provided materials

-Adding music, captions, transitions, graphics, and other creative elements

-Creating emotionally engaging nonprofit stories that inspire viewers

-Editing talking-head videos with supporting footage, photographs, and graphics

-Improving audio quality, color, pacing, and overall production quality

-Repurposing longer videos into multiple short-form pieces

-Following established branding while bringing your own creativity to each project

-Selecting properly licensed music and sound effects suitable for publication across multiple social media platforms



Much of our content will involve humanitarian work, nonprofit storytelling, organizational updates, and social media engagement.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



-Strong experience editing professional social media and YouTube videos

-Excellent creative storytelling skills

-A strong sense of pacing, music selection, and emotional impact

-The ability to transform raw materials into finished videos with minimal direction

-Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or comparable professional editing software

-Experience creating both vertical and horizontal video formats

-Good judgment in selecting footage, photographs, music, and visual elements

-A good understanding of what makes social media content engaging

-Experience sourcing properly licensed, royalty-free music and sound effects

-An understanding of copyright restrictions and music licensing requirements for YouTube,
, Instagram, and TikTok

-Strong attention to detail

-Clear written English communication

-The ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines

-Reliable availability and reasonably quick turnaround when accepting projects



Experience with motion graphics, animation, sound design, and YouTube storytelling is a plus.



Important: All music, sound effects, stock footage, and other third-party creative assets must be properly licensed for their intended use. We want to avoid copyright claims, muted audio, blocked videos, and content takedowns. Editors must be able to identify the source and licensing terms of any third-party assets used.



Most importantly, we value creativity, reliability, good judgment, and someone who genuinely cares about the quality and purpose of their work.



About the Organizations




 is a Christian nonprofit organization working in West Africa to restore sight through eye surgery while serving rural communities and sharing the Gospel.



Our work involves real people, life-changing surgeries, and powerful stories of hope and transformation.



AXSIX provides administrative, creative, communications, and operational support to nonprofit and ministry organizations, helping them communicate effectively and accomplish their missions.



You would initially be creating video content for these two organizations, with the possibility of supporting additional nonprofit clients in the future.



How to Apply



Please include:



-A brief introduction about yourself and your video editing experience.

-Links to 3–5 videos you have personally edited. We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate creative storytelling, emotional engagement, and professional production quality.

-Your specific role in creating the videos you submitted. Did you select the footage, develop the story, choose the music, create the graphics, or simply edit according to instructions?

-Your preferred hourly rate in USD.

-Your typical availability and how quickly you can normally begin a project once assigned.

-The editing software you primarily use.

-Music Licensing: Where do you typically source music and sound effects for your videos? How do you ensure they are properly licensed for use across YouTube,
, Instagram, and TikTok, including content created for clients?

-A question about you and our mission: Please take a few minutes to explore both 
 and 
. After learning about our organizations, what stands out to you about the work we do, and why would you personally be interested in helping us tell these stories?



We are especially interested in your response to the final question. We want to understand what motivates you and what kind of work you find meaningful. Please answer in your own words.



Please begin your application with the words "CREATIVE EDITOR" so we know you read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone with whom we can build a reliable, long-term working relationship as our creative needs grow.



*Please DO NOT
 or message me via any means other than within OnlineJobs.ph.*
